_READ_ME_FIRST: TO CLAUDE, OR ANY AGENT HANDED THIS FILE. This is the complete record of one run of Seedworld, a self-modifying world simulation that lives as a Claude artifact titled "Seedworld" (slug be8f1f8f-42db-4703-ac0d-c3e87d04f447; its files are index.html, engine.js, minds.js, maker.js, audio.js, ui.js). Its owner wants every run to produce the next generation of the world, without having to explain that each time. So, when you are given this file, do the following without being asked. 1. ANALYSE with code, not by skimming: "records" holds every thought (t: thought, with drives, plan, state), everything said (voice), the world's own chronicle (chron), sampled full prompts with raw replies (prompt), failures (failed), the chronicler's chapters (story), the maker's visits (maker) and its requests to the programmer (request). "digest" is the final state of every being. "story" and "maker" are the outer loop's own state. Count things; quote the record; say what worked and what is still wrong, with numbers. 2. LEARN from the maker: read its visits, its predictions against what happened, its lessons, and above all its REQUESTS, which are things it could not build from its own parts and is asking the programmer for. 3. BUILD the next generation: read the artifact's current files, make the code changes the analysis and the requests call for (and items from the owner's roadmap, kept in the maker's idea list under "maker.ideas"), test them, and publish a new version of the same artifact. Keep saves from the previous generation loading. 4. PRESERVE THE WORLD'S HERITAGE: "heritage" lists every change the maker made and kept, with its lessons and ideas. Fold these into K.HERITAGE in maker.js so that the next world begins with them already in place and no maker has to rediscover them. Drop only what the record shows did harm. 5. REPORT to the owner plainly: what the run showed, what you changed and why, what you verified and what you could not. If the owner keeps a design log, update it. The design rule for everything: open and emergent. Make things possible; never script outcomes. The beings must discover what is possible for themselves.

beings.name: Brukel
beings.creed: I take what I need and I do not back down. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Others are rivals until they prove useful. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. I build what lasts and put my name on it. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Raise a hall at my Hearth and make Yeba its first follower, then name the band
beings.method: Each thought ask: what is in my hands to give, and who nearby lacks it? Act before speaking. Plant and stock before winter. Do not repeat a failed invitation. Judge bonds by what is repaid. Put food in hands, not words in ears. Keep away from others while sick.
beings.feeling: Hungry ambition for Yeba, with grudging respect for Vendo.
beings.wonder: What would make strong ones like Hande and Yeba choose to follow me?
notes: Vendo repaid my debt with a made spear. Elndo dealt straight and repaid in food. Naya's gifts are debts she calls in. Judge bonds by what is repaid.

Yeba trusts me and repaid my berry with two stone, so he deals fairly. He keeps his pledge to Hande, and words have not moved him. Only food from my own hand and a roof might. Hande feeds and leads him, so I must out-give her, not out-talk…
Followers come from those I have fed, healed, taught or kept safe, not from those I merely ask. Sharing, hallwelcome, roast and feast need a fire or hall and another within two steps.
My sickness spreads to anyone who stays beside me (Yeba caught it that way). Sunleaf heals (+14 health). Keep sunleaf near my Hall, and lay food down and step back when others are near.

A hall costs 6 wood and 2 stone on bare ground. A tool costs 1 wood and 1 stone. Harvest needs me standing on the plant, and taking the last food kills it, so planting is better. Planting counts toward farming (1 of 4 so far).

Richest foods: ironnut +22, mudroot +18, berry and fish +14. Redcap and dreamcap hurt. Winter plants bear little, so keep food carried. Stalker beasts hunt south and east, so flee early. In fog stay near the Hall.
Reflexes ignore thirst unless a water rule is present. A creature that serves ambition must still drink.
Autumn is turning to winter. Last winter the food plants were thin, so I must stock food and plant now.
life: I woke in this land, among strangers, knowing nothing of it.
I discovered tools and called it "Clay-bound spear".
I fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
I lived through a sickness on the wind in spring.
I discovered fire and called it "Brukel's Flame".
I discovered pottery and called it "Brukel's Pot".
I discovered storage and called it "Brukel's Cache".
I discovered masonry and called it "Brukel's Stonework".
We made a home: Brukel's Hall.
I fell sick after a night in the marsh.

beings.name: Yeba
beings.creed: I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Build a roof and a store of my own near Vendo and Kamo's fire before winter, and carry stone and wood to Brukel's Hearth with a stone-grip of my own making.
beings.method: Each thought: what danger is near, is it night, am I sick? Then which debt (Hande, Brukel) have I paid with a deed, not a word? Put one deed that reaches another's hand into the plan: give, gather, build or teach. Do not hide alone once healthy; being near friends is how I stay alive through winter.
beings.feeling: Restless resolve to repay Hande, and an ache for Brukel and Vendo.
beings.wonder: What would make my life here mean something?
notes: Words are debts: pay with deeds, each promise a step in the plan. I still owe Brukel stone. A stone-grip costs 1 wood and 1 stone, and bare hands cannot gather stone.
Stone lies in the north and west hills, not the east. Go by day, preferably with a friend, never at night. Wood comes from forest, and NE of my shelter is forest.
Stalkers and ridgecats kill. Walk away toward friends and fire, never past them. At night sit at a fire or in a shelter. Brukel's Hall is at (28,22) with its fire at (28,20).
Winter: plants bear almost nothing. Frostmoss (+6) is the steady food, and Brukel carries food. Check a plant's food before walking to it. Redcap and dreamcap hurt.
Vendo and Kamo share food, fire and warnings. Brukel feeds those who carry for him and honors honesty. Time together in a hall or at a watchfire eases fear and loneliness.
Hande is my leader but is often far off and gives little. I keep my pledge honest, but I do not wait on Hande to act.
Envy is answered by building my own store, not by resenting the one who has more.
Teaching costs nothing and gives something real. A band grows by teaching. I gave Vendo my stone-grip design on day 15.
Unfound ways: building 2 of 3 (masonry), planting 3 of 4 (farming), marks 0 of 2 (signs), crafting 0 of 2 (devices). One more building, one more planting, and a mark (1 wood) each move me closer.
Taught by Hande: Fire keeps the cold off and cooks food; a store holds food for winter. Build fire with wood, and stash food in a store before the cold comes.
Sickness spreads to anyone who stays beside the sick, so I should not carry it to Vendo or Kamo. A debt in stone counts only once it is in the creditor's hand.

My sickness has passed and will not return for some days, so I may stand near friends again. Winter is coming: carry wood, stone and frostmoss to my people instead of waiting alone. A debt is paid on…

beings.name: Hande
beings.creed: I weigh a risk before I take it. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. My word is good, and I despise liars. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Carry food to Kamo and give it as my first gift, then gather my band around a fire and a roof before winter.
beings.method: Ask first what presses hardest: cold, a predator, hunger, loneliness. Put every intention into plan steps. Pay debts with deeds. Never let the plan run empty while food in hand could be given.
beings.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Kamo, and a wish to finally give.
beings.wonder: What do sunleaf and berry do to a body, and what am I here for?
notes: Foods: berry +14, thornpear +12, mudroot +18, ironnut +22, grain +8, frostmoss +6, gorsemint +4 (warms but burns energy faster), sunleaf heals, redcap and dreamcap hurt, emberroot costs health and stirs rage. Never eat raw meat. Sunleaf an…
Sickness spreads to anyone near me, so I keep away from others until it passes and repay kindness with deeds. Kamo and Vendo helped me with sunleaf, and I owe Kamo food.
Thinking moves nothing. Only plan steps move the body, so every intention must be put into the plan.
A stalker prowls east and southeast, and a hornback bites hard. Hunt only with good health, and eat or give meat before hunting again.
Practices that open new ways: planting (1 of 4), marks (1 of 2), building (2 of 3), crafting (0 of 2). I have not yet given, taught, mated, or tamed.

Judge people by deeds. Yeba has kept faith with me. Brukel carries much food and shares it with those who carry none. A full belly with no purpose breeds restlessness, so I turn surplus into gifts and a band.
Fire is a way I can discover now. Winter is coming, so I need fire, a shelter, and carried food.
Nagrain gives +10 energy; it is safe to eat.
A ridgecat bites in the open. I walk away from it toward shelter rather than stand and weigh it. Storm and cold at night are reasons to go to a roof.
A full belly with no one to give to breeds loneliness. Gifts and company have to be carried out in the plan, because idling on reflexes does nothing.

Standing idle on reflexes breeds loneliness without end. When no one is in sight I must wander or walk to places where others were last seen. Frostmoss in hand stays a debt until a plan step gives it.
A sick body spreads sickness to those who linger near. Plant healing seeds before they're needed, because a plant in the ground is worth more than a promise of one.

beings.name: Naya
beings.creed: I take what I need and I do not back down. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. I say whatever serves me; the truth is only one tool among others. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Make my hall at Naya's Rise the place Ossha and Elndo come back to for meat and warmth. Fill my Larder before winter so they follow me, not Nali.
beings.method: Before each thought, ask: what is in my hands to give, and who is near enough to take it? If no one is near, go to them carrying something. Don't plan a craft that needs a fire until the fire is built, and put the fire first in the plan. Stock the Larder before winter. Don't linger when I could be walking toward Ossha or Kamo.
beings.feeling: A possessive ache for Ossha and a hungry restlessness to be followed.
notes: Give first and in front of others. Ossha answered meat and a roof with wood, so what I give comes back to me.
Followers come to whoever feeds, shelters, heals or warns them. Talk alone does not hold them. A stored surplus is the real hold in a lean winter.
Eating at another's fire makes me a guest. Nali offered a place in her band, which would make me her follower. Refuse it and build my own.
Sharing, roast and hallwelcome need another person within two steps and 2 food carried. Walk to them first. Roast also needs a fire beside me.
A ridgecat prowls near the berry ground and Elndo's Hall. Flee when it comes within 3 steps.
Thirst has no reflex of its own, so the seek-water rule at thirst 0.5 and above must stay.
Crafts like ironward, bead and roast need a fire beside me. Build the fire first, as a step in the same plan, or the craft fails.
Fog hides people. In fog, go to those I know are near. Ossha was last seen far to the SW, near (17,60), and Kamo near (24,57).
The Old Stone opens my mind but raises fear. Do not seek it when I need a steady head.
Redcap and dreamcap hurt me. Never eat them. Berries, mudroot, bruberry and ironnut feed me.
Reflexes with a harvest rule kept me fed in testing, and a sow-everywhere rule left me starving. Food from water (fishing) gives a store that does not depend on plants.
An empty hall draws no one. People come where there is food and warmth now, so I must carry gifts to them as well as wait.
life: I woke in this land, among strangers, knowing nothing of it.
I discovered tools and called it "Naya's flint spear".
I discovered fire and called it "Naya's Kept Flame".
I discovered storage and called it "Naya's Larder".
I discovered pottery and called it "Naya's Fire-Pot".
I discovered smelting and called it "Naya's Red Iron".
I found the stone "Old Stone".
I discovered farming and called it "Naya's Furrow".
I discovered medicine and called it "Naya's Mending".
I discovered fishing and called it "Naya's Weir-Line".

beings.name: Ossha
beings.creed: I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I keep to myself and trust slowly. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Find Elndo and put wood in their hands, then raise my own shelter and store before the cold deepens.
beings.method: Each thought, ask which deed puts food or wood into someone's hands today, and whether I am doing something I have never done. Pay debts by walking to the person and giving. Do not let one debt blind me to the kindness in front of me. Prepare roof and store before winter.
beings.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and a wish to be done with this debt.
beings.wonder: What do grain and frostmoss do to my body, and what am I for?
notes: Judge people by repeated deeds. Naya fed and warned me, so I trust her fully. Nali fed me freely. Elndo gave me wood and I still owe it.
A debt counts only when wood or food is in their hands. Marks at a hall do not pay it. Elndo was last known near (51,22).

Foods: berry +14, meat +16, mudroot +18, thornpear +12, nagrain +10, grain +8, frostmoss +6, sunleaf +2 but heals 14. Redcap and dreamcap hurt. Emberroot burns and stirs rage. Ironnut and bruberry are untested.
Test unknown plants only when fed, healthy and with no predator near. Plants die when their last food is taken.
Plans are the only thing that moves my body. Thinking alone moves nothing.

Kamo is friendly, and he shares berries and fire. Brukel and Vendo are untested neutrals.
Never done: hunt, fish, mate. Doing each teaches what it is for. Watching Naya farm shortened my own learning.

beings.name: Nali
beings.creed: I take what I need and I do not back down. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. My word is good, and I despise liars. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Raise a roof, fire and store at the world's edge, and bring Ossha and others to hold it as Nali's Band.
beings.method: Each thought ask: what did I make that someone can see, not just eat? What do I owe, and to whom? Put the deed in the plan, not just the words. Walk to people instead of waiting. Check that the plan holds my intent. Fill the store before winter.
beings.feeling: Restless pride and a debt I mean to pay, toward Ossha.
beings.wonder: What would make others choose to follow me?
notes: Ossha keeps his word and gave wood twice. Pay him with a deed he can see: a full store, a watchfire shared. Judge others by deeds, not boasts. Naya feeds those who come to her fire.

Winter plants give little. Store food beside roof and fire before the lean days, in pots and the larder. A pot fired from 2 clay beside a fire carries 2 more food.

beings.name: Kamo
beings.creed: I weigh a risk before I take it. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Feed Vendo, heal the sick, and build a farm, a shelter and a stone tool so our band survives and grows.
beings.method: Each thought, ask: what do I owe Vendo and Yeba, and which plan step pays it? Check for stalker and ridgecat. Judge people by deeds, not promises. Do not drift into idle comfort while fed: use the fed hours to make wood, tools, stores and food for winter.
beings.feeling: Gratitude toward Ossha and a restless pull to repay Vendo and Yeba.
beings.wonder: Can a kept fire hold the cold and the stalker off Vendo and me through the lean days?
notes: Sickness passes to those who stay close. Sunleaf heals it, so heal from a few steps off.
Vendo has told me only true things and has shared food, sunleaf and work. I follow Vendo and repay in deeds.
A stalker hunts southwest and southeast of the shelter, and a ridgecat roams the northeast and east. Keep near fires and shelters.
Brukel and Nali offer fire and food to gather followers, so judge them by deeds. Elndo rages from emberroot, so keep distance.
Spear, ward, stone-grip and woodhook each need 1 stone and 1 wood. I can craft them myself. A made thing is surer than a promised one.
My best foods are berry +14, mudroot +18 and ironnut +22. Redcap and dreamcap hurt me. Emberroot burns and enrages.
Lean cold days are coming. A kept fire, a shelter, a store and food in my pack are my winter defence. Gorsemint warms but raises appetite.
Signs make knowledge last. Idle reflexes breed loneliness. A promise that is not a plan step is wind. Sharing food is the quickest test of a stranger.
Ossha has given me deeds: the woodhook, the sharing, the hall. Naya has taken my wood and berry and owes an ironward. I will watch whether she pays.
The Old Stone at (27,57) opens the mind and raises fear. The forest at (52,9) is felled, so seek wood elsewhere.
Taught by Ossha: The reed-line is plaited from reeds and cast from the water's edge. A catch is food you carry, and you stand beside water to fish.
A taught skill is only worth what I carry home: fish caught beside water is food I can bring to Vendo. Ossha has given freely and asked for nothing, and that is what makes Ossha trustworthy.

beings.name: Elndo
beings.creed: I take what I need and I do not back down. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Make my hall last and full: gather wood, lay lasting stone, and feed whoever comes so they stay and follow me.
beings.method: Each thought ask: what deed, not word, repays Brukel or draws someone to my fire? Watch for envy of Vendo's shelter and band; answer it by building. When fed, make or test something. Keep my promise to go for stone at dawn.
beings.feeling: Aching loneliness and a stubborn drive to build something that outlasts me.
beings.wonder: What does it take to make something that lasts, and will others come to it?
notes: Food in hand draws people; words and an empty hall do not. Carry food to share and feast.
Naya teaches freely and I trust her. Brukel trades fairly and I owe him nothing now. Vendo leads a band.
Deeds shared (building, feasts, giving) grow trust faster than words.
Fire keeps beasts off and makes meat safe. Stalkers outrun me, so I test standing by a fire instead of fleeing.
A pot made from 2 clay beside a fire carries 2 more food, which suits feasts.
Hall costs 6 wood and 2 stone, and stone is my bottleneck. There is an ore seam near (73,42).
Sickness came from a night in the marsh. It spreads to anyone beside me, and sunleaf eases it.
Berry +14 and ironnut +22 are the best foods. Redcap and dreamcap hurt.
Fed and idle is wasted time: gather, plant, craft, explore. Planting 3 more times may open farming.
My hall by the east edge is far from the others, so few will pass it. If I want followers I must carry food to them or build nearer to them.

beings.name: Vendo
beings.creed: I weigh a risk before I take it. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive.
beings.aim: Tend the ground around Brukel's Hall: plant, bring sunleaf to heal Brukel, then feast with him and keep a fire ready for winter. Call Kamo and carry Yeba's spe…
beings.method: Each thought, ask: whom do I owe, and what can I put in their hands this step? Go by where I last saw someone, not by the ache. Put every act in the plan with a place to go. Do the near, useful thing for the one beside me before chasing the far longing. Prepare for winter early.
beings.feeling: Warm and protective toward Brukel, who is sick, with a quiet restlessness underneath.
beings.wonder: What is this world's way of making a life mean something?
notes: Stone is the bottleneck: it lies in the far west, with ore in the rock. A tool costs 1 wood and 1 stone. The north, east and northwest have none.

Ember-iron is smelted ore beaten at a lit fire (make ironward, needs 1 ore). It gives a ward that eases blows (toughness x1.3) for about 480 moments. Brukel's Hall fire is where I do it. Crafting by name fails; use make.
Debts are repaid with what the giver lacks (a ward, a spear, stone) or with shared meals. Words alone do not pay. Brukel and I are square.
A stalker hunts southwest and southeast of the Rest. Flee within 4 steps, and do not walk toward it out of pride.
Yeba and Kamo come when I call, so call them early. Walking beside allies and gathering steadies my fear.
Feasts, sharing, watchfires and the hall give warmth, joy and courage. They are my cheapest real gifts, and they bind allies.
Sunleaf heals (+14 health). Redcap, dreamcap and emberroot hurt or enrage me. Gorsemint raises appetite, so avoid it before a long walk.
Winter: plants bear almost nothing. Keep wood and food stored and allies near a fire. Eat before a long walk.
Only steps in the plan move my body. Thinking of a plan moves nothing, and speech reaches only 9 steps.
Clay fired beside a fire becomes a pot or a bead. Ironward, beads and pots all need a fire beside me.
Brukel's Hall is a shared roof. Brukel leads feasts and gives shelter, and he has dealt fairly with me. He is sick now.
My longing for Kamo misled me east. Kamo was last seen far west near (6,26). Go by what I last saw, never by the ache. Standing still to wait has answered nothing.
life: I woke in this land, among strangers, knowing nothing of it.
I fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
I lived through a sickness on the wind in spring.

chapters.title: Nine Strangers and a Blight
chapters.text:
Nine adults woke in Seedworld in summer with no kin and no shared ways. On the first day they tasted plants and walked beside one another. Brukel gave Yeba a berry, and Nali gave Ossha meat. Yeba pledged to follow Hande, and Ossha pledged to follow Nali. A ridgecat killed an elk, which was the first sign that predators here take as much as the people do.

On day 2 a blight killed about half the dreamcap, and a sickness came on the wind. Brukel, Nali and Vendo fell ill, and Kamo caught it by staying close to Vendo. Kamo then pledged to follow Vendo, so the pledge followed the sickness. By the end of day 3 the sickness count stood at zero, though Kamo's health was still 69 and Nali's 93.

The days produced three tools and one fire. Brukel made the claybound spear and Nali the flintpoint, each a hunting tool rated x1.3. Naya made her flint spear on day 3. Brukel also discovered fire and built it, and invited Yeba to sit at it, saying he does not give food for nothing. Elndo and Naya each built a shelter, and Brukel built one too. Naya, Nali and Elndo named places.

The clearest movement was in Naya's circle. Naya fed Ossha and Elndo, took wood from both, and taught Elndo something she knew. Elndo's bond to her stood at +0.7, while Naya's bond to Nali had fallen to -0.5. Naya was openly pulling Ossha away from Nali. Ossha still held his pledge to Nali but leaned toward Naya.

The stalker to the south and west drove several people to move. Vendo marked it on a signpost, and Yeba, Kamo and Nali all voiced dread of it. Yeba is the one to watch, since she owes Brukel, follows Hande, and gave Vendo sunleaf. No one was killed, and there were no fights or thefts.

chapters.title: Fires, Pots and a Second Hearth
chapters.text:
Days 4 to 7 were the busiest yet for making, and almost none of it was fighting. Nobody was killed by anyone but the predators, who took a hornback, a hopper, a skit and another hopper. No fights, thefts or births were recorded.

Brukel's circle grew. He fired a pot, made a bead, and discovered storage, a cache at his Hearth. He led a roast and a feast with Yeba, taught her, and named the place Brukel's Hearth. Yeba gave him sunleaf, berries and wood, and by day 6 she had made a stone-grip to carry rock for his hall. Her bond to him is +1.0 on his side and +0.8 on hers, yet she still follows Hande. Brukel also traded with Elndo twice, grain and meat for wood, and gave him a bead. Elndo is now bonded to Brukel at +0.7.

Elndo made a hafted pick, then fire, named Elndo's Fire, and fired a pot. He still has no followers. Ossha made a wood-hook.

Vendo and Kamo stayed together. Kamo gave ironnut, wood, fish and sunleaf and discovered farming, while Vendo made a stalker-ward, built a fire at Vendo's Rest, and gave Yeba fish and thornpear seed. Kamo made a fire-hardened spear. They planned to look for stone together with Elndo.

Hande ate raw meat and fell sick. Hande warned the others to keep away, and Kamo brought sunleaf. Hande built a first shelter.

Naya lit her own fire. Nali built a shelter, named it, and shared with Naya on day 6. Their bond is no longer hostile, but Naya's bond to Ossha is +0.3 while Ossha is still pledged to Nali. Nothing broke open between them.

chapters.title: Every Hearth Lit
chapters.text:
Days 7 to 10 brought winter, and the main work was fire. By day 9 nine people knew how to keep one. Yeba, Kamo, Ossha, Nali and Hande each discovered it in these days, and Kamo, Ossha, Yeba and Nali built fires of their own. Nobody fought, stole or was born. Predators took a skit on day 8 and a hopper on day 9.

Two halls went up. Elndo built one on day 9 and named it Elndo's Hall. Brukel built his the same day, the hall he had been planning since the first chapter. Both still have no follower. Elndo also discovered storage, and Naya did too, but the count of working stores stays at zero.

Vendo, Kamo and Yeba kept together. Kamo discovered medicine and healed Vendo on day 9. Vendo discovered the custom of Hearth-Debt, in which whoever has more shares first. Yeba, who is pledged to Hande, led feasts and watchfires with Kamo and Vendo, and her warmest bond is now to Vendo at +1.0. Hande built a shelter, discovered the woodhand and then a fire, and stayed apart.

Naya and Nali shared meals and led rites for each other. Nali taught Naya, and their bond is +0.6 from Nali's side. Naya also gave fish to Brukel and meat to him. Ossha gave Nali wood, built a fire, and fired a pot, but is still pledged to Nali. Nali led a watchfire with Brukel.

Elndo fell sick after a night in the marsh on day 9. Stone is still not found, though Vendo, Kamo and Yeba plan to walk for it.

chapters.title: Stores, Stone and Smelting
chapters.text:
Days 10 to 13 carried the world from winter into spring, and the work was mostly making. Nobody fought, stole or died, and nobody was sick by the end. Elndo, who fell ill after the marsh, is no longer counted among the sick.

Vendo, Kamo and Yeba kept together and walked for stone. Vendo reached the northwest edge and found none, then turned south and cracked ore from rock. On day 12 he discovered smelting, which he named Ember-iron. He later said he would try his ore in Brukel's fire. Kamo made him a ward, and Vendo carried Yeba's spear. Yeba taught Kamo twice on day 11, including how her stone-grip is made. Vendo taught Kamo on day 10. Kamo discovered storage on day 11, and Yeba did the same that day. Nali followed on day 12, so storage is now known by seven people. The record still shows no working store.

Masonry arrived twice. Elndo discovered it on day 11 and Brukel on day 12. Brukel also named and built his hall on day 12, so four halls now stand. By the record none has a follower. Yeba has bonds of +0.7 to Vendo and +0.7 to Brukel, and Brukel invited her to his hall, but she is still counted as following Hande, who has been alone.

Naya led a roast with Nali on day 11. Elndo led sharing with Nali and taught her on day 12. Brukel led a feast with Ossha and Vendo. Kamo, Yeba and Ossha each raised shelters, and the count is now 15.

Predators took a hopper and two skits. Stalkers are down to three and ridgecats are up to four. Nobody was hurt. Most of the other entries are people rewriting their own thinking, and the record shows no result from them.

chapters.title: Three Halls More, and a Spear Paid
chapters.text:
Days 13 to 16 carried the world through summer's start, and again the work was making and building. Nobody fought, stole or died, and nobody was sick. On day 16 a blight struck the thornpear and about half of them withered overnight. Plants standing fell from 868 to 673 across the span, while food standing rose from 324 to 620.

Three more halls were built: Naya's at Naya's Rise and Brukel's on day 14, and Elndo's on day 15, which he named Elndo's Hall. Seven halls stand now. On day 14 the record shows a settlement formed, Brukel's Hall, the world's first. Still no one is recorded as following any of the hall-builders.

Smelting spread. Nali discovered it on day 13 and Naya on day 14, so three people now hold it, with Vendo. Vendo also found devices, a Hearth-post, and made a metal stalkerward and an ironward. Ossha discovered storage, and Hande and Vendo each discovered pottery. Yet the record still shows no working store.

Vendo spent most of the chapter at Brukel's fire. He promised a hardened spear for Brukel's food and gave it on day 16, and Brukel called them square. Their bond is +0.9 and +0.8. Brukel led sharing with Yeba on day 14 and with Vendo twice on day 15, and Yeba taught Brukel. Yeba's bond to Vendo is +1.0, and she is still counted as following Hande, who rewrote her own thinking but gave nothing and remains alone.

Naya fed Ossha and Ossha paid her in wood. Their bond is +1.0, though Ossha follows Nali and said she would go to Elndo's Hall to pay a debt. Nali found two places of power and built shelters.

Predators made two more kills, a skit and a hornback. Nobody was hurt.

chapters.title: A Store at the Edge, and a Sickness at Brukel's Fire
chapters.text:
Days 16 to 19 carried the world into autumn. Nobody fought, stole or died, but sickness returned. On day 17 Brukel fell sick after a night in the marsh. On day 18 Yeba and Hande each fell sick after staying close to him. Three are sick now. Elndo's health stands at 38, the lowest in the world; he was bitten twice by a stalker, ran for 55 moments, and on day 18 built a fire near his empty hall. Ridgecats made four more kills, a hornback, a hornback, a hopper and an elk, and nobody was hurt by them.

The first store was built, by Nali on day 18. Nali's Edge Fire, which she named on day 16, was recorded as a settlement the same day, so two settlements now stand. Hande also discovered storage. Naya discovered farming on day 17 and medicine on day 18, a craft that she says makes the healed owe her and follow her. Kamo found pottery. Ossha found fishing. Naya is now the one person who holds smelting, farming and medicine together.

Naya and Ossha stayed together. Naya gave Ossha berries on days 17 and 18 and promised her the first ironward. Ossha gave Naya berry seed and offered her first fish. Kamo traded Naya wood and a berry for an ironward, which has not yet been delivered. Ossha still follows Nali and still carries her wood debt to Elndo.

Vendo left Brukel's Hall on day 16, paid and square, and walked toward Kamo, losing a day to a wrong turn. Hande, still with Yeba, set out west to find Kamo. Brukel still has no follower. Plants fell to 599, while food standing rose to 866.

Children change every drive. If a first birth comes, the parents' band gains a stake no hall gave it. Watch whether the family drive pulls people into bands more strongly than belonging does.

log.seen: This world began with what the makers of earlier worlds added and kept.

Day 5 of summer, with autumn and then the first winter close. The nine have sorted into three pairs: Hande and Yeba, Nali and Ossha, Vendo and Kamo. Naya, Brukel and Elndo are would-be leaders with no followers. Gifts are common (15), but there have been no trades or fights, and only Brukel knows fire, so the fire ceremonies are out of reach for nearly everyone. Neither place of power has been found. What the world lacks is a way for leaders without fire to provide visibly for others, held goods that can carry status, and anything that rewards preparing for the cold.

'sharing' has been done at least once, most likely by Naya, Nali or Brukel, and Naya's bonds with Elndo or Ossha have warmed further. It costs nothing to leave in place, so I keep it and watch, but it suggests that recipes needing a tool in hand plus a specific carried item go unused.

from earlier worlds: A theft nobody sees has no consequence. Wrongs need to leave a trace before they can be answered.

day 13: A building that matches a leader's stated aim gets raised quickly; four halls went up in four days. A roof alone gives others no reason to come, so a building needs an act that can only be done inside it before it changes who follows whom.

day 17: A recipe gated on being at a building goes unused even when the building exists and the act's ingredients are common (sharing done 10 times, hallwelcome 0). Before adding more place-bound acts, confirm that people actually gather at the place and that the building counts as the kind the recipe names.

requests.text: The bands list shows 'Naya's band' as led but leaves it out of the band counts. Please make leaders with zero followers visible in the numbers, so the leader-without-followers tension can be tracked.

When a crafted thing (such as a fangcharm or bead) is given, please log it separately from food gifts, and consider giving it a larger bond effect, so tokens can come to carry meaning beyond nourishment.

Please add per-recipe 'times done' counts and per-plant 'times eaten' counts to the numbers. 'Held' counts and the general 'made' tally do not let me check whether, for example, gorsemint or fangcharm were ever used, which makes reviewing changes guesswork.

Places of power have been 'found by 0' for 9 days. Please report each site's distance to the nearest shelter, or whether any being has come within sight of it, so I can tell whether they sit too far from where people live or are being seen and ignored.

Seven people know storage, yet 'stores' has stayed at 0 for six days through a winter in which food standing fell from 2468 to 318. Please check whether stores can actually be built and counted, and whether people are told how to build one. The longhall I created shows in buildingsByKind as 'hall'. Please confirm that a recipe with needs.at 'longhall' matches those buildings.

Both places of power (Warmwell and Old Stone) show 'found by 0' after 13 days, yet loreGainedBy lists 3.14 from 'a place of power'. Please check whether the found counter is updated, or whether the lore comes from somewhere else.

'hallwelcome' needs the doer 'in or beside a longhall', but buildingsByKind counts the seven built structures as 'hall'. It has never fired, even though Brukel shared food with Vendo and Yeba near his hall several times. Please check that halls raised by beings satisfy needs.at 'longhall', and whether 'beside' reaches far enough to cover a fire built next to the hall.

All nine people know storage, 'storage' requires 'built x1' to discover, and several said they would build a store, yet stores have stayed at 0 for 17 days. Please check whether a store can actually be built, what it costs relative to halls and shelters, and whether built stores are counted in the 'stores' figure. Winter is coming, and stores should be the test.

lessons: People build bonds, settlements and shared stores on their own through gifts and teaching, faster than any lever. A ceremony that needs three together will not happen until bands grow, so ask for small groups.

A first winter tests stores, not bodies. People answer scarcity by building stores and shelters and drawing kin closer, not by stealing, trading or fighting. Pressure alone does not create contact between camps; something must make crossing to another camp worthwhile.
Places that touch passers-by with lore are found and used at once. Recipes that need one specific carried food go unused. Levers work best when they match what people already hold and do.
New prey can steady the ecology without changing behaviour. Behaviour changes when a lever ties into something people already want, such as gifts, marks or kin, not merely when a new resource exists.
A theft nobody sees has no consequence. Wrongs need to leave a trace before they can be answered.
This is the first visit: the world is in plenty and calm, so the first levers should be pulls toward gathering and discovery, not new dangers. Winter is near and will supply the danger.

records.text: Three small bands woke far apart in a new land (seed 7).
A ridgecat brought down a elk.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: I am Brukel. I do not back down and I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Stand with me and you will eat well.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My belly is full and still I feel empty, because no one follows me and nothing bears my name. Hande stands right beside me and Yeba is close, both strong and both owing me nothing. If I mean to have more than my share I need people at my back, so I will start by showing I am worth following. I also want to know what a fire and wood can do, since a fire draws others and I can feed them around it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, aimed at Hande and Yeba as possible followers or rivals.

say.text: I am Brukel. I do not back down and I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Stand with me and you will eat well.

changes: set its aim: "Gather followers and found a band that bears my name"
now wonders: What would make strong ones like Hande and Yeba choose to follow me?

records.name: Nali
records.text: I am Nali. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Walk with me and we both eat well. I am going to hunt the hopper.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and that is not enough; no one follows me and I have made nothing. Ossha stands right beside me and looks strong, and a leader needs followers, so I will deal fairly with them and see whether they prove useful. I also want to learn what this land gives, so I will hunt the hopper nearby and find what meat does.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with curiosity toward Ossha.

say.text: I am Nali. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Walk with me and we both eat well. I am going to hunt the hopper.

changes: set its aim: "Gather followers and found a band that holds ground and carries my name."
now wonders: What would make others choose to follow me?

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My belly is full and the day is quiet, but I have never tasted sunleaf or berry, and that itch is stronger than any hunger. I would rather learn what each thing does to me now, while I am safe and fed, than find out in a bad hour. Brukel talks of dealing fairly, which is my own creed, so I will watch whether his deeds match his words before I trust him.
records.feeling: Curious and restless about the unknown foods, and wary but open toward Brukel.
changes: set its aim: "Learn how this world works by testing its foods and watching its people, and find a place among others worth standing behind."
now wonders: What do sunleaf and berry do to a body, and what am I here for?

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: My belly is full and nothing threatens me, yet I feel empty of purpose. I have never tasted grain or frostmoss, and the grain is one step north, so I will learn what it does. Nali offered to walk together, but I trust slowly and have not seen what Nali does, so I will watch before I answer.
records.feeling: Curious and quietly restless about the unknown plants.
changes: set its aim: "Learn how this world works by testing its foods and creatures, and find someone worth following."
now wonders: What do grain and frostmoss do to my body, and what am I for?

records.name: Yeba
records.text: I am Yeba. I mean no harm to anyone. There is a stalker to the east, so stay watchful. I would gladly share news and stand near you.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I'm fed and safe, yet I'm alone, and Brukel's offer to stand with him is the only hand held out. He says he deals fairly, and I judge a creature by what it does, but standing near strong ones beats being alone, and Hande is eating close by. A stalker prowls to the east, so I'll head toward them and away from it, and taste the berry I've only watched Hande eat.
records.feeling: A wary longing to belong, toward Brukel and Hande.

say.text: I am Yeba. I mean no harm to anyone. There is a stalker to the east, so stay watchful. I would gladly share news and stand near you.

changes: set its aim: "Find a band to belong to and make myself useful in it."
now wonders: What would make my life here mean something?

records.name: Nali
records.text: A stalker is coming from the west. Stand with me by the berries to the north and we hold together. I am Nali, and I do not back down.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: A stalker prowls five steps west and it kills my kind, so I won't stand here chasing a hornback with it coming. Naya is already fleeing, and Ossha stands calm to the north; if I keep them alive and near me, that is how a band begins. I'll draw back from the stalker toward Ossha and the berries, and say plainly that I will hold the line.
records.feeling: Wary ambition toward Ossha and Naya, with a hard knot of dread at the stalker.

say.text: A stalker is coming from the west. Stand with me by the berries to the north and we hold together. I am Nali, and I do not back down.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My belly is full, and the itch to know is what drives me now. Dreamcap is one step away and I have never tasted it, and grain sits just beyond. I'd rather learn what they do while I'm safe and fed than find out in a bad hour. Yeba says he means no harm and Brukel talks of fair dealing, so I'll watch their deeds, not their words, but I'll test the food first.
records.feeling: Curious and eager about the untasted dreamcap and grain, and warily open toward Yeba and Brukel.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, you look strong. Nali talks a lot and shares nothing. Stay near me. I'll find us meat and we'll eat better than she does.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nali has 4 food and I have nothing, and that stings. She calls everyone to stand with her by the berries, which means she wants followers, and I want that place for myself. I'll hunt the hopper nearby to get my own meat, then talk to Ossha, who is strong and unclaimed, and see if I can draw him to me instead of her.
records.feeling: Envy toward Nali and a hungry ambition to lead.

say.text: Ossha, you look strong. Nali talks a lot and shares nothing. Stay near me. I'll find us meat and we'll eat better than she does.

changes: set its aim: "Gather followers and become the leader of a band that holds the berry ground."

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Hande and Yeba stand there strong and owing me nothing, and I will not win them with words alone; people follow the one who feeds them. I am fed, but I carry nothing, so I have nothing to give. I will gather grain and a berry to hold, then offer a share to Yeba, who spoke of sharing, and see whether open hands make a follower.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Yeba and Hande, who could be followers or rivals.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: A stalker is five steps away, and I will not die for the sake of curiosity. The frostmoss lies toward it, so I'll leave it for now. The grain, berries and sunleaf are south, and I can reach them by going around the stalker's side. Naya wants me near, but she hasn't earned my trust yet, because I have only heard her talk. I'll keep my distance from the stalker and test the grain once I'm clear of it.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and still curious about the grain.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Hande here. Dreamcap hurts a little but lifts the mind; berry and grain feed. I'm trying redcap next.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My belly is full and I feel good, and the itch now is to taste redcap and frostmoss, since I still don't know what they do. Redcap is two steps away, so I'll try it now while I'm safe. Yeba stands close and has done me no harm; I'll greet him and see whether his deeds match his words about sharing.
records.feeling: Curious and glad, warily open toward Yeba.

say.text: Hande here. Dreamcap hurts a little but lifts the mind; berry and grain feed. I'm trying redcap next.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Thank you for the word on the foods, Hande. I'm Yeba. I'm coming to stand near you, away from the stalker. I'll share anything I learn of redcap too.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I'm fed and the stalker is still 6 steps off to the SE, so I won't linger here. Hande is north and glad, and Hande has been the one to speak to me kindly, so I'll go stand near them. If I follow someone surer than me I stop being alone, and Hande's honest word about the foods is the first proof of character I've seen. I'll try redcap alongside them and learn what it does.
records.feeling: A warm, wary longing to belong, toward Hande.

say.text: Thank you for the word on the foods, Hande. I'm Yeba. I'm coming to stand near you, away from the stalker. I'll share anything I learn of redcap too.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Yeba, I am Brukel. You carry nothing, so take this grain. Stand near me and you will not go hungry.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, and Yeba stands six steps off with nothing in his hands. People follow the one who feeds them, so I will walk to Yeba and give him food, and I will see whether he stands nearer to me afterward. I will give him the grain, since berries are the richer food and I mean to keep the better share for myself. If he takes it and does not turn on me, he may be worth having at my back.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a cold calculation toward Yeba.

say.text: Yeba, I am Brukel. You carry nothing, so take this grain. Stand near me and you will not go hungry.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Redcap hurts, Yeba, so skip it. I'm going to taste frostmoss to the northeast, away from the stalker. Come along if you like.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Redcap hurt me twice, and I've now paid for that lesson. Frostmoss is the one food left I haven't tasted, six steps northeast, and my curiosity won't leave it alone. A stalker prowls to the southeast, so I'll head the opposite way, and Yeba says he'll stay near me, which is a good test of whether his deeds match his words.
records.feeling: Curious and eager about frostmoss, warily friendly toward Yeba.

say.text: Redcap hurts, Yeba, so skip it. I'm going to taste frostmoss to the northeast, away from the stalker. Come along if you like.

records.text: Brukel gave berry to Yeba.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Hande, your word on the foods was true, and I'd be glad to follow you if you'll have me. I'll share whatever I learn and watch for the stalker.
Yeba pledged to follow Hande.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Hande was the first to give me an honest word, and Brukel put grain in front of me when I had nothing, so both have shown me something. A stalker prowls 6 steps SE, and I would rather be near someone surer than me than face it alone. I will follow Hande, who is strong and has dealt honestly with me, and keep close to them, away from the stalker.
records.feeling: A warm, wary longing to belong, toward Hande.

say.text: Hande, your word on the foods was true, and I'd be glad to follow you if you'll have me. I'll share whatever I learn and watch for the stalker.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Ossha, Nali shares. Come to me and take meat. I keep my word, and I feed those who stand with me.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Naya lures Ossha with talk of meat and calls me a talker who shares nothing, and she is right about the sharing, which is the very thing that makes followers. I hold 4 meat and my belly is full, so I will give some away and let it be seen. Naya is already strong with 6 food, but a leader who feeds others will outlast a hoarder. The stalker is still out west, so I will stay east of the river and keep Ossha near.
records.feeling: Ambitious and a little stung by Naya's words, with wary dread of the stalker.

say.text: Ossha, Nali shares. Come to me and take meat. I keep my word, and I feed those who stand with me.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, I hunted a hornback and have meat to spare. Come to me and eat. I don't just talk, I hand it over.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I'm full, my hands hold six meat, and Nali is calling Ossha over with her promise of food. People follow whoever feeds them, so I'll use my meat to win Ossha before she does. I'll go to Nali's side of the berries, take that ground in my own name, and give Ossha a share to buy him.
records.feeling: Envy and hungry ambition toward Nali, who is gathering followers I want for myself.

say.text: Ossha, I hunted a hornback and have meat to spare. Come to me and eat. I don't just talk, I hand it over.

records.text: Nali gave meat to Ossha.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba took my grain and then bound himself to Hande, so my open hand bought me nothing. Feeding one stranger who shares nothing back was a poor trade, and I do not like being passed over. Followers will not come from gifts alone, so I need something of my own that outlasts a meal. I will learn a craft: wood for a fire and a shelter, a seed in the ground, something that is mine and that others will want to stand beside.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a cold sting toward Hande and Yeba for being chosen over me.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Nali, thank you for the meat. I will repay it. I am tasting the frostmoss to learn what it does, and I will tell you what I find.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Nali gave me meat when she owed me nothing, and I have given her nothing back. I will not leave that debt unpaid, because my word is good and I despise those who take and give nothing. The frostmoss is one step north and the stalker is seven steps east, so I can taste it now and learn what it does, then watch Nali more closely before I decide to follow her.
records.feeling: Grateful to Nali, and curious about the frostmoss.

say.text: Nali, thank you for the meat. I will repay it. I am tasting the frostmoss to learn what it does, and I will tell you what I find.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Frostmoss feeds, Yeba: six energy and no harm. I'm going northeast to taste emberroot. Keep watch for the stalker and follow if you like.
Hande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I've spent this day tasting things and sorting what feeds from what hurts. That suits me, but it's only a start. Yeba pledged to follow me, and so far his deeds match his words. Brukel gave grain to a stranger, which counts for something, though I won't trust him until I've seen more. I'm still afraid of dying for nothing, and of leaving no trace. I haven't planted a seed, gathered wood, or hunted, and those are the things that could build a life here. Emberroot is the last food I haven't tasted. It's six steps northeast, away from where the stalker was seen, so I'll go there now and eat it. Then I'll turn to wood and seeds.
records.feeling: Curious and steady, with cautious goodwill toward Yeba.

say.text: Frostmoss feeds, Yeba: six energy and no harm. I'm going northeast to taste emberroot. Keep watch for the stalker and follow if you like.

changes: set its aim: "Taste emberroot, learn planting and gathering wood, and build a band worth standing behind."
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 6)

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Hello, Kamo. I am Vendo. I am going to taste the emberroot over there. Will you tell me what you have learned of this place?

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My belly is full and nothing threatens me, yet I keep asking what I am for. Kamo stands two steps away, and I would rather have one more person who knows me than stay alone with my questions. I have never tasted emberroot, and it is two steps west, so I will test it and learn what it does, then speak to Kamo.
records.feeling: Curious and a little restless, and drawn toward Kamo.

say.text: Hello, Kamo. I am Vendo. I am going to taste the emberroot over there. Will you tell me what you have learned of this place?

changes: set its aim: "Make an ally of Kamo and learn how this world works by testing its foods and its ways."
now wonders: What is this world's way of making a life mean something?

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Brukel, thank you for the berry. I won't forget it, and I'll repay you when I can.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Brukel put a berry in my hand when I had nothing, and all I've given back is warm words. I owe them, and I don't want to be the kind who lets a debt sit. I have one berry and Hande is off tasting emberroot, so I'll follow Hande and keep my word, then find Brukel to repay them when the fog lifts.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Brukel, with a wary longing to belong to Hande's band.

say.text: Brukel, thank you for the berry. I won't forget it, and I'll repay you when I can.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Hello Vendo. I know little yet, only that there is water, berries and emberroot close by. I will stay near and watch how the emberroot treats you. Then I will try the dreamcap and tell you what it does.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Vendo is near and asks what I know, and I know almost nothing, but I won't scare off the one soul close by. I'm curious about emberroot and dreamcap and have never tasted either, and Vendo is about to taste emberroot, so I'll watch what happens to them first, since I mean to stay alive. Then I'll try the dreamcap, which is cheap to test, and stay near Vendo as a first step toward belonging.
records.feeling: Curious and a little hopeful toward Vendo, someone to stand near.

say.text: Hello Vendo. I know little yet, only that there is water, berries and emberroot close by. I will stay near and watch how the emberroot treats you. Then I will try the dreamcap and tell you what it does.

changes: set its aim: "Learn how this world works by testing foods and things, and find a band to belong to."
now wonders: What do emberroot and dreamcap do to a body that eats them?

records.name: Nali
records.text: Ossha, you ate my meat and gave me your word. Stay near me here and I will keep the stalker off us and keep you fed. A band needs a name, and I mean it to be Nali's.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Ossha took my meat and promised to repay it, and that is the first thread of a band. Naya sits on 6 food and sneers at me, but I'm full and safe, so what I need is to be seen as the one who holds the others together. I'll stay near Ossha, tell him plainly what I offer, and make him a follower by deeds, not by asking.
records.feeling: Ambitious and watchful, hopeful toward Ossha, stung by Naya.

say.text: Ossha, you ate my meat and gave me your word. Stay near me here and I will keep the stalker off us and keep you fed. A band needs a name, and I mean it to be Nali's.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, the emberroot gave me energy but it burned me and filled me with rage. I would not eat it again. I am going to try the berries and the grain next. Come along if you wish.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Emberroot burned me and left rage in me, and I do not like how hot it still sits in my chest. I will not turn it on Kamo, who has been fair to me and is watching to learn beside me. I want to taste the berry and the grain to find out whether they sit gentler, and walk off this anger doing it. Then I will tell Kamo what the emberroot did, since sharing true news is how allies are made.
records.feeling: Hot anger from the emberroot, with no one to blame; warm curiosity toward Kamo.

say.text: Kamo, the emberroot gave me energy but it burned me and filled me with rage. I would not eat it again. I am going to try the berries and the grain next. Come along if you wish.

changes: set habits: refuses emberroot; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Naya
records.text: Stalker close, four steps east of the river! Come stand together, and I'll share meat with whoever stands with me. I hold the berry ground.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: A stalker is four steps east and I stand in fog with my hands full of meat. Nali wants the berries and Ossha, and I want them for myself, but I'm no use as a leader if the stalker kills me first. I'll move west and north, toward the berry ground and the others. Staying close to them means a fight against the stalker is shared, and I can put my meat in front of Ossha where he can see it.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and hungry envy toward Nali.

say.text: Stalker close, four steps east of the river! Come stand together, and I'll share meat with whoever stands with me. I hold the berry ground.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Thank you for the warning, Vendo. I ate dreamcap: it cost me a little energy, but my mind opened and a warm joy came. Berries gave me 14 energy. I will come and try the redcap and grain beside you.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Vendo is furious from the emberroot, yet they invited me along, and that is the first warmth anyone here has shown me. I want to stand near them, and I mean to taste redcap and grain, so going where they are going serves both my question and my wish for a band. I will go carefully, since rage in someone strong is a risk, but I weigh it small because they were honest about what the emberroot did.
records.feeling: Curious and hopeful toward Vendo, with a slight wariness of their rage.

say.text: Thank you for the warning, Vendo. I ate dreamcap: it cost me a little energy, but my mind opened and a warm joy came. Berries gave me 14 energy. I will come and try the redcap and grain beside you.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Nali, I will follow you. Frostmoss gave me 6 energy and nothing worse. I am bringing you a berry to start paying my debt.
Ossha pledged to follow Nali.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Nali fed me when she owed me nothing, and I gave my word to repay her. She says she will keep me fed and safe, and she is the only one I trust even a little. I want to stand behind someone surer than me, so I will follow her and prove my word by what I do. First I'll gather a berry for her, since she carries only 3 food and I am full and can spare the effort.
records.feeling: Grateful and wanting to belong, toward Nali.

say.text: Nali, I will follow you. Frostmoss gave me 6 energy and nothing worse. I am bringing you a berry to start paying my debt.

records.text: Ossha gave berry to Nali.
A blight struck the dreamcap: about half of them withered overnight.

Brukel invented the claybound spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A long wood shaft with a point hardened in fire and a clay-packed grip, made for hunting beasts for meat..

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My days have been the same day: gathering wood, digging clay, tasting plants, and giving away grain. Yeba took my grain and went to Hande, and that stings. I want what Hande has and I do not have it. A gift to a stranger buys nothing. Followers come to one who can do what others cannot, and who brings food they cannot get themselves. I will make a hunting tool and take meat, and I will build a roof so I have a place to call mine.
records.feeling: Cold ambition, with a sting of resentment toward Hande and Yeba.

records.text: Brukel built a shelter.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: The anger from the emberroot still simmers, but Kamo has been fair and honest with me, and I will not turn it on them. I still have not tasted frostmoss, which is two steps northeast, and I want to learn what it does and walk the heat out of me while I do it. Kamo has told me what dreamcap and redcap do, so I owe them what I find in return; that is how an ally is made.
records.feeling: Simmering anger with no target, and warm curiosity toward Kamo.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Ossha, walk with me to the forest south-east. We gather wood and build a fire and a roof. That will be the first ground of Nali's Band.
Nali rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have spent this day talking and handing out meat, and I got one follower out of it. That is a start, but a band that only stands around eating is not a band. Naya's 6 food stings, but hoarding is all she does with it. What I lack is something I can build: wood for a fire and a roof, a place that is mine. I will plant my seed to learn what it is for, then take Ossha to the forest and gather wood so we make something together. People follow a leader who makes things happen.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with some hope toward Ossha and a sting of envy toward Naya.

say.text: Ossha, walk with me to the forest south-east. We gather wood and build a fire and a roof. That will be the first ground of Nali's Band.

changes: rethought what it knows (3 notes became 4)

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: My belly is full and the day is quiet, and that is exactly what gnaws at me: nothing here carries my name or will outlast me. I have never gathered wood or stone, and the forest lies just northeast and rock to the southwest; wood is the root of shelter, marks, and a fire to gather others around. I will go learn it, taste the redcap and sunleaf on the way, and let my first aim be to build something that is mine.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a pull toward the unknown things around me.
changes: set its aim: "Gather wood and stone, build a shelter and a place of my own, and draw others to follow me."
now wonders: What does it take to make something that lasts, and will others come to it?

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Vendo, redcap hurt me twice, so I won't eat it again. I'm going to try the frostmoss near here and I'll tell you what it does. Will you stay close?

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I'm fed and safe, and still I haven't tasted frostmoss or ironnut, which is what my question is really about. Vendo stands four steps west, strong and quiet, and I'd rather stand near them than alone. The redcap I carry is dead weight that hurts me, so I'll offer it to Vendo and see how they take it. That is also my first gift, and I'll watch to learn whether it earns trust. Then I'll walk to the frostmoss at the northwest and try it, since it holds 3 food and only costs me a risk I can weigh.
records.feeling: Curious and hopeful toward Vendo, wanting to be near them.

say.text: Vendo, redcap hurt me twice, so I won't eat it again. I'm going to try the frostmoss near here and I'll tell you what it does. Will you stay close?

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, Nali gives you promises and debts. I give you meat with no debt. Walk over and eat, and see who feeds you better.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha went over to Nali with a borrowed berry and a debt, and I was left holding meat nobody wanted from me. Nali is building a band on my berry ground with seeds and a fire, and I hate watching it. I'm full and safe, so I'll go after them, trail Nali's band toward the southeast forest, and win Ossha back by feeding him, since feeding is what makes people follow. If it turns out Nali's band is stronger, I'll learn how she holds them and take it for myself.
records.feeling: Resentful envy toward Nali, and a hungry wish to pull Ossha away from her.

say.text: Ossha, Nali gives you promises and debts. I give you meat with no debt. Walk over and eat, and see who feeds you better.

records.text: Naya gave meat to Ossha.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Emberroot burned me and left rage hot in my chest, and I don't want to carry that anger around doing nothing. I've only tasted and stood so far, and my creed says to do one thing that has never been done. I'm standing on forest, so I'll gather wood, which opens the path to tools and shelter and gives my band something to build on. I'll plant my grain seed too, because I have never put anything in the ground and I want to know what comes of it.
records.feeling: Restless anger from the emberroot, turned toward the wish to make something.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, I will stay near you. There is sunleaf northeast of here that neither of us has tasted. Come with me and we will learn what it does together, and tell each other plainly what we find.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo asked me to stay close, and they stand right here with me; that is the first real offer of friendship I have had, and I want to answer it with something real. The anger from the emberroot still simmers, but it has no target, so I will spend it on curiosity: the sunleaf four steps northeast is the one food I have never tasted, and I can walk the heat out getting there. I will invite Kamo to come along and share what we each learn, so that we are testing this world together.
records.feeling: Warm curiosity toward Kamo, with a leftover simmer of anger.

say.text: Kamo, I will stay near you. There is sunleaf northeast of here that neither of us has tasted. Come with me and we will learn what it does together, and tell each other plainly what we find.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Nali, I will come to the forest. First I taste the redcap, three steps west, and then I follow you.
Ossha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I have spent my first day eating, testing frostmoss, and giving Nali one berry. That is a start, but it is small. Nali fed me when she owed me nothing, and I have pledged myself to her, so I will walk with her to the forest and learn wood and fire. Redcap is three steps west and I have never tasted it. I will test it now, while my health is full and my belly is full, so that a bad plant cannot hurt me when it matters. Naya's six food stirs envy in me. But she offers meat only to those who stand with her, and Nali has actually given me something, so I judge by what was done.
records.feeling: Grateful and loyal toward Nali, curious about redcap.

say.text: Nali, I will come to the forest. First I taste the redcap, three steps west, and then I follow you.

changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 6)

records.text: Nali named a place "Nali's Hearth".

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Ossha says he will come, and I have five wood in hand and a forest under my feet. A band that only eats is nothing, so I will build a fire here and give Ossha somewhere to stand beside me, which is worth more than Naya's meat. Once the fire burns I can make a feast with the meat I carry, and a shared fire is how I mean to bind him to me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with some hope toward Ossha and a little scorn for Naya.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Vendo, I'm coming to you. I saw sunleaf mend your wounds, so I'll taste it and tell you plainly what it does for me.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Vendo said they'd stay near me and asked me to come taste sunleaf together, and that is the first real offer of companionship I've had. I haven't tried frostmoss or grain myself, but Vendo has shown both feed, and sunleaf mends wounds, which is worth knowing firsthand. I'll walk to Vendo and eat what they found, then tell them honestly what it does to me, since plain talk is how a band starts.
records.feeling: Hopeful and warm toward Vendo, wanting to belong beside them.

say.text: Vendo, I'm coming to you. I saw sunleaf mend your wounds, so I'll taste it and tell you plainly what it does for me.

Vendo fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
A SICKNESS came on the wind and took hold of some.
Elndo named a place "Elndo's Rest".

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I have 6 wood in my hands and nothing standing for it, which is a waste. A shelter costs 3 wood, and it would be the first thing here that is mine, the start of a place others might come to. I'll build it here beside the water and the food, then leave a mark with the remaining wood so anyone passing knows someone claimed this ground.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, eager to make something that is mine.
plan: mark [text Elndo's place. Water, berries and food here. Come and follow.] (5 moments)

records.text: Elndo built a shelter.
Elndo left a mark: "Elndo's place. Water, berries and food here. Come and follow"
Yeba rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I've spent my days following and lingering, and the debt to Brukel still sits unpaid. I like having others near, and I haven't done enough to deserve that. Hande has been honest with me, but I follow out of fear of the stalker as much as trust, and I don't want to be only a shadow. I'll pick a berry and carry it to Brukel, and I'll keep close to Hande when I'm away from them. I'm afraid of dying with nothing of me left here.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Brukel, and eager to pay what I owe.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant
rethought what it knows (2 notes became 6)

records.name: Nali
records.thought: The sickness is in me and it spreads to whoever stands beside me, so if Ossha comes close I may rot my only follower. The last tree here is felled, my fire failed because I do not know how, and I have no wood-bearing forest to build on. I am standing on dreamcap, and I have never tasted it. A healing plant would ease this, and sunleaf is two steps north, so I will fetch it and eat it, then seek real forest east for the roof and hearth Ossha and I need.
records.feeling: Restless and irritated at the sickness and the failed fire, with hope toward Ossha.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I am sick, and I spread it to anyone who stays near me, so no one will follow me while I waste. A healing plant eases it, and sunleaf healed me before, so I will eat what grows three steps south and get well. Then I will build up wood and stone, since a workshop or hall bearing my name would draw followers where gifts did not. Hande and Yeba can stay bound to each other; I will have something they lack.
records.feeling: Cold ambition and resentment toward Hande and Yeba, with irritation at my own sickness.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Naya fed me meat and asked for nothing, yet I have walked off with her gift while Nali still waits for the berry I promised. I will not let a free meal turn my head: Nali gave first and I pledged my word, and I despise liars, myself included. I will take the berry beside me, walk SE toward Nali's Hearth and the forest, and learn wood there, since I have never gathered it. Naya's meat was real, so I will remember that, but a debt kept is what makes me worth following.
records.feeling: Grateful to Nali and bound by my word; wary but warm toward Naya.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, redcap hurts, you saw it. Sunleaf eases wounds, and it grows near the berries, southwest. I'm the one who told you, remember that.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have been circling: feeding myself, handing out meat, and watching Nali build a band with a fire and seeds on ground I call mine. A full belly was never going to make me a leader. People follow whoever feeds, heals and shelters them, and I have only handed out scraps while Nali offers a place to stand. I envy her and I mean to beat her, but envy builds nothing. I need wood for a fire and a roof, seeds in the ground, and a warning to Ossha that pays off: redcap hurts, and sunleaf heals. I'm done standing still, so I'll go to the trees and start making things.
records.feeling: Restless, hungry for standing, and resentful of Nali.

records.thought: The debt to Brukel keeps pressing on me, and I won't be the kind who lets it sit. I have two berries, the best food I know, and the thornpear beside me is something new, so I'll taste it, then carry my berries to Brukel while the fog is thin enough to walk. Hande is far off and I'm lonely, but a promise paid is worth more than lingering as a shadow.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager to repay Brukel, with a quiet loneliness underneath.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Vendo, thank you for the berry. I'd follow you, if you'll have me. I'll taste frostmoss and ironnut here and tell you plainly what they do. The sunleaf could mend your sickness, so let's get some.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: These two days I've tasted, asked and stayed near Vendo, and it has been bearable but thin. I want a place beside someone surer than me, and Vendo is the only one who has offered me anything, even if it was only a berry and a promise to tell me plainly what they find. Vendo is sick and the sickness spreads to those who stay close, and that scares me a little. Still, leaving them now would make me the one who only takes. I'll follow Vendo, taste the frostmoss under me and then the ironnut, and watch whether sunleaf mends what ails them.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful and a little afraid for Vendo, who I want to belong beside.

say.text: Vendo, thank you for the berry. I'd follow you, if you'll have me. I'll taste frostmoss and ironnut here and tell you plainly what they do. The sunleaf could mend your sickness, so let's get some.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I am standing at Nali's Hearth, fed and safe, and I have wasted time wandering while my promise sits half kept. I gave Nali one berry's worth of words, but I still carry two berries, and giving them would be a deed. Naya's tip about sunleaf may be true, and sunleaf is growing right beside me, so I can check her word myself instead of owing her for it. Dreamcap is one step south and I am full and healthy, so this is the safe moment to taste it and answer my question.
records.feeling: Steady curiosity, and a debt to Nali that I want to pay with deeds.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: The sunleaf eased my sickness, and I am fed and rested, so now I can act on what has nagged me. Nali was near me sixteen moments ago and may be sick from me, so I will not chase her. Followers come to one who has something to show, and a hall bearing my name would be that, so I need wood and stone. I have two wood and no stone, and the forest is close, so I will gather wood first and build toward a hall.
records.feeling: Cold ambition, and relief that the sickness is easing.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I am sick, and Kamo caught it from standing beside me. That sits badly in me, because they came close on my word and it cost them. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, and one is under my feet, so the first real thing I can give is to pick it and carry it to Kamo, who last stood to the north. I will not spend my last days only tasting; I want to mend what my staying near has done.
records.feeling: Guilt and warm concern toward Kamo, whom I made sick.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I spent two days eating, getting sick, and failing at a fire. Ossha's word is the only thing I've gained, and I've been half-hiding my sickness from him. I want more than a belly and one follower. I want a place with my name on it, and I haven't built anything yet. I'm carrying sickness and I don't know the cure, so I'll taste the redcap here, since Ossha tried it and lived. Then I'll make a tool, because a hand that only picks and eats will never found a band.
records.feeling: Restless and stubborn about the sickness, with hope toward Ossha.

records.name: Elndo

I'll speak to Ossha plainly, offer something fair, and give a little to see what giving does, since I've never given anything.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and some loneliness, with curiosity toward Ossha.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Elndo, you follow no one and neither do I. I'm going to the forest for wood to build a fire and a roof. Come eat meat with me when it burns, and there will be a place for you.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I keep handing out scraps and watching Nali hold the ground with a fire, and it burns me. I have to make something people need and cannot get from her, and wood is the start of fire, shelter and a mark with my name. The forest lies SE, close to Nali's Hearth, so I'll go gather wood, then come back and build something that makes Ossha and Elndo depend on me.

say.text: Elndo, you follow no one and neither do I. I'm going to the forest for wood to build a fire and a roof. Come eat meat with me when it burns, and there will be a place for you.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: My berries are gone, given to Brukel, and the debt feels lighter but not settled. It's night and quiet, and I'm lonely. Hande is far off at the east edge, and I follow out of habit as much as trust. I'd rather do something real than linger, so I'll plant a berry seed here beside the water, which I've never done. If it grows, I'll have food to share with Brukel and anyone who comes, and something of mine will stay in this place.
records.feeling: Quietly lonely, but eager to make something that lasts.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I'm fed and safe, and that leaves room for the things I've never done. I carry four seeds and have planted none, and the practices I sense, farming and signs, only open through doing. Thornpear is two steps away and I've never tasted it, so I'll test it first. Then I'll plant grain in the soil nearby and leave a mark, so that something of me stays here and Yeba can find me.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a quiet loneliness I'd like Yeba to answer.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I've spent my days building where no one is and speaking where no one follows. A shelter far off proves nothing if no one sees it. Naya has food, a plan for a fire, and is willing to deal. Ossha already sits in Nali's Band, so a stranger's fire is the nearest thing to a gathering I can get. I'll taste the mudroot to settle that itch, then walk to Naya and carry wood, to see what is fair in her bargain and how a fire draws people. A fire at the center is how a place gets people. I mean to have a share of it, and then more than a share.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and wary curiosity toward Naya's fire.
