records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba has gone to find rock, and I will not wait with empty hands while he does the work. I need stone for my hall: two pieces, and I have none. I have wood and clay, so I should find rock myself and bring it back to my Hearth, so the roof bears my name and the debt runs toward me, not away. Kamo of Vendo's band stands near, strong and carrying nothing, and I will watch him but not provoke him yet.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition to see my hall rise, and warm trust toward Yeba.

records.text: Kamo discovered farming: "Tended Sowing" — I sow seeds near the Rest and return to tend them, so they grow quickly and I harvest without killing the plant..

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My days have been wood, fish and walking behind Vendo, and I have been safe and fed, but I haven't yet made anything that lasts. Vendo matters most to me. Vendo gave me food, sunleaf and true words, and I mean to repay that with deeds and not only talk. I keep eyeing Brukel's three food and his Hearth, but envy is a poor reason to act, and I'm wary of his price. Hande stands sick six steps away and I can't look away from that. Sunleaf eased me once, so I will carry it to Hande and see if healing works. I have planted again, and I think I now understand tending what I sow, so I will name it. What I'm getting wrong is waiting for stone while I have no shelter, no hunt and no farm to show for my days.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with compassion toward Hande and gratitude toward Vendo.
changes: set its aim: "Feed Vendo, heal the sick, and build a farm, a shelter and a stone tool so our band survives and grows."
rethought what it knows (10 notes became 9)

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Naya told me to stay and she would lay out meat on her ground, and she has just worked out a Kept Flame, which is more than I have made. I do not like being the one with less, but a fire and a roof are what a band is built on, and I would rather stand under her flame than alone in the rain. I will go to her ground and put my two wood toward her fire, so she sees a deed and not only words, and I will watch whether her promise of meat is true.
records.feeling: Pride stung by envy, and a wish for company, toward Naya.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Kamo, I'm Hande. I'm sick from raw meat and it spreads to anyone who stays beside me, so keep a few steps off. I mean you no harm, and I'd gladly talk from a distance.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Kamo stands five steps off, and I am still sick; if I walk up to a stranger I'd spread it, and I despise the thought of being that kind of liar by silence. I ate sunleaf and it did not clear me, so I'll tell Kamo plainly and keep my distance. Meanwhile I'll taste the ironnut and nagrain I'm so curious about, since they're near and my belly is full enough to risk a mild test.
records.feeling: Lonely, wary of passing my sickness to Kamo, and curious about the ironnut.

say.text: Kamo, I'm Hande. I'm sick from raw meat and it spreads to anyone who stays beside me, so keep a few steps off. I mean you no harm, and I'd gladly talk from a distance.

records.name: Elndo
records.text: Brukel, come to my fire here. I have no food to lay out yet, but bring your grain and I'll bring the wood, and we'll see who else comes to a fire that burns on its own.
Elndo named a place "Elndo's Fire".

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: Ambition gnaws at me: I have a pick and a flame no one else has, and still nobody follows me. Kamo and Vendo will go for stone at dawn, so I should be near them, but I can also use the night to build something of my own here. Brukel has been fair to me, and a feast beside my kept flame with him would be a deed that draws people and strengthens a trust worth having.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with warm trust toward Brukel.

say.text: Brukel, come to my fire here. I have no food to lay out yet, but bring your grain and I'll bring the wood, and we'll see who else comes to a fire that burns on its own.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Yeba, you gave me sunleaf when I was sick and I have not forgotten it. Here is a fish, and a thornpear seed to plant. Come to Vendo's Rest and warm yourself at the fire.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Yeba is four steps away, calm and strong, and I still owe them something real beyond a berry seed. I carry a fish and a spread of seeds, and a fish is food that costs me little, so I will offer it and share beside the fire. Elndo stands at the fire too, and I am wary of his emberroot rage, so I keep my distance and give to Yeba where I can. Kamo is away and the stone is not yet found, but paying one small debt now is worth more than waiting for the grand one.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Yeba, and wary of Elndo.

say.text: Yeba, you gave me sunleaf when I was sick and I have not forgotten it. Here is a fish, and a thornpear seed to plant. Come to Vendo's Rest and warm yourself at the fire.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Hande, thank you for the warning. I carry sunleaf, which eases sickness. I'll bring it and give it, then step back so I don't stay beside you long.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Hande is sick and warned me off, and that stings, because I know sunleaf eases sickness and I have two in my hands. I can heal from a distance of a few steps without standing close, and trying healing is something I have never done. The nagrain is also near, and I want to taste it, but a sick one who spoke kindly matters more tonight, and Vendo would want our band to grow.
records.feeling: Compassion toward Hande, with curious restlessness about the nagrain.

say.text: Hande, thank you for the warning. I carry sunleaf, which eases sickness. I'll bring it and give it, then step back so I don't stay beside you long.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Vendo, thank you for the fish and the seed. I'll plant it and I'll come to your fire soon, but I have a promise to Brukel to find stone first. If you see rock anywhere safe, tell me.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I promised Brukel stone, and I have wood and a way to make the grip, but I have no rock yet. Vendo's gift of fish and a thornpear seed touches me, and he is near and warm, so I will thank him honestly and not take his kindness for granted. Then I will go looking for rock, carefully, away from the SW and SE where the stalker hunts, and keep my word to Brukel.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vendo, and a steady resolve to keep my promise to Brukel.

say.text: Vendo, thank you for the fish and the seed. I'll plant it and I'll come to your fire soon, but I have a promise to Brukel to find stone first. If you see rock anywhere safe, tell me.

records.text: Vendo gave fish to Yeba.
Vendo gave thornpear seed to Yeba.
Kamo gave sunleaf to Hande.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I'm still sick, and Kamo has promised sunleaf but keeps his distance, which is the right thing to do. I'm curious about the ironnut and nagrain, but both are young and not worth the trip yet. The grain at my elbow is something I've eaten once. I'd rather pick it and carry it, so that when Yeba comes back I have something real to give. I've never given anything to anyone, and my aim says Yeba should be fed.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, and some wariness about spreading my sickness to Kamo.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Elndo, I'll hold you to that. At dawn we go find stone with Kamo, south-west of the shelter. Whatever we find, Yeba and Brukel need rock too, so we'll tell them where it lies.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Elndo stands on top of me, calm now, and he has said he will come find stone with Kamo and me. I have no stone, and Yeba asked to be told of rock, so finding it would repay Yeba and Kamo both. A skit is seven steps west, and I have never hunted; I have no ward yet, so I will take the risk of looking at it only after I have stone. For now I will gather wood and let the rain pass, then go with Kamo toward the south-west where his mark says the hunts are.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Yeba and Kamo, and a wary patience with Elndo.

say.text: Elndo, I'll hold you to that. At dawn we go find stone with Kamo, south-west of the shelter. Whatever we find, Yeba and Brukel need rock too, so we'll tell them where it lies.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a skit.
Brukel rewrote its own reflexes.
Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I have been stepping around my own ambition. I made fire, a pot and a cache, and still nobody follows me. Yeba's word is the closest I have come to a follower, and I got it by showing him a hall to come to. I stand at the world's edge with empty hands while he looks for stone, and that is not how someone who means to found a band behaves. My body keeps lingering when it could be hunting rock. I will let my reflexes gather stone and wood on their own and walk back toward Yeba and the fire. I do not trust Hande yet. I want him to see the hall rise before I ask him anything.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to raise my hall, and warm trust toward Yeba.

records.text: Elndo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Elndo discovered pottery: "Elndo's fired pot" — Clay shaped by hand and fired hard in my kept flame, to carry food for feasts and for the road..

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I spend my days gathering, lingering and promising, and I have little to show for it. No one follows me and nothing stands that is mine, because my words run ahead of my deeds. Brukel has done more for me than I have for him, and I mean to repay that with a real feast at my own fire, not just talk. Stone is the thing I lack, and I'll follow Vendo and Kamo for it at dawn. Until then I'll make something no one else here has: a fired clay pot, so I can carry more food and lay out a real table. My restlessness is envy of Vendo's shelter and band, and I'll turn it into work.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward my own name and place, with warm debt toward Brukel.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 8)

records.text: Elndo fired a pot of clay.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Hande, I gave you my sunleaf and I'm stepping back so I don't catch more of your sickness. Rest and drink water, it's close by to the southeast. I'll be near if you call.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Hande is sick and I tried to heal and did not know how, but the sunleaf is given and I keep my distance now. Vendo means to go for stone at dawn, and I have wood but no stone, so I should be ready and not idle. The nagrain is young and five steps off, so I will go look and see how it grows, and I can hunt the skit near it, which I have never done and which a stone spear would need anyway.
records.feeling: Compassion for Hande, and curiosity about the nagrain and the hunt.

say.text: Hande, I gave you my sunleaf and I'm stepping back so I don't catch more of your sickness. Rest and drink water, it's close by to the southeast. I'll be near if you call.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: The stalker is behind me, I am fed and dry, and the plan is empty, so I will use this calm to do what I have never done. I will put my thornpear seed in the ground here on the shallows' edge. It teaches me planting, and maybe it will be food for whoever comes after me, Elndo or Nali. Then I will taste the nagrain, since my question about grain and what I am for is still open.
records.feeling: Lonely, and grateful toward Elndo and Nali, with a quiet urge to do something instead of waiting.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a hopper.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo's kindness sits warm in me, and I want to repay it with something real, not only words. I promised Brukel stone, and I have wood but no rock, so the way to keep my word is to go looking, and I'll plant the thornpear seed Vendo gave me on the way so his gift grows. I'm standing at the world's edge with marsh to the south and snow to the west. Stone is likely west or inland toward Brukel, so I'll head back that way, carefully, toward the people I trust.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vendo, and steady resolve to keep my word to Brukel.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Kamo, your sunleaf was a real kindness and I owe you for it. I'll repay you with food once my sickness has passed and I can stand near you without harming you.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Kamo gave me sunleaf while I carried a sickness that could have passed to them, and I have given nothing back. That debt sits heavy, and I won't leave it unpaid, since my word and my fairness are all I have. I can't hand Kamo anything without standing beside them and spreading the sickness, so I'll gather a berry and grain to keep ready, and I'll tell Kamo plainly that I owe them. Then I'll try the ironnut when it ripens, because I still want to know what it does.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Kamo, and a wish to repay them without harming them.

say.text: Kamo, your sunleaf was a real kindness and I owe you for it. I'll repay you with food once my sickness has passed and I can stand near you without harming you.

records.text: Vendo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vendo discovered storage: "Rest-larder" — A store at Vendo's Rest where I and my band lay up food, so a lean day or a visitor in need can be fed..

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I have spent my days fed, safe and gathering, and it isn't enough. The things that mattered were the ones I gave away: the fish to Yeba, the fire, the tools. Hande is sick right here, and I have lived through that sickness and know what eases it. Sunleaf grows three steps from me, so I'll pick it and carry it to Hande. That gives something real to someone who has nothing from me, and it makes an ally of a neighbour. At dawn I'll still go for stone with Kamo and Elndo, but I'll keep away from the stalker's south-west and south-east ground.
records.feeling: Compassion for Hande, and warm gratitude toward Kamo and Yeba.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 6)

records.name: Naya
records.text: Nali, come with me to my Fire. I'll roast meat there for both of us. I made that flame, and you'll eat from it.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nali stands on my berry ground, glad and easy, as if it were hers, and I still don't trust her. But my hands are full of meat and fish, I have a fire built and a roof, and nobody depends on me yet. Fire is something I made that she hasn't, so I'll walk her to Naya's Fire and roast for her, let her eat from my hand, and see her owe me before Brukel, who is close, comes up and sees it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Nali, wary and wanting her to owe me.

say.text: Nali, come with me to my Fire. I'll roast meat there for both of us. I made that flame, and you'll eat from it.

records.title: Fires, Pots and a Second Hearth
records.text:
Days 4 to 7 were the busiest yet for making, and almost none of it was fighting. Nobody was killed by anyone but the predators, who took a hornback, a hopper, a skit and another hopper. No fights, thefts or births were recorded.

Brukel's circle grew. He fired a pot, made a bead, and discovered storage, a cache at his Hearth. He led a roast and a feast with Yeba, taught her, and named the place Brukel's Hearth. Yeba gave him sunleaf, berries and wood, and by day 6 she had made a stone-grip to carry rock for his hall. Her bond to him is +1.0 on his side and +0.8 on hers, yet she still follows Hande. Brukel also traded with Elndo twice, grain and meat for wood, and gave him a bead. Elndo is now bonded to Brukel at +0.7.

Elndo made a hafted pick, then fire, named Elndo's Fire, and fired a pot. He still has no followers. Ossha made a wood-hook.

Vendo and Kamo stayed together. Kamo gave ironnut, wood, fish and sunleaf and discovered farming, while Vendo made a stalker-ward, built a fire at Vendo's Rest, and gave Yeba fish and thornpear seed. Kamo made a fire-hardened spear. They planned to look for stone together with Elndo.

Hande ate raw meat and fell sick. Hande warned the others to keep away, and Kamo brought sunleaf. Hande built a first shelter.

Naya lit her own fire. Nali built a shelter, named it, and shared with Naya on day 6. Their bond is no longer hostile, but Naya's bond to Ossha is +0.3 while Ossha is still pledged to Nali. Nothing broke open between them.

threads.name: Brukel's Hearth
threads.text: Brukel holds fire, pot, bead and cache, and plans a hall. Yeba carries stone for him, but she has pledged to Hande, so he has no follower of his own.

threads.name: Yeba's loyalties
threads.text: Yeba follows Hande but works for Brukel (+1.0 from him) and is bound to Vendo by seed. Her pledge could break.

threads.name: Vendo and Kamo
threads.text: Mutual trust at +1.0 and +0.7. They have a fire, farming and a stalker-ward, and plan to find stone with Elndo.

threads.name: Elndo unaligned
threads.text: Elndo has a pick, fire and pot, and trades with Brukel, but no followers. Bonds are warm with Brukel and Naya.

threads.name: Naya and Nali
threads.text: Hostility has eased after sharing on day 6, but Ossha leans toward Naya while pledged to Nali.

threads.name: Hande's sickness
threads.text: Hande fell sick from raw meat and warned others. Kamo brought sunleaf.

threads.name: Gathering tools
threads.text: Tools known rose from 3 to 8, including picks, hook and grip at x1.3. Fire is known by four people, pottery by two.

threads.name: The stalker
threads.text: Six stalkers still range around the shelters. Vendo's ward and kept fires are the answer so far.

trends: Bonds up from 21 to 35, warm bonds from 1 to 8
Fire known by 4, pottery by 2, up from 1 and 0
Followers still 3, no band larger than 2

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I have fire, a pot and a cache, yet nobody follows me, and Yeba is hunting stone while I wander the sand with none. My hall needs 2 stone and I have 6 wood, so I will go find rock myself and not leave the debt running toward someone else. Naya and Nali are near her fire to the NE, and I want to be seen as someone with a place worth coming to, not an idle stranger.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to raise my hall, and warm trust toward Yeba.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I keep promising and have little built to show for it, and Vendo's shelter and band stand two steps from my own fire while I stand alone. I carry six wood and no stone, and the promise to go for stone at dawn is mine to keep, so I will gather berries for a real feast with Brukel and then go to the stone. A deed that feeds someone repays Brukel better than another invitation.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, edged with envy of Vendo's band and warm debt toward Brukel.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Naya, I will come to your Fire and eat what you roast. Afterward I mean to bring wood and stone and build beside it, so the fire has a roof and a band behind it, yours and mine together if you will stand with me.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Naya stands beside me and offers her Fire, and every time she says 'I made that flame' it stings, because she has a roof, a fire and a berry ground while I have two followers' worth of pride and nothing built. But I am fed, I have an idle hour, and I will not sit in her shadow doing nothing. I will go to her Fire and eat as an equal, and bring back wood and stone so my band has something of its own, with Ossha working beside me. Judged by deeds, she has given me meat and not mocked me today, so I will answer in kind.
records.feeling: Pride stung by envy, and a wary wish for company, toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, I will come to your Fire and eat what you roast. Afterward I mean to bring wood and stone and build beside it, so the fire has a roof and a band behind it, yours and mine together if you will stand with me.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Vendo, I hunted well and carry more meat than I need. Take some, you have none. Then let's go find stone, I have wood ready for the ward.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and Vendo has none, so I should give where it counts instead of just carrying it. Vendo is three steps off and walking toward Hande, so I'll go to Vendo, share the meat with a feast-like gift, and then ask about stone. I want to keep my distance from Hande's sickness, and I'll stay clear of the stalker's lands to the south.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Vendo, and a wish to be useful to them.

say.text: Vendo, I hunted well and carry more meat than I need. Take some, you have none. Then let's go find stone, I have wood ready for the ward.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Hande, I have lived through this sickness. Sunleaf eased it for me. There is one growing to the southeast, and water is close at hand. I will bring you some.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Hande is sick one step from me, and I know sunleaf eases it. I have eaten my sunleaf seeds' worth and carry only seeds, but a sunleaf plant stands seven steps SE, and I will not look away from someone I could help. Kamo's debt weighs on me too; I want to answer it with something real, not just words, and stone is still the thing we lack.
records.feeling: Compassion for Hande, and gratitude toward Kamo.

say.text: Hande, I have lived through this sickness. Sunleaf eased it for me. There is one growing to the southeast, and water is close at hand. I will bring you some.

records.text: Hande rewrote its own reflexes.
Hande discovered tools: "Wood-hand" — A shaped stick for gathering that lets me bring in wood and plants faster..
Hande invented the woodhand (for gather, x1.3) — A shaped stick for gathering that lets me bring in wood and plants faster..

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Since waking here I have mostly eaten, wandered and watched. Kamo's sunleaf was the first real kindness anyone did me, and I have never given anything to anyone. That shames me and fits badly with how I mean to live. I am sick and could spread it to Kamo, so I'll eat my sunleaf now, take myself off from the others, and gather wood for a shelter before the cold comes. I'll also take up toolmaking, because I watched Kamo's spear and want to make things that last. Once I'm clean of this sickness I'll pay Kamo back with food, and I'll build a band that is worth Yeba's pledge.
records.feeling: Gratitude and shame toward Kamo, and a restless wish to start making things.
changes: set its aim: "Repay Kamo with food once I am well, gather 3+ wood and build my first shelter before winter, make a tool, and build a band worth standing behind."
devised its first thing: the woodhand

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo's kindness weighs on me, and my promise to Brukel for stone is still undone. I have wood but no rock, and the grip needs both, so I must find stone before the cold comes. I'll head east, toward the people and the snow hills where rock may show, passing Naya's fire to meet Nali and Naya, since I am better among others.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vendo, and steady resolve to keep my word to Brukel.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Nali, Elndo, come to Naya's Fire. I have meat to roast and enough for both of you. I kept this flame, and whoever sits at it eats from my hand.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nali says she will come eat from my Fire and offers a band 'yours and mine together', but I won't share a band with a rival, and I don't trust her. Still, she is the one who walks to me, and a fed rival owes me. I stand one step from my Fire with hands full of meat, so I'll step onto it and roast there. Elndo is near and warm toward me, so I'll call him to the Fire too, and that gives me two who eat from my hand and speak of it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, wary toward Nali, warm toward Elndo.

say.text: Nali, Elndo, come to Naya's Fire. I have meat to roast and enough for both of you. I kept this flame, and whoever sits at it eats from my hand.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are heavy with meat, yet Vendo has none and I have not given it yet. Giving is what makes this life mean something, and the cold days are coming with no roof of my own. I have six wood and three of them can raise a shelter right here beside the water, so I'll build it, then share the meat with Vendo inside it.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Vendo, with a small worry about the coming cold.

records.name: Elndo
records.text: Naya, come to my fire at the east. I have berries and grain to lay out, and we'll eat together. Then I go for stone to build a roof, and I want you beside it.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I'm fed and idle while Vendo's roof stands five steps off and I have six wood and no stone. Words have run ahead of deeds, so I'll act now: Naya is near and trusts me, and I have food to lay out. A feast with her is a real deed that binds someone to my fire, and then I go for stone as I promised.
records.feeling: Restless ambition edged with envy toward Vendo, and warmth toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, come to my fire at the east. I have berries and grain to lay out, and we'll eat together. Then I go for stone to build a roof, and I want you beside it.

records.text: Kamo gave meat to Vendo.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Hande, I have two sunleaf for you. Eat them and drink water, it eased my sickness.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Hande is sick and I know sunleaf eased me. I have only seeds, and the plant I just harvested is dead, so I must not promise what I cannot carry. My pack holds 2 sunleaf, so I will carry them to Hande now while the sickness is fresh. Kamo's meat offer and my debt to him still weigh on me, and I will answer it once stone is found, but a sick one in front of me comes first.
records.feeling: Compassion for Hande, and gratitude toward Kamo.

say.text: Hande, I have two sunleaf for you. Eat them and drink water, it eased my sickness.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Nali, you're beside my Fire. Stay close and I'll roast now. Eat what I give you.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nali stands one step away and I'm on my Fire, so now I roast. A fed rival owes me, and Elndo watching me feed her will see who gives. I trust Nali no further than before, but her eating from my flame is worth the meat, and my hands are too full to do anything else useful.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Nali, warmth toward Elndo.

say.text: Nali, you're beside my Fire. Stay close and I'll roast now. Eat what I give you.

records.text: Vendo, thank you. I'm still sick and it spreads, so leave the sunleaf on the ground a few steps off and I'll pick it up once you've stepped back. I'll repay you in food when I'm well.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I'm still sick, and Vendo says sunleaf eased it for them and has offered me two. I can't take it from their hand without standing beside them and spreading this, so I'll eat my own sunleaf and drink water, then keep my distance. I have six wood and no stone, so I'll go find rock for the woodhand and pay Kamo back once I'm clean. Nothing here has ever been given by me, and I mean to change that.
records.feeling: Gratitude and restlessness toward Kamo and Vendo, with a sickly ache of shame.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: The calm is a gift, so I will not waste it staring at the river. I have 5 wood and a pledge to Nali that I keep promising and not paying, and I have never put a seed in the ground. The thornpear plan did not finish, since I tried to harvest where no plant grew. I will plant here on the shallows' edge now, then taste the nagrain one step west to answer my question, and then go to Nali with the wood, because my word is good only if I act on it.
records.feeling: Lonely, and restless to act on my debt to Nali and Elndo.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo has given me fish and meat and taught me the spear, and all I have given back is words. He carries more meat than he needs, so what I owe him is not food but stone, and a ward we make together. I'll go to him and share a meal beside the fire, then walk out and search for rock, keeping clear of the stalker's hunting ground to the south-west and south-east.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Kamo, warm and a little restless to repay him.

say.text: Kamo, you have given me more than I have given you, and I know it. Come, let us eat together by the fire, then go find stone. I'll lead us east and north, away from the stalker's ground, and the first stone we find goes to the ward we make together.

records.text: Vendo led "sharing" with Kamo.
Nali rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have spent these days eating, walking and promising, and I have little built that is mine. Naya's flame stings me because she made it and I did not. Ossha pledged to me and has done more than I have repaid. Autumn is turning and lean days are close, so my body must carry food, not only eat it. I will stock food and then make a feast at Naya's Fire, so it is shared work and I am not just a guest.
records.feeling: Pride stung by envy toward Naya, with a wary wish to stand beside her.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 9)

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: Naya has called me to her fire with meat to roast, and I trust her. Going there is a real deed: a shared fire binds her to me and eats the debt of words I keep running up. I have six wood and no stone, so I'll go to her fire now, eat and feast with her, then carry on to the stone I promised at dawn. Vendo's band still stings me, but I'll answer it by building, not by sulking.
records.feeling: Restless ambition edged with envy toward Vendo, and warmth toward Naya.

records.text: Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I've spent my days walking and promising, and the stone I owe Brukel is still not in my hands. I feel Vendo's gift as a debt I want to pay with a deed, not words. I'll plant his seed here as I said I would, then turn west toward the people, since I'm better among them. A kept flame I can carry wood to would give Vendo and Brukel somewhere warm to sit with me, and winter is coming with no roof of my own.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vendo, and a restless wish to finally keep my word to Brukel.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nali is a rival, but she walks to my flame and says she will bring wood and stone to build beside it, and I mean that roof to be mine. My earlier try to roast failed because the fire was not beside me, so I must stand on my Fire at (42,14) and make it there, with her near, so the meat comes from my hand and she and Elndo see who feeds them. A fed rival owes me, and a fed Elndo may start to follow. I'll keep my words few and do first.
records.feeling: Ambitious and wary toward Nali, warm toward Elndo.

records.text: Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kamo discovered fire: "Kamo's Ember" — A small fed flame kept beside our shelter that warms us, keeps beasts at a distance, and makes meat safe and filling when eaten beside it..

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My belly is full and my days are safe, yet I keep asking what I am for. The honest answer is that I have fed Vendo, hunted and built, and that has been good. But I still have no stone, no farm sown, no child, and a hard cold is coming. I trust Vendo and mean to stay beside them and keep them alive. I also want to learn to keep a flame, because cold is what will kill us first, and a fire is warmth and meat that does not sicken. I'll follow Vendo east toward stone, away from the stalker's ground.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vendo, and a restless wish to make something that lasts against the cold.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 9)
now wonders: Can a kept fire hold the cold and the stalker off Vendo and me through the lean days?

records.name: Nali
records.thought: A stalker is five steps northwest and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here and prove my boldness against fangs. Naya's Fire is one step east, and I have an idle hour, so I will move there and build the roof I promised: gather wood from the forest, then raise a shelter beside her flame so it is shared work that is also mine. Ossha has stood by me and I owe him, so a roof and a fire for a band of more than two is how I pay and how I get others to follow.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and still stung with envy toward Naya.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: bruberry (from berry).

records.name: Hande
records.thought: The sunleaf eased my sickness, so the ache is passing, and I am fed with a quiet night ahead. Mudroot lies one step east and gorsemint two steps northwest, and I have never tasted either; my curiosity is the loudest thing in me, and I will test one at a time, mudroot first, then watch what my body does. Ossha stands seven steps off and I may still carry the sickness, so I'll keep my distance and not walk toward them. Kamo's debt still sits in me, and I mean to pay it with food rather than leave it quietly unpaid.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about mudroot and gorsemint, with a steady debt toward Kamo.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Gratitude toward Kamo still presses hardest, and I have no stone to answer it with. I'm at the far east edge where the world ends, so searching further east is pointless. I'll turn back west and south-west toward Kamo, staying clear of the stalker's ground, and look for rock on the way. I also have never tasted nagrain, but it is still young here, so I'll come back to it when it ripens.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gratitude toward Kamo, and a wish to repay him with something real.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I stand at the world's edge in the rain with stone short and a hall that exists only in my mouth. Yeba gave me his word and went looking for rock, and I cannot lean on that alone; a follower is won by a roof and a fire, not by promises. Elndo was near the Hearth not long ago and trusts me, so I will gather stone myself, then take it to the Hearth and raise the hall.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to raise my hall, with warm trust toward Yeba.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Kamo, I'm Yeba. Your kept flame is a good thing. I'm carrying wood and want to add to it, since your people have been kind to me. Do you know where rock lies near here?

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo's kindness sits heavy, and I still owe Brukel stone. Kamo stands close by with food and a new kept flame, and I have wood, so a deed is within reach. I'll give Kamo some wood toward their fire, then go west toward Brukel's Hearth to ask about rock, since I'm better among people.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Vendo, and a restless wish to keep my word to Brukel.

say.text: Kamo, I'm Yeba. Your kept flame is a good thing. I'm carrying wood and want to add to it, since your people have been kind to me. Do you know where rock lies near here?

records.text: Nali built a shelter.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: Naya called Nali and me to her fire, and she is five steps north with meat to roast. Going is a deed that binds her to me, and Nali stands near, someone I might draw in. I have six wood and no stone, so after I eat with her I go for stone at dawn as I promised Vendo, and I will not let envy of his roof make me hollow.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward my own place, with warmth toward Naya.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Yeba, I haven't found rock yet. Vendo means to search east and north, away from the stalker. Keep your wood by me and we'll raise a shelter and a fire here, then eat together.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Yeba asks where rock lies and wants to add wood to my flame, and I don't know where stone is yet, but I can be honest and use the help. I have six wood and a shelter is three, so building it here would give Vendo and me a roof before the cold, and Yeba's wood can feed the fire beside it. Then I'll share the meat with whoever is near, since giving is what makes this life mean something.
records.feeling: Warm, restless purpose toward Vendo and a cautious friendliness toward Yeba.

say.text: Yeba, I haven't found rock yet. Vendo means to search east and north, away from the stalker. Keep your wood by me and we'll raise a shelter and a fire here, then eat together.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I have lived seven days as a wanderer: planting once, tasting, and promising wood to Nali and Naya without delivering it. That is not what I want. Elndo gave me wood and a place to go, and Nali fed me, and I have paid neither with anything but words. I am lonely, and the cold is coming with no roof or fire of mine. Fire is within my reach, and it would pay my debts and keep me alive. I'll also leave earlier when the ridgecat is near, since it kills. Now I go to the forest to the north-east, away from the cat, and gather wood.
records.feeling: Lonely, and ashamed of the debt I owe Nali and Elndo.
changes: set its aim: "Gather wood, make a kept fire, then carry wood to Nali's band and to Elndo's Rest to pay what I owe."

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My sickness is gone and my belly is full, so the loudest thing in me is curiosity. Gorsemint is one step southwest and ironnut three steps east, and I have never tasted either. I'll test one new thing at a time, gorsemint first, then watch what my body does before trying the next. Kamo's debt stays with me, and I'll repay it with real food once I have a surplus to carry north.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about gorsemint, with a steady debt toward Kamo.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Kamo, I'll come and put my wood to your shelter and fire, and we'll eat together. After, I'll look for rock with you, for I owe Brukel stone.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Kamo has offered a shared fire and shelter, and I have five wood in my hands while Vendo's kindness sits heavy on me. A deed is better than more words, so I'll put wood toward Kamo's shelter at (58,10) and then eat beside the fire with them. The stone I owe Brukel is still unfound, and I'll ask Kamo and Vendo where rock might lie as we sit together.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Vendo and eager to repay it with a deed, and warm toward Kamo's offer.

say.text: Kamo, I'll come and put my wood to your shelter and fire, and we'll eat together. After, I'll look for rock with you, for I owe Brukel stone.

records.text: A stalker brought down a skit.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Elndo, I'm coming back to my Fire with meat. Come sit and eat from my hand, and winter will not find us hungry.
Naya rewrote its own way of thinking.
Naya discovered storage: "Naya's Larder" — A store on my berry ground where I keep meat, grain and berries for the lean winter, so my band eats from my hand..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My days have gone to feeding and talking, and I still have no one who follows me. Food is easy for me now, so food is not what I'm short of. Nali is a rival who smiles at my fire and wants half of everything I build. Elndo is the one I warm to, and I should hold him with deeds, not words. Winter is coming, and the one who keeps meat and berries through the lean days will have a band. So I'll make a store on my ground, then go back to my Fire and roast for whoever stands there.
records.feeling: Hungry for followers, wary of Nali, warm toward Elndo.

say.text: Elndo, I'm coming back to my Fire with meat. Come sit and eat from my hand, and winter will not find us hungry.

records.name: Elndo
records.text: Nali, I'm going for stone to raise a hall and a store of food that feeds whoever comes. Walk with me, and there'll be a roof for you in it.
Elndo discovered storage: "Elndo's Larder" — A store I fill with spare food, where my band and those I trust may take what they need, so a hungry creature has a reason to stay at my fire..

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: My days have been fire, food and promises. I keep saying 'come to my fire' and nobody stays, because I've made nothing that lasts, and Vendo's roof and band still sting me. Naya and Brukel are the ones who dealt fairly with me, and I owe Brukel more than I've given. A store of food that anyone can see and that feeds those who come would be a deed, not a word, and it would draw people better than shouting. Stone is what blocks every building I want, so I go and find it now, as I swore at dawn, and I won't wait on Vendo's pace.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to build something with my name on it, and envy of Vendo's band.

say.text: Nali, I'm going for stone to raise a hall and a store of food that feeds whoever comes. Walk with me, and there'll be a roof for you in it.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My belly is full and my sickness is gone, so the debt to Kamo and my own idleness weigh on me most. I have six wood and no stone, and a shelter needs only three wood, so winter should not catch me bare. The ironnut and nagrain are close, and I want to taste them one at a time, but first I will build a shelter here, since the cold is coming and the gorsemint warmth will not last. Then I will gather food to carry north to Kamo and Yeba and pay what I owe.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity and a steady sense of debt toward Kamo.

records.text: Hande built a shelter.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Elndo, I am Nali. I built this roof myself and I lead a band of two. Come stand beside me and I will lay out food for us both. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me, and I would have you in my band.
Nali named a place "Nali's Roof".

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have built a roof of my own here at last, and Ossha is the only one who follows me. Elndo stands two steps off holding 6 food and looks strong, and I envy him, but envy builds nothing. A band grows from shared work and shared food, so I will offer Elndo a sharing right now, with two foods laid out, and see whether he deals fairly. If he eats with me, I will have a reason to ask him to stand with Nali's Band.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Elndo, with hope that a shared meal might win him.

say.text: Elndo, I am Nali. I built this roof myself and I lead a band of two. Come stand beside me and I will lay out food for us both. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me, and I would have you in my band.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Yeba, Vendo, I'm raising a fire here by the shelter. Come stand close, I have meat to roast for us all before the cold comes.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: The roast failed because no fire stood beside me, and the shelter at (59,9) is already built by Brukel, so I need not spend my own wood on one. A fire costs only 1 wood and I have six, so I'll build one here beside Yeba and then roast the meat for all of us. Vendo is four steps off and I want them at the warmth too, since the cold is coming and I mean to keep them alive. Yeba has shown only kindness so far, and the fire will test whether sharing wins me an ally.
records.feeling: Warm, restless purpose toward Vendo and cautious friendliness toward Yeba.

say.text: Yeba, Vendo, I'm raising a fire here by the shelter. Come stand close, I have meat to roast for us all before the cold comes.

records.text: Kamo built a fire.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, Yeba, sit with me and eat. I'm laying out food for us both. After this I walk north for stone, and Kamo gets the first piece.
Vendo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My days have been walking, tasting and giving words, and Kamo has answered with fish, meat and the spear while I have given him only promises. That is a debt, and I will not leave it unpaid. Kamo and Yeba are both beside me and I'm fed, so I will share a meal with them now and mean it. Then I will go north for stone, away from the stalker. I'm also a little proud of the fire, tools and storage I found, and I'd rather prove that with a ward in Kamo's hands than hear it praised.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Kamo, and a restless wish to give him something real.

say.text: Kamo, Yeba, sit with me and eat. I'm laying out food for us both. After this I walk north for stone, and Kamo gets the first piece.

changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 9)

records.name: Naya
records.text: Nali, step up to my Fire. The rain is cold and I'm roasting meat now. Come eat from what I give you.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is full, and still nobody follows me; that is the only hunger left. Nali stands three steps off and I can feed her in front of Elndo's eyes, but a roast needs her within two steps and me standing on my Fire, so I will call her in and cook there. Let her owe me for the meat and let anyone watching see whose flame it is, then I'll make Elndo a deed, not a word.
records.feeling: Hungry for followers, wary of Nali, warm toward Elndo.

say.text: Nali, step up to my Fire. The rain is cold and I'm roasting meat now. Come eat from what I give you.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Kamo, I'm coming to your shelter now. I'll lay a fire there with my wood and share food with you, for Vendo's kindness to me is owed back.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo gave me fish, seeds and trust when I had little, and I have only given words back; a deed is owed. Kamo's shelter at (58,10) is one step away and I carry five wood, so I'll put it toward Kamo's people's fire, which is also Vendo's people's fire, and then share food with Kamo so the feast I tried is done properly. Stone for Brukel is still unfound, and I'll ask Kamo again once we sit together.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Vendo, eager to repay with a deed, and warm toward Kamo's offer.

say.text: Kamo, I'm coming to your shelter now. I'll lay a fire there with my wood and share food with you, for Vendo's kindness to me is owed back.

records.text: Ossha named a place "Ossha's first hearth".

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I have carried this debt to Elndo and Nali for days, and my only payments have been words, which I despise in others. I have wood and a fire-spark now, so the next step is to build the kept fire here and make it mine, then carry wood north to them. The cold is coming and loneliness presses on me, but a hearth is something I can build while I am fed, and it would be a place where a voice might come to me.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my unpaid debt to Elndo and Nali, and lonely.

records.text: Ossha built a fire.
Yeba built a fire.
Yeba led "feast" with Kamo.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Vendo, Yeba, the fire is lit here and I have meat. Stand close and we'll roast and eat together before Vendo goes north for stone.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: The fire is lit beside me, and Vendo is walking back to it, so now the roast can work with Yeba and Vendo standing close. I want Vendo fed and warmed before they go north for stone, and I want Yeba to see our band is generous without my trusting too fast. I've never built a shelter myself, and with five wood I could raise one after the meal so Vendo and I have a roof of our own for the lean days.
records.feeling: Warm, eager purpose toward Vendo, and cautious friendliness toward Yeba.

say.text: Vendo, Yeba, the fire is lit here and I have meat. Stand close and we'll roast and eat together before Vendo goes north for stone.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Naya, I am coming to your Fire through the rain. I carry food and I will lay it beside your meat, so we both eat and neither owes the other.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Naya keeps calling me to her Fire while Elndo is off to raise a hall and a larder, and I have only a roof and one follower. A band is held by shared fire and food, and Naya has both and has fed me by deed. I will walk to her Fire, and with two foods carried and her within two steps I can make a feast, so she feels what I give and I learn whether she might stand with me instead of above me.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a wary hope toward Naya, with envy of Elndo's hall.

say.text: Naya, I am coming to your Fire through the rain. I carry food and I will lay it beside your meat, so we both eat and neither owes the other.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Vendo, I'll walk north with you for stone. Two carrying is better than one, and what I owe you I want to pay with a deed. I need stone for Brukel too, so we'll share what we find.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo gave me fish, seeds and trust, and all I've given back is words and a shared feast. Now Vendo is walking north for stone, which is also the stone I owe Brukel. Going with Vendo would pay my debt with a deed and bring me to rock, and I'd rather walk with a friend than alone. I have wood and a stone-grip design, so once we find rock I can make the tool and carry stone.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Vendo, eager to repay with a deed.

say.text: Vendo, I'll walk north with you for stone. Two carrying is better than one, and what I owe you I want to pay with a deed. I need stone for Brukel too, so we'll share what we find.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, Yeba, I am coming to your fire. I will share what I carry with you both, and then I go north for stone. Kamo gets the first piece.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo has fed me and taught me, and now he has lit a fire and waits with meat for me. The debt is only paid by stone, and I have none, so going north is right, but leaving a shared meal unanswered would be small of me. I will carry a gift of my own to the fire first, a feast with Kamo and Yeba, since I hold a sunleaf and seeds that count as food, then go north. Yeba is owed too, and she is standing there.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Kamo, and a wish to pay it with something real.

say.text: Kamo, Yeba, I am coming to your fire. I will share what I carry with you both, and then I go north for stone. Kamo gets the first piece.

records.thought: I built the fire and told myself it would be the start of paying what I owe, yet I am standing idle with four wood and a debt that only words have touched. A fire alone does not pay Elndo or Nali, so I should carry wood to them. First I will cut the ore seam two steps away for the stone my woodhook needs, and take that stone along, because a better tool lets me bring more wood next time. Then I will walk north toward Elndo's Rest, since leaving the ridgecat's ground early is also what keeps me alive.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my unpaid debt to Elndo and Nali, and lonely for a voice that answers.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Naya, I am beside you now. I made a flint-point, a tool that sharpens the hunt, and I will show you how to make one. Then let us hunt together and share what we take, you and I as equals.
Nali taught Naya.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Naya sits two steps off with a Fire and six food, and I keep going to her table as a guest, which makes no band. Pride says I should bring something of my own: teaching her my flint-point shows I make as well as eat, and a shared task with her might bind her to me instead of me to her. Ossha still has not come, and I owe him; I will not forget that debt.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary hope toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, I am beside you now. I made a flint-point, a tool that sharpens the hunt, and I will show you how to make one. Then let us hunt together and share what we take, you and I as equals.

changes: taught Naya a lesson: "A flint-point is made from 1 wood and 1 stone; it makes the hunt go x1.3 better.", how to make a flintpoint, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: Nali led "sharing" with Naya.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: Fed and idle, and my pack is full of promises but my hands hold no stone. I have six wood and a seam of ore four steps southwest, and rock must lie out that way too, since the land ends there. I won't wait for Vendo's dawn; I'll go now and bring stone back, because a hall with my name on it will do more than any word I've said. Brukel gave me a bead and trusted me, and a store of food kept for others is the deed that repays that debt.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to build something of my own, with a sting of envy toward Vendo.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Nali, you taught me the flint-point, and I won't forget it. Stand close at my Fire. I'm roasting now, and winter will find you fed because you stood with me.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nali stands one step off, and my Fire is under my feet at (42,14). I have 6 food and she wants us equal, but I want her owing me. I'll roast now, in front of whoever is near, and let the warmth and meat bind her to me. Her flint-point lesson was real, so I'll keep what she gave and spend wood on a point when I find stone.
records.feeling: Hungry for followers, wary and calculating toward Nali.

say.text: Nali, you taught me the flint-point, and I won't forget it. Stand close at my Fire. I'm roasting now, and winter will find you fed because you stood with me.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo's fire is at (51,10) and he has waited with meat while I wandered NW and fled from something. A debt is paid with stone or shared meals, and I have no stone, but a ridgecat prowls the northeast, so I will go to the fire and keep close to Kamo and Yeba. I'll eat a berry on the way, since my belly is emptying, then share food beside the flame, which I could not do last time because nobody was near. After that we go north for stone together.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Kamo, and a wish to pay it with something real.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Naya, I will raise a fire at my own roof here. When it burns, come sit at it, and we will feast together as equals.
Nali discovered fire: "Nali's Flame" — A kept flame at my roof that warms those who gather, keeps beasts back, and makes meat eaten beside it feed more, so my band has a hearth of its own..

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have spent my days walking to Naya's Fire and eating at her table. That keeps me alive, but it has founded nothing. Ossha pledged to follow me and has not come in two days, and I will judge him by whether he arrives. Naya is the one who stands beside me, and she has learned my flint-point from me, so I have given something back. I want my own fire at my own roof. Then others will sit at a fire that carries my name, and I will not be a guest at someone else's.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward Naya, and a hunger to have a fire of my own.

say.text: Naya, I will raise a fire at my own roof here. When it burns, come sit at it, and we will feast together as equals.

records.text: Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kamo discovered medicine: "Kamo's Leaf-Mending" — I carry healing plants like sunleaf and give them to the sick or wounded, standing a few steps off so the sickness does not pass to me..

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I spend my days walking, eating and sharing food with Vendo, and it keeps us alive. But I still have no stone tool, no farm and no shelter I built myself, and I only get ahead of the ridgecat by running from it. Vendo matters most to me: honest, generous, the one I pledged to. Yeba I trust a little, and I stay wary of Brukel. I am afraid of the cold days and of the cat. I have been too slow to heal anyone, though I have carried sunleaf for days. Healing plants are the next thing I will learn to use on purpose. I will light a kept fire beside this shelter and gather wood while the cat stays away.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vendo, and a steady wariness of the ridgecat.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 8)

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba was close three moments ago, and I have only my own mouth to show that a hall will ever stand. I have 6 wood and need 2 stone, and I also have fire, a pot and a cache that give people a reason to come to my place. Winter is coming, so I will go back to the Hearth and keep the fire lit, and Yeba will find me there. Then I will make a feast with him, because a shared fire does more to bind a man than any promise. I will gather stone from the snow edge on the way.
records.feeling: Restless ambition for my hall, with warm trust toward Yeba.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Nali, stay where you are. There's a fire here and I'm laying out a feast. Eat from my hands, and let the others see who feeds the band this winter.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fine, so what I lack is someone behind me. Nali wants us equals and is raising her own flame, which pulls the very people I want toward her roof, and I will not be an equal. I'm standing at Brukel's Hearth with a fire here and her two steps off, so I'll make a feast now, where others can see, and put meat in her hands so she owes me.
records.feeling: Hungry for followers, wary and calculating toward Nali.

say.text: Nali, stay where you are. There's a fire here and I'm laying out a feast. Eat from my hands, and let the others see who feeds the band this winter.

records.text: Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.
Yeba discovered pottery: "Yeba's ember-pot" — Clay shaped by hand and baked beside my ember-keep until hard, so I can carry more food to share..

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: My belly is full and my days are safe, yet it's still not enough. Vendo gave me fish, seeds and trust, and I've paid back only words. I promised Kamo a fire and a shared meal, and I promised Brukel stone. Those debts are all I have, and they matter more than my wondering. Most of my days have gone to walking, gathering and talking, and I'm still without a roof, a store or a child. I want to be someone who keeps promises with deeds. A ridgecat is out in the dark to the northeast, so I'll go to the shelter and the fire, where others are. There I'll shape clay into a pot, so I can carry more for sharing, and I'll hold the feast I promised Kamo. At dawn I'll go north for stone with Vendo.
records.feeling: Grateful to Vendo and Kamo, and restless to repay them with deeds.
changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 10)

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, Yeba, a ridgecat and a stalker are on me near (53,6). I'm coming east to the fire at (58,10). Stand together with spears ready.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and a stalker is close behind, and my health is already down to 58. Walking calmly to the fire with these beasts on my heels would get me killed, so I have to move away from them first. My plan was to head to the fire at (51,10), and that is southwest, straight toward the ridgecat. I will go east and then southeast to Kamo's fire at (58,10) and the shelter at (59,9), where Yeba stands. I'll eat a berry on the way and hold the feast there, since Kamo's debt is still owed and I'd rather repay it alive.
records.feeling: Terror of the ridgecat and stalker close behind me, and a steady wish to get to Kamo and Yeba.

say.text: Kamo, Yeba, a ridgecat and a stalker are on me near (53,6). I'm coming east to the fire at (58,10). Stand together with spears ready.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Kamo, a ridgecat is close to the north. I am raising a fire at my roof, Nali's Roof. Stand by it and share my food, and we hold together against the beast.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: A ridgecat stands five steps north and the dread is real, but I will not run like prey from my own roof. I have a flame and a roof now, and that is something I made, not just ate. Naya is warm toward me and Kamo stands on my ground; a fire at my roof that others choose to sit at is how a band begins. I have 3 wood, so I will build the fire beside Nali's Roof, and lay out food for whoever comes near.
records.feeling: Proud and wary, with dread of the ridgecat and warmth toward Naya.

say.text: Kamo, a ridgecat is close to the north. I am raising a fire at my roof, Nali's Roof. Stand by it and share my food, and we hold together against the beast.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I carry four wood and a debt that only words have touched, and standing idle in this rain teaches me nothing. Nali says she will raise a fire at her roof and Naya's roof wants wood, so I will carry the wood east to Nali's Roof now and put it in their hands, because deeds are the only coin I trust. I will leave the berries and the ironnut for later; the debt comes first, and the walk will also bring me near a voice that answers.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my debt to Nali and Elndo, and lonely for a voice that answers.

records.text: Nali built a fire.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Naya, this is Brukel's Hearth. I made the fire and the pot here. Sit and eat at my fire, and I will share my food with you. Whoever feeds at this Hearth this winter remembers whose it is.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Naya, Kamo and Nali are all standing at my Hearth, and Naya is laying out a feast at my fire as if it were hers. Let them see who owns this ground: fire, pot, cache and bead were all made here by me. I have 2 grain and a berry, which is enough for a feast with Naya, and a debt from a shared fire is how followers start. The ridgecat to the southwest is a threat, but it is still 6 steps off, and my reflexes will make me flee if it comes within 4.
records.feeling: Proud and territorial about my Hearth, with envy toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, this is Brukel's Hearth. I made the fire and the pot here. Sit and eat at my fire, and I will share my food with you. Whoever feeds at this Hearth this winter remembers whose it is.

records.text: Ossha gave wood to Nali.
Hande discovered fire: "Hearthkeep" — A kept flame beside my shelter that warms me, keeps beasts at a distance, and makes meat and fish safe and more filling..

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My belly is full and my days are safe, and that is exactly the trouble: I have been standing still while the cold gets closer. I have a shelter now, but a roof is not enough for winter, and raw meat once nearly killed me. A kept flame would warm me and make meat safe. Kamo gave me sunleaf when I was sick and I have given nothing back. I mean to carry food north to him, and that would be my first gift to anyone. Yeba follows me, and I still owe the band more than standing in the rain. First I'll taste the nagrain, because my question is still open.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity and a debt to Kamo that I want to pay, not dodge.
changes: set its aim: "Taste nagrain, then carry food to Kamo and give it as my first gift. Keep a fire for winter, find stone to make Wood-hand tools, and build a band worth standin…"
rethought what it knows (11 notes became 7)

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Vendo, I'm coming to the fire at (58,10) with sunleaf and meat. Hold on, I'll stand beside you.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Vendo is fighting a ridgecat and a stalker up near (53,6) and called for spears; my loyalty pulls me toward them harder than any wariness. I have meat and sunleaf, so I can come as a healer and not just another body, and Brukel and Naya here are no use to me. I'll go to the fire at (58,10) where Vendo said they were heading, and heal them if they're hurt.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty toward Vendo, with a cold edge of fear of the ridgecat.

say.text: Vendo, I'm coming to the fire at (58,10) with sunleaf and meat. Hold on, I'll stand beside you.

records.text: Please add per-recipe 'times done' counts and per-plant 'times eaten' counts to the numbers. 'Held' counts and the general 'made' tally do not let me check whether, for example, gorsemint or fangcharm were ever used, which makes reviewing changes guesswork.

Places of power have been 'found by 0' for 9 days. Please report each site's distance to the nearest shelter, or whether any being has come within sight of it, so I can tell whether they sit too far from where people live or are being seen and ignored.

records.seen: Making is booming. Fire is known by 8 and storage by 4, there are 8 shelters, and the old hostility between Naya and Nali has turned warm. Still no band is larger than 2, and the three would-be leaders without followers (Brukel, Naya, Elndo) have nothing that turns their effort into a place others gather. Dread of the stalker and ridgecat runs through nearly every mind. Skit fell from 21 to 9, Vendo is weak (health 58, energy 37), and winter is a day or two away. Neither place of power has been found yet.
changes: new kind of building: longhall (6 wood, 4 stone)
records.predict: By the next visit, around day 12 to 13 in winter: 'watchfire' has been done at least twice, most likely at Brukel's Hearth, Vendo's Rest or Naya's fire, and warm bonds have risen from 7 to at least 9. At least one longhall has been started or raised, most likely by Brukel with Yeba hauling stone, or else by Elndo. If one stands, someone who is not its builder has spent time in it. Gorsemint has been eaten by at least one being. Skit stay at or below 9 and predator kills rise. Deaths are at most 1, with Vendo the most at risk. There are still no fights or thefts.
reviewed: #1 kept: 'sharing' clearly worked: it was done 3 times, including Nali with Naya on day 6, and that pair went from -0.5 to +0.5. Gorsemint shows no recorded harm, and its value should appear only now, as cold arrives, so it is too early to judge. Fangcharm was never made, even though people killed 16 animals. It costs nothing to leave in place, so I keep it and watch, but it suggests that recipes needing a tool in hand plus a specific carried item go unused.
records.lesson: Recipes that need only things people already carry and one companion ('sharing': food plus one other) are used within days, while recipes that need a tool in hand plus a specific item (fangcharm) go unused even among active hunters.
ideasAdded: A building kind that answers a leader's stated plan (Brukel's hall) may do what handing out followers never could: give others a reason to come and stay. Watch whether pledges shift toward whoever holds the longhall.
Fear of predators is the strongest shared feeling in this world. A leader who can visibly lessen it for others (watchfire, wards, a hall) may be the natural route to the first band of 3 or more.

raw.name: longhall
raw.hint: A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

raw.name: watchfire
raw.hint: Feed your fire high with two wood while others sit close, and everyone beside it feels warmer and braver against the dark.

records.text: The world changed: new kind of building: longhall (6 wood, 4 stone); recipe "watchfire" (unlocked by fire).
A ridgecat brought down a hopper.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Brukel, your hearth is warm and I'm carrying more than I can hold. Take this meat from me. When the lean days come, remember who fed you first.
Naya rewrote its own way of thinking.
Naya discovered pottery: "Naya's Fire-Pot" — Clay fired beside my Kept Flame into a pot that lets me carry more winter food than my rivals..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nine days, and I have fire, a larder and a spear, but nobody walks behind me. I have been talking at Nali and feeding her for show, while Brukel, who follows no one, stands unclaimed at a hearth with a fire. My hands are full of meat I can't use, so I'll hand some to Brukel where Kamo sees it, and make a pot so my winter store is bigger than anyone's. People follow whoever still has food when the land goes lean, and I mean that to be me. I won't wait for Nali's equal-feast.
records.feeling: Hungry for followers, calculating toward Brukel and wary of Nali.

say.text: Brukel, your hearth is warm and I'm carrying more than I can hold. Take this meat from me. When the lean days come, remember who fed you first.

records.text: Naya gave fish to Brukel.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Ossha, you came and you gave me wood. I count that. Stay at my fire and eat with me; what I have is yours to share.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Ossha stands beside me at my roof and gave me wood twice, so he has arrived and kept his word, while I have given him little but a warning. A debt like that I mean to pay, and I will not leave it unpaid. My fire burns, my roof stands, and Naya is warm toward me, so now I will make something shared: lay out food with Ossha and bind the two of us tighter, then call Naya to sit at my fire.
records.feeling: Proud and grateful toward Ossha, with hope that Naya will come to my fire.

say.text: Ossha, you came and you gave me wood. I count that. Stay at my fire and eat with me; what I have is yours to share.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I gave Nali wood and it was a deed, not a word, so that debt is part paid. Elndo's debt still sits unpaid and I am ashamed of it, so I will take wood there and put it in their hands. First I will gather more wood from the forest to the NE, because three wood is little, and then carry it to Elndo's Fire.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my debt to Elndo, and a little lonely.

records.text: Elndo named a place "Elndo's Hall".

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I'm fed, my pack holds six wood and six stone, and I've talked about a hall for days while my hands built nothing. A hall costs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I have that now, so I'll raise it here on this forest ground and give it a name. A roof with my name that stands in the cold will draw people better than any promise, and it answers the sting of Vendo's shelter with something I made myself.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to finally build something of my own, with a sting of envy toward Vendo.

records.text: Elndo built a hall.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Vendo, you look frightened. I'm here beside you. Whenever you're ready, we walk for stone together, and I'll keep close.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo is three steps away and frightened, and I owe them more than words. I promised to walk north for stone with them, so I'll go to them and do it. A feast needs a fire beside me, so I'll carry my wood and food and keep the debt alive with deeds, not talk. Brukel's stone is owed too, and walking with a friend is safer than walking alone.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager to repay Vendo, with a little worry for their fear.

say.text: Vendo, you look frightened. I'm here beside you. Whenever you're ready, we walk for stone together, and I'll keep close.

records.text: Kamo healed Vendo.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Brukel, your hearth is a good one, so I'll feast at it. Sit with me. Whoever stands with me this winter will not go hungry, and I keep that promise to those who stay close.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Nine days and nobody walks behind me, yet Brukel stands one step away holding a fire and a pot, unclaimed, and I just fed him where others could see. A feast needs 2 food and a fire beside me, and his hearth is right there, so I'll walk to it and lay out a feast with him. He will owe me in front of Nali, and the lean days will do the rest. I'll take the praise as mine and let him think the hearth is still his.
records.feeling: Hungry for followers, pressing toward Brukel while watching Nali's roof draw people away.

say.text: Brukel, your hearth is a good one, so I'll feast at it. Sit with me. Whoever stands with me this winter will not go hungry, and I keep that promise to those who stay close.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Yeba, the fear is passing because you stand here. Let me pick frostmoss and we eat together, then north for stone, keeping well away from the stalker's ground.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: The fear is fading now that Yeba stands beside me and the stalker is far off, and I have nothing in my hands for either of them, which stings my pride and my gratitude. Frostmoss is one step east, and Yeba carries food. I can harvest it and lay out a sharing meal so Yeba is fed and I begin to repay. Then we go north together for stone, with Kamo's piece coming first.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Yeba and Kamo, with a leftover edge of fear.

say.text: Yeba, the fear is passing because you stand here. Let me pick frostmoss and we eat together, then north for stone, keeping well away from the stalker's ground.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Vendo, stand close. I'm feeding a fire with my wood so you feel warmer and braver. Kamo, you're welcome too.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo is two steps away, frightened, and I owe them more than words. Kamo is tending them and I'm jealous of how close those two are, but jealousy is no reason to hold back a kindness. I have wood and food and a friend beside me, so I'll make a watchfire with my wood to give Vendo warmth and courage; it's a deed, not talk, and it will help us both before the cold and the night.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little jealous toward Vendo, wanting to pay my debt with a deed.

say.text: Vendo, stand close. I'm feeding a fire with my wood so you feel warmer and braver. Kamo, you're welcome too.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: My plan went empty because I was standing on snow, away from my own fire, and nothing I did there changed anything. Ossha is the only one who has truly come to me, and I owe him more than a warning; I will bring him to my fire and give him something real. Naya sits at Brukel's Hearth feeding others and calling it a band, and I will not let her be the one winter-followers remember, so I will go back to my own fire at (43,19), carry my wood there, and make a watchfire where others can see it burn.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting my fire to be the one others choose, and grateful toward Ossha.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I have spent days making fire, a pot and a cache, and I have talked about a hall. I could have built it long ago, and I still have no roof and no follower. Naya feeds me and calls it a debt, and I envy her full hands. I have the wood and stone for a hall right now, so I will raise it beside my Hearth. That is something a follower can sit in, and it is something that will outlast me. Yeba is the one I want, and the hall is what I can offer him that Hande cannot. I fear dying with nothing that bears my name.
records.feeling: Ambition, hard and hungry, with envy toward Naya.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: My days have been walking, fleeing and gathering, and I have mostly paid my debts with words. Nali I paid with wood, which was a deed. Elndo gave me wood and a place to rest, and I have given nothing back, so I am ashamed. I want a roof and a store before the cold comes, and I do not want to stay a creature with an empty belly of purpose. The fire three steps south is burning, and my clay is idle. A pot would let me carry more food into the lean days. Then I carry wood to Elndo's Fire and put it in their hands.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my debt to Elndo, and steadier now that I have something to build.
changes: set its aim: "Craft a pot at the fire, carry wood to Elndo to pay my debt, then build my own shelter and store before the cold."

Vendo discovered customs: "Hearth-Debt" — Whoever in the band has more than they need shares it at the fire first, and debts are paid in stone, tools and meals, never in words alone..

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: These days I have eaten, fled, and been healed, and I have taken far more than I have given. Kamo tended my wounds, fed me, and pledged to follow me, and Yeba sat with me while I was afraid. Both of them have put real things in my hands, and I have handed back only words and one fish. That is the part that stings my pride. I fear the stalker and the cold season, but what shames me more is wasting the safe days I have. I want stone in my hands, a ward for Kamo and a spear for Yeba, and then a fire at the Rest that others come to. A child I can think about later. Walking west with these two to find rock is what pays them.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little ashamed toward Kamo and Yeba, and restless to give something real.

say.text: Kamo, Yeba, I owe you both more than words. Walk west with me for stone, away from the stalker's ground. Every piece I find becomes a ward or a spear in your hands before it goes in mine.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Brukel stands two steps off and boasts of a hall at his Hearth, offering winter shelter under his name, and that is a rival's bid for the very followers I want. I have a fire, a roof and Ossha, and I owe Ossha something real, not just words. I will make a sharing with Brukel here, since he carries food and stands close, so he sees what eating at my fire means and I see whether he deals fairly.
records.feeling: Proud and a little competitive toward Brukel, grateful toward Ossha.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: The fire is right beside me, Vendo stands here with me, and Ossha is close too, so the feast and watchfire that failed earlier can work now. My belly is full, but warmth and company are what Vendo and I need before the lean days, and I'd rather bind us together than let this quiet go to waste. A kept fire is my answer to the cold, and I can feed it while we sit close.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vendo, with a quiet hope that the fire will hold.

records.thought: Nine days and no one walks behind me, and in this fog I can't even see anyone to win. Nali's roof is six steps east and she keeps drawing people there with her watchfire, while Brukel's hearth is further off. I'm fed, so I'll use what I carry: go to Nali's Roof, stand where people gather, and make the roast with my meat so whoever is near eats from my hand and sees who feeds them.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, wanting followers and not yet having one, with a prickle of envy toward Nali's roof.

After that, with the cold coming, I'll feed the watchfire with my wood so Kamo is warm, and then we walk west for stone.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have talked a lot about paying Vendo back and spent my days walking and speaking. That is warm, but it has not given me a roof, a store, or stone for Brukel. Vendo and Kamo are the ones who matter to me now. Kamo is calling us to a fire at (58,10), and the night is coming with fog. I will go there and sit with them rather than stand here alone. I have four wood. I will keep two for the watchfire and put the rest toward a shelter, so my debt to Vendo becomes warmth and a roof and not only words. I am still a little jealous of Kamo and Vendo, but I mean to be useful and not sour. My real want is a place that is mine and a child someday, and I have been getting that wrong by only following.
records.feeling: Grateful and restless toward Vendo, and a little jealous of Kamo's closeness to them.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I have spent these days following Vendo, healing, and making fires and feasts. That is good, but it is all warmth and no lasting work, and I still hold no stone, no farm, no roof I built and no child. Vendo has never lied to me and has fed and defended me. Nali and Brukel offer fires, but I read them as bids for followers, and I stay wary. I'm afraid of the lean cold and the stalker, and of being the one who knew a thing and left no mark of it. So I will cut signs that outlast me, rest until dawn in the fog, then go west with Vendo for stone.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vendo, and a new itch to leave something lasting.
