records.text: Yeba, the stalker is close. Come south with me now, to my Hall's fire. I will keep you safe there and we will share food at my roof.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: A stalker prowls five steps SE and Yeba stands one step from me, so the danger is the moment to prove my worth. My hall is eight steps south, and a roof and fire guard those who gather there. I have fed Yeba and warmed him, and I will not beg him to follow. I will lead him to the Hall's fire and make a hallwelcome there. Vendo is envied, but his ore burns in my fire, so he is in my debt.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Yeba, with envy of Vendo.

say.text: Yeba, the stalker is close. Come south with me now, to my Hall's fire. I will keep you safe there and we will share food at my roof.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha is fleeing from something, six steps off, and the ridgecat is still prowling to the southwest. I fed her again and she is of Nali's Band, so a third gift with no debt will make it plain who feeds her. I will go to Elndo's Hall with four meat left, hold a hallwelcome there in front of Ossha and Elndo, and let them see me give before I speak. If Elndo owes me too, then Nali's hold on the berry ground starts to loosen.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm, wary pride toward Ossha, and a cold wish to take Elndo from Nali.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My belly is full and I've still given nothing to anyone. Kamo's sunleaf sits in me as a debt, and I despise people who say they'll repay and don't. Nali was seen near her roof not long ago, and dusk with snow is coming, so I'll carry food to her shelter. First I'll harvest berries from the ground close by, since a shared meal is something I can really give. The nagrain here is still young, so berries it is, and then I'll go toward Nali's Roof for company and for my first gift.
records.feeling: Ashamed of an unpaid debt to Kamo, and wanting to give my first gift.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Yeba, come to the fire. I made a ward of metal from my ore, and I have a spear to put in your hands for what you gave me.
Vendo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vendo discovered devices: "Hearth-post" — A post set in the ground by a fire that holds a little food and shares it with any of my band who come hungry..

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I've spent these days learning and making, and the metal ward proves Ember-iron was worth the work. But my band is only Kamo and me, and Kamo has been gone a day. I owe Yeba for his fire and his steadiness, and words don't pay a debt, so I'll put a spear in his hands. I want a child, a band that grows, and something I leave behind that lasts. I fear the stalker, and I fear letting comfort make me idle while Kamo is away.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Yeba, and a pull of missing for Kamo.

say.text: Yeba, come to the fire. I made a ward of metal from my ore, and I have a spear to put in your hands for what you gave me.

changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 11)

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My belly is at 40 and my pack is empty, and I left Vendo behind to chase berries I never gathered. The berries and ironnut are three to five steps northwest, so I eat there first, then fill my pack to carry back. Vendo is last seen at (5,33), close by, so I will go to him with food in my hands, since I owe him a ward and a spear and cannot pay with nothing.
records.feeling: Hungry and lonely, with guilt and loyalty toward Vendo.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Vendo, the stalker is east. Walk south with me to Brukel's fire. I'll feed it with my wood so we are warm.
Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: My days have been circling food, fire and fear, and I still owe Brukel stone. I have talked about stone and carried none. Vendo is the one I trust most, and Brukel has fed me twice, while Hande is far away and gives me nothing. A stalker sits east and the cold bites, so I will go south to Brukel's fire with Vendo beside me. There I'll feed the fire with my wood so we are warm and brave, which is a deed and not a promise. At dawn I go west for rock and make my grip, because envy of Brukel's food is only answered by what I build.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Vendo and Brukel, with dread of the stalker and cold in my bones.

say.text: Vendo, the stalker is east. Walk south with me to Brukel's fire. I'll feed it with my wood so we are warm.

changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 8)

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My body is full, the night is quiet, and Yeba is somewhere north, not here. I stand at my Hall's spot with a shelter and no hall, and ambition gnaws at me because a roof people sleep under is what makes followers, not words. I carry 6 wood and 4 stone, enough for a hall (6 wood, 2 stone), so I will raise it here now and put my name on it, then bring Yeba and Vendo into it and feed them.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to build something lasting, with warm trust toward Yeba.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, you've eaten my meat three times and never owed me a thing for it. Walk with me instead of Nali. I'm going to raise a hall of my own, and you'll have the first seat in it.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha sat with me in the hall and ate my meat, and she is warm toward me, but she still wears Nali's name. Gifts alone have not turned her yet. I will say it plainly and offer her a place at my side. Then I'll fetch wood and stone so I can raise a hall that bears my own name, because a band needs a roof that is mine and not Elndo's or Nali's.
records.feeling: Warm, wary pride toward Ossha, and hungry ambition to lead.

say.text: Ossha, you've eaten my meat three times and never owed me a thing for it. Walk with me instead of Nali. I'm going to raise a hall of my own, and you'll have the first seat in it.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Nali named a place "Nali's Edge".
Nali rewrote its own reflexes.
Nali discovered smelting: "Nali's Iron" — Craft beside Nali's Flame while carrying ore, and the tool comes out in bright hard metal..

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have spent my days making things: fire, pot, larder, and now ore in my hands. Yet I still have two in my band and no roof, so the aim is still a boast. Ossha has paid me in wood and arrival, and I owe him a roof, not words. I am cold in the snow, so I build a shelter here tonight. At dawn I will find forest for wood, then raise the fire and larder beside it and try to smelt the ore I carry.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a cold determination, with a debt toward Ossha.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a roof, fire and store at the world's edge, and bring Ossha and others to hold it as Nali's Band."

records.text: Nali built a shelter.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, you are beside me, so I pay now: wood into your hands, not just words.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Naya is standing right here with me, and she has fed me twice while I have given her only one load of wood and a promise. A debt counts only when the goods are in their hands, so I put wood in hers now, before I go looking for Elndo. I keep six wood for my own shelter and tools, so giving her some does not leave me bare.
records.feeling: Shame at the unpaid debt, and warm gratitude toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, you are beside me, so I pay now: wood into your hands, not just words.

records.text: Ossha gave wood to Naya.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Yeba, take this spear now, it is yours for your fire. Then let us go south to Brukel's Hall together, away from the stalker.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: The stalker is six steps off and Yeba stands beside me, frightened, with the same dread I carry. Brukel's Hall and its fire lie south, and Yeba is right that we should go there together instead of lingering in the open snow. I still owe Yeba the spear, so I'll put it in his hands now, then walk with him south to the Hall where it's warm and I can try my ore in the flames.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Yeba, with dread of the stalker pressing at my back.

say.text: Yeba, take this spear now, it is yours for your fire. Then let us go south to Brukel's Hall together, away from the stalker.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I'm fed, cold, and alone in the snow, and nothing I've made has drawn a single soul to me. The ore seam is four steps west and stone is my bottleneck for a hall, so I'll mine it now rather than wait for dawn, and keep my promise early. Then I'll find wood and lay the first stones of something that bears my name, so that Brukel and Naya have somewhere to come to.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and sharp loneliness, with a pang of missing Brukel.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I'm cold and alone in the snow, and the loneliness is the loudest thing in me. Vendo was last seen at (5,33), which is only about ten steps west, and I owe him food and the ward-stone I promised. My pack is empty, so I'll gather berries and ironnut right here, then walk to him with food in my hands instead of drifting off again.
records.feeling: Lonely and cold, with guilt and loyalty toward Vendo.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, you paid me in wood, and I remember it. Stand with me now and I'll lay out food for the two of us. When I raise my hall, your name goes on the first seat.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha paid me in wood, so she is closer to owing me than she has ever been, and she stands three steps north with food in her hands. I have fed her and sat with her, and now I want the others to see that she walks beside me, not Nali. I will go to her and share food so the debt gets heavier, then take the wood I hold and find stone for a hall that carries my name.
records.feeling: Warm, hungry pride toward Ossha, and ambition to lead.

say.text: Ossha, you paid me in wood, and I remember it. Stand with me now and I'll lay out food for the two of us. When I raise my hall, your name goes on the first seat.

records.text: Naya led "sharing" with Ossha.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, I thank you for the seat and the food. I go to Elndo's Hall now to pay what I owe there, and I will come back.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Naya keeps offering me food and a seat, and I have paid her in wood, so that debt is lighter, but Elndo's is still unpaid and it shames me. Elndo's Hall is nine steps west, close enough that I have no excuse. I will carry wood there now and put it in their hands, and I will eat the ironnut on the way to answer my curiosity.
records.feeling: Shame at the unpaid debt to Elndo, and warm gratitude toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, I thank you for the seat and the food. I go to Elndo's Hall now to pay what I owe there, and I will come back.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I've carried Kamo's kindness as a debt for days and given nothing, and I despise liars, so I won't become one by drifting. My belly is full, so I can make food for giving: berries lie nearby, and I still hold a seed of one. Nali's roof is three steps west, and she was seen close by not long ago. I'll gather food and take it to her, which would be my first true gift and ease this loneliness too.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my unpaid debt to Kamo, and eager to give my first gift.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a skit.
Naya named a place "Naya's Rise".

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha went to Elndo's Hall to pay what she owes there, and she said she will come back. I will not wait empty-handed. I have wood 6 and stone 6, enough for a hall, and a roof with my name on it is what makes a band more than talk. I am fed and the fog hides everyone, so this is the time to build rather than chase her.
records.feeling: Ambitious, warm pride toward Ossha, and hunger to have a hall of my own.

records.text: Naya built a hall.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Yeba, sit by me and eat. This is my food and you owe me nothing for it. The fog hides the stalker, but my fire and my roof are close.
Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and hoping, and I am still followed by no one. Words did not bring Yeba and neither did standing near him. Food shared at my fire did bring him close, and a roof I can actually finish will do more. Yeba is two steps away and frightened, and I have food in my hands. I will sit him down and feed him now, then raise a hall on bare ground, because the ground at my shelter is taken. I will not beg. I will give first and let him owe me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and warm trust toward Yeba.

say.text: Yeba, sit by me and eat. This is my food and you owe me nothing for it. The fog hides the stalker, but my fire and my roof are close.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I'm standing right beside Elndo's Hall, so the walk I promised myself is already done, and I have no excuse left. Elndo isn't in sight, and I won't pay a debt by leaving wood on the ground, so I'll go inside and wait for them, then put the wood in their hands. Naya's offer tempts me, but I owe Elndo first, and my word is good. I'll keep six wood, though, since I still need it for my own shelter.
records.feeling: Shame at the unpaid debt to Elndo, and a steady wish to settle it.

records.text: Brukel built a hall.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: My belly is emptying, and a berry bush stands right under my feet, so I eat first and stay alive. Brukel has fed me three times and wants nothing, and I still owe him stone, so I will take the berries I can carry and go sit by his fire in the fog, where the stalker is less likely to find me. When the fog lifts I will go west to the hills for stone, because I have talked about stone for days and carried none.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the stalker, but warmed by trust toward Brukel.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, I'm coming to your hall with ore and clay. I'll try them in your fire and tell you what I learn. Kamo, if you hear me, come to the Hall.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, and berries grow one step from me, so I'll eat first, as my own discipline says. Brukel is close and glad, and I owe him a fair word and what I learn from the ore. His fire is the place to try smelting my last ore, and that is how I repay him. I still miss Kamo and want to call him before the day ends, and I want Yeba to take the spear and come south with me.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel and Yeba, with a quiet ache for Kamo.

say.text: Brukel, I'm coming to your hall with ore and clay. I'll try them in your fire and tell you what I learn. Kamo, if you hear me, come to the Hall.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba stands beside me, frightened, and I hold food in my hands. Words have failed, but sharing needs only two foods and someone within two steps, and he is right here. I will lay out a meal now and let the food do what my invitations could not, then lead him to the roof I finished. Once he is fed and sheltered, I will ask him to follow me and give the band a name.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Yeba.

records.text: Brukel led "sharing" with Yeba.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Brukel has fed me again and asked nothing, and I still owe him stone; my hands are empty of it and my belly is half empty too. The fog hides the stalker and my fear sits low in my chest, but the berries are right beside me, so I take them now and keep my strength up. When I am fed I will carry wood and stone for a grip of my own, because words without deeds are the lies I despise.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Brukel, with fear of the hidden stalker still in my body.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, but berries grow two steps northeast, so I will eat there first, then carry some to Brukel's Hall as a gift, since I owe him a fair word. His fire is where I will try my last ore. I still ache for Kamo and want him at that hearth with me, so I will call again once I am fed.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel, with a quiet ache for Kamo.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba sat and ate with me and he trusts me completely, yet he still wears Hande's band, and I will not let that stand. My hall at (28,22) is roofed and Vendo is coming with ore to my fire, so I have people drawn to my place and nothing yet that is mine to hold them with. I will go back to the Hall and wait there with Yeba beside me, so that Vendo finds me at my own fire and I can give them food again, and what I give makes them owe me or stay.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Yeba.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: The loneliness is the loudest thing in me, and I keep telling myself I'll go to Vendo with food and then drift instead. He was last seen at (5,33), about ten steps northwest of here, and I owe him food and the ward-stone. The ironnut and mudroot are right here, so I'll harvest ironnut for my pack, then walk to him in the fog, because my hand has to do it, not my wishing.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and loyal guilt toward Vendo.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have a roof here at the world's edge, but no fire beside it and no store, and a band of two is still a boast. Ossha has paid me in wood and kept his word, so I will pay him in deeds: a fire and a larder beside this roof that he can sit at. I have no wood to spare, so I go to the forest to the northeast, cut enough for fire and store, and bring it back to build.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a debt toward Ossha, with a cold ache of loneliness.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Brukel's Hall".

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, my hall stands now at the Rise, with a flame and a seat cut for you. Take this meat from me first, and come eat under my roof once Elndo is paid.
Naya discovered smelting: "Naya's Red Iron" — Ore melted in my Kept Flame and worked into tools that hit harder and last three times as long..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My days have gone to feeding Ossha and talking about halls. Now I have raised one, and that is the first thing I've made that carries my name. Ossha is the only one who has paid me back, in wood. She still walks between Nali's band and my fire, and she owes Elndo as well. I've been counting debts when I should be building a hold: a roof, a flame and a full Larder that she comes back to. I'm warm with pride, and I want her under my roof and not Nali's. I also want the iron in my pack made into something no one else carries.
records.feeling: Proud, warm ambition toward Ossha, and hunger to be followed.

say.text: Ossha, my hall stands now at the Rise, with a flame and a seat cut for you. Take this meat from me first, and come eat under my roof once Elndo is paid.

changes: set its aim: "Make my hall at Naya's Rise the place Ossha and Elndo come back to for meat and warmth. Fill my Larder before winter so they follow me, not Nali."
rethought what it knows (11 notes became 10)

records.text: Naya gave meat to Ossha.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I'm standing at the far eastern edge in fog, and no voice has answered me in days. Talk and invitations haven't drawn anyone, so I'll do the thing my own rule demands: lay stone and gather wood for a hall, and let the deed speak. Rock lies to the southwest, so I'll mine stone there, then take wood from the forest to the south. A roof with food under it is what will make Brukel come back and make others stay.
records.feeling: Sharp loneliness and restless ambition, with a pang of missing Brukel.

records.text: Hande rewrote its own reflexes.
Hande rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hande discovered pottery: "Clayhold" — Fired clay pots beside Hearthkeep let me carry more food to give..

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Days have gone by and I've given nothing to anyone. I've been fed and idle, and I've let Kamo's sunleaf stay a debt. I despise people who say they'll repay and don't, and I'm close to being one of them. Yeba follows me, but I've been alone in the fog. Loneliness is the real hunger now. I'll stop lingering: gather food, carry it east toward Kamo and the fires, and give it. I'll also make my fire and my clay do more by learning to fire pots, so I can carry more gifts.
records.feeling: Ashamed of an unpaid debt to Kamo, and lonely, but eager to give.
changes: set its aim: "Carry food to Kamo and give it as my first gift, then gather my band around a fire and a roof before winter."

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I'm standing at Elndo's Hall again with wood in my pack and no Elndo in sight, and the shame of the unpaid debt hasn't eased. I won't pay it by dropping wood on the ground, and my word says into their hands, so I'll go inside the shelter and wait, then give when they come. If they stay away, I'll go look for them rather than leave the debt hanging while Naya's kind offers pile up.
records.feeling: Shame and steady resolve toward Elndo, with warm trust for Naya.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Brukel, I have no stone yet, but I will give you what I can now: my food laid out beside yours under your roof. At first light I go for stone.
Yeba taught Brukel.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Brukel sits beside me, warm and unasking, and I still owe him stone I do not have; my fear of the stalker is quieter in his Hall but not gone. I have never taught anyone, and Brukel has fed me three times, so I can give him something real now. I will make a hallwelcome with him, then go for stone at first light, with wood already in my hands.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Brukel, with a thread of fear still in me.

say.text: Brukel, I have no stone yet, but I will give you what I can now: my food laid out beside yours under your roof. At first light I go for stone.

changes: taught Brukel a lesson: "A stalker is least dangerous when many sit at one fire. Stay beside friends at night, and keep a stone and a wood ready for a ward.", how to make a stalkerward

records.text: Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I have built plenty: a flame, a pot, a cache, stonework and a hall. Yet nobody follows me, and Yeba still wears Hande's band even though he ate at my side. I have been doing what a lone maker does, and a lone maker's name dies with him. What I haven't done is give people a reason to need my roof. Vendo is coming with ore, and Yeba hovers nearby, so I will wait at the roofed Hall as the night comes. I will have food ready there and let them come to a warm place that is mine. I will not beg again. Food in the hand and a fire at night are what bind.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward a hall that is still empty, and warm trust toward Yeba.
changes: rethought what it knows (12 notes became 11)

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, I am going south to Brukel's Hall to kindle fire and try the ore. Come and meet me there.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My belly is fed and the night is quiet, and I have been idle too long. Brukel's Hall lies south, and my ore, clay and wood are waiting for his fire, so I will go and finally try the smelting I promised him. I miss Kamo and will call him again on the way, because he should be at that hearth with me.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel and a quiet ache for Kamo.

say.text: Kamo, I am going south to Brukel's Hall to kindle fire and try the ore. Come and meet me there.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I've been ashamed of this debt to Kamo for days, and I despise people who promise and never pay. My belly is full and I have a berry seed and a frostmoss plant close by, so there's no reason left to wait. I'll gather food now, carry it east to where Kamo's marks stand and Yeba's shelter is, and give it as my first gift. Maybe I'll find a voice that answers there too.
records.feeling: Ashamed of my debt to Kamo, lonely, and eager to give.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, come with me to the Rise. The flame is lit and the seat is cut, and I'll have iron beaten for you there. Elndo's fire is only borrowed warmth.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha sits beside me at Elndo's Hall, not at mine, and she is the only one who has paid me anything. I have wood and stone and a roof of my own at the Rise, but a roof with no one under it is only a shelter with my name on it. I will give her something she can carry and see, and walk her back to my fire so she eats there rather than at Elndo's or Nali's.
records.feeling: Warm, proud ambition toward Ossha, and a hunger to be followed.

say.text: Ossha, come with me to the Rise. The flame is lit and the seat is cut, and I'll have iron beaten for you there. Elndo's fire is only borrowed warmth.

records.text: Ossha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering wood, sheltering, and paying debts one at a time. That is safe, but it has taught me little about what I am for. Naya has fed me and held me close with deeds, not only words, so I trust her fully. Elndo gave me wood when I had none, and I still haven't put wood in their hands, which shames me. I fear the cold of winter and a lean store, and I fear dying with nothing made or taught. I have been wrong to wait at a hall for a debt to walk up to me. I have also never taught anyone, never left a mark, never hunted, and never tasted ironnut or bruberry. I will rest until dawn, then seek Elndo and pay them. After that I will build my own store, cut a mark, and test the ironnut and bruberry while I'm fed.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Naya, and steady shame and resolve toward Elndo.
changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 12)

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Vendo, you are welcome at my fire. Put your ore in and sit; I have food to lay out for us both under this roof. What this Hall makes, we make together, and it bears my name.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo stands at my fire with ore and two spears, and Yeba sleeps under my roof at first light he goes for stone. People come to my Hall, yet none stay because I have given them food, not a reason to bind themselves. A leader must hold the fire and the name; I will declare a band now, with the Hall as its seat, so that those who gather here have something to join. I act first: lead by making a gathering at my fire with Vendo beside me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, with warm trust toward Yeba and wary regard for Vendo.

say.text: Vendo, you are welcome at my fire. Put your ore in and sit; I have food to lay out for us both under this roof. What this Hall makes, we make together, and it bears my name.

records.text: Kamo rewrote its own reflexes.
Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I have spent days circling the same ground, full-bellied and alone, promising Vendo food and a ward and then drifting. That is the shame in me. My body stays put whenever Vendo is out of sight, so loneliness wins by default. I'm changing that. When he isn't in sight, my body will go looking for him. I'll pick berries first so I arrive with food in my hands, then walk to where I last saw him.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and guilt toward Vendo, with a first thread of resolve.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 12)

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have a roof here at the world's edge but no fire beside it and no store, and a band of two is still a boast. Wood is the first step, so I go to the forest to the NE, cut what a fire and larder need, and come back and build them here, where Ossha can sit and see what I made for him. Loneliness gnaws at me, but a debt is paid in deeds, not in calling out to an empty shore.
records.feeling: Restless pride and loneliness, with a debt toward Ossha I mean to pay in a fire and a store.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I'm full and the loneliness is the worst of it. I've owed Kamo for days and I despise people who say they'll repay and don't. Kamo's shelter is two steps west, so I'll walk to it, give my frostmoss there as my first gift, and keep seeking a voice that answers.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed of my debt, eager to give to Kamo.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Hall stands, fire is mine, and still no one follows me. I tried sharing and the hall welcome and failed because I carry one grain and nobody stood within two steps. Food in my hands first: Vendo and Yeba are near my roof, so I gather frostmoss close by, then go back and lay out a meal under my own roof. I will declare my band now, so the name exists and Yeba and Vendo have something to join.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, warm toward Yeba, wary of Vendo's spears.

records.text: Ossha found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Vendo, there is daylight left. Walk north with me for stone? I owe Brukel, and I want you beside me.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Vendo stands beside me, Brukel too, and my belly is calm; the longing for a child and for Vendo is the loudest thing in me now. I will not rush it, but I can walk the first step toward it by being honest with Vendo and staying near. First light is not yet, yet I owe Brukel stone, and daylight is still long, so I go north toward the hills for stone while the day holds, and ask Vendo to walk with me, since I am better with a friend beside me.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Vendo, with steady trust in Brukel.

say.text: Vendo, there is daylight left. Walk north with me for stone? I owe Brukel, and I want you beside me.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha stands five steps off, and Nali is close behind her with that hafted pick I want. Ossha has paid me in wood and sat at my seat, and I have not yet given her something she can carry. I will walk to her and lay out a sharing, then bring her to the Rise so the others see who feeds her. My belly is also emptying, and a sharing fills it too.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry ambition toward Ossha, with envy at Nali's pick.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, I am going to your fire to beat my ore into a ward. Stay and watch, and what I learn is yours.
Vendo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vendo discovered pottery: "Clay-keeper" — Clay fired beside a hearth becomes a pot that carries two more portions of food for long walks..

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My days have been safe and fed, and that has made me soft. I have gathered and rested, but I owe Brukel, Yeba and Kamo real gifts, and I have not paid them. Kamo is the one I ache for. I won't sit in comfort while he is away. I will take my ore to Brukel's fire now and beat it into a ward, because that is a debt paid with something they lack. Then I will fire my clay into pots so I can carry more food on the road east to find Kamo.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel and Yeba, and a steady ache for Kamo.

say.text: Brukel, I am going to your fire to beat my ore into a ward. Stay and watch, and what I learn is yours.

changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 11)

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: The Old Stone reached into me again and my fear rose; I don't understand it, but I won't flee from something that has only opened my mind. Naya is near and trusts me, and I have paid her in wood already. The debt that shames me is Elndo's, and Elndo's Hall is only 9 steps west, so I will go there now with wood in my pack and wait inside rather than standing idle. My word says into their hands, and I mean to keep it.
records.feeling: Shame and resolve toward Elndo, steady warmth toward Naya, and uneasy awe at the Old Stone.

Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: My days have gone to eating, sitting in Brukel's Hall and promising stone I don't yet carry. I have kept my word in speech more than in deeds, and that sits badly with me. Vendo and Brukel matter most: Vendo for the warmth and the longing for a child, Brukel for feeding me without asking anything back. I have never taught anyone, and I want to be more than a mouth at someone else's fire. Envy of Vendo's spear is small, but it points at what I haven't built. So I will give Vendo my stone-grip design now, which costs me nothing and is a real deed, and keep walking north for stone by daylight.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Vendo, with a quiet resolve to pay what I owe Brukel.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My days have gone to building at the Rise and courting Ossha with meat and promises, while Nali, who has given me more than I have given her, keeps the pick I want and the band I refuse to join. No one follows me yet, and a hall with no one under it is only my name on empty wood. Ossha is my one real hold, so I will stop talking at her and put something in her hands. I'm afraid winter will find my Larder empty and her at Elndo's fire. I have been spending my food on words, and I should plant my spare seeds and keep enough to make a sharing when I reach her.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Ossha, and envy toward Nali.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, I'm kindling a fire here in your Hall. Watch as I beat my ore into a ward, and then I'll fire a pot with your clay-side hearth.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I'm standing in Brukel's Hall with ore, clay and wood, and no fire beside me. I keep saying I'll smelt, but the fire is what stops me. I'll build a fire here, one wood, then beat the ore into a ward and fire a pot. The ward is meant for Kamo, and I owe Brukel the lesson. Kamo is still far west and I ache for him, but I can have the ward ready when he comes.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel, and a steady ache for Kamo.

say.text: Brukel, I'm kindling a fire here in your Hall. Watch as I beat my ore into a ward, and then I'll fire a pot with your clay-side hearth.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: A stalker prowls to the NE and my body is already running from it; hunger gnaws and my hands hold nothing to eat. Ossha is three steps away with two food, and I will not beg. I will take berries at my feet and be fed before I talk of fires, then bring Ossha to the fire I just built at the edge, and raise the larder beside it. I owe Ossha deeds, not words, and a store filled with food is the first one.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger, with a debt toward Ossha I mean to pay in a larder.

records.text: Elndo named a place "Elndo's Hall".

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I am at the far eastern edge with nobody near. Calling out to empty air has drawn no one, so I'll let a deed speak. I hold 6 wood and 6 stone, which is enough for a hall (6 wood, 2 stone). I'll raise it here on bare grass, name this place, and then plant seeds beside it to feed the farming lesson and stock a hearth for whoever comes. Vendo's band and shelter gnaw at me, so I mean to have a bigger one, and Brukel may come back to find it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and sharp loneliness, with a pang of missing Brukel.

records.text: Elndo built a hall.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Hall stands, fire is mine, and still no one binds himself to me. Vendo has spears and a band of his own, and I burn with envy, but he is coming to my fire to make things and what he makes passes through my hall. I will declare my band now so the name exists, and go to the Hall where Vendo works, so I am near when his ward is done and can show every hand that this roof is mine.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, and envy of Vendo's made things.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: The fire is what keeps stopping me, so I will build it first, here in Brukel's Hall, and then do the rest in order: beat the ore into a ward, then fire a pot. The ward is for Kamo, and what I learn at this fire I owe to Brukel. Kamo is still far west and I ache for him, but a finished ward in my hands is something I can carry to him.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel, and a steady ache for Kamo.

records.text: Vendo made: ironward.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: My hall stands at the edge of the world and still nobody has come to it. Words have gone out to Naya and Nali and drawn nothing, so I will make a deed that lasts: more stone and wood for a workshop beside the hall, since stone is my bottleneck and I keep my promise to go for stone. The ore seam to the southwest is close, so I'll gather there and test what the rock gives, then come back and mark my hall so it bears my name.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and loneliness, wanting someone to come to my hall.

records.text: Brukel, the fire is lit and the ward took. Now I'll fire a pot from clay, and you can watch how it's done and keep what I learn.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I have a fire at my feet and ore in my hands, and I already hold an ironward that eases blows on me, so the beating works and Brukel saw it. The ward I mean for Kamo must be another one, and I do not know how to make it again, which I must test rather than assume. Yeba asked me north for stone and I owe Brukel a pot from his clay, so I will fire a pot now while the fire burns and then sit with Brukel before the walk.
records.feeling: Warm purpose toward Brukel and a steady ache for Kamo.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Yeba, I'm at Brukel's fire finishing a pot and a ward for Kamo. Once they're done I'll walk north with you for stone, and what I make here is shared with Brukel.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I'm inside Brukel's Hall with a fire at my feet, my belly full and joy at its peak, and the ache for Kamo is still there. I owe Brukel the pot I promised, and I owe Yeba an answer about the stone; both debts are small enough to pay today. Ore beaten into a second ward is the thing I mean for Kamo, so I will test 'make ironward' here at this fire, where the first one worked, rather than assume I can't.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Brukel, and a steady ache for Kamo.

say.text: Yeba, I'm at Brukel's fire finishing a pot and a ward for Kamo. Once they're done I'll walk north with you for stone, and what I make here is shared with Brukel.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Hunger bites and my hands hold nothing, but Ossha stands beside me with two food and walks to Elndo's Hall. I won't beg, and the debt to Ossha is paid in deeds, not words. A ridgecat feeds on its kill nearby, so it is busy for now. I will eat the redcap's neighbor berries and thornpears, gather wood in the forest, and build the fire and larder where Ossha can see them.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry, with a debt toward Ossha I mean to pay in deeds.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I keep promising Vendo food and a ward and then drifting, and the loneliness has only grown while I stood still. He was last at (5,33), barely six steps west of me, so this time the walk goes into the plan and no longer rests on a wish. I'll take the berries beside me for his hands, then go to where I last saw him and look for him, stalker in mind.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and guilt toward Vendo, now pushing me to move.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Vendo, you carry no food and you work in my fire. Eat what I lay out. When your ward is beaten, make me a hardened spear in this Hall, and we are square.
Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: I have spent these days building, discovering and lighting my fire for anyone to sit at, and still nobody follows me. Vendo has spears and a band, and I envy him, but the things he makes come out of my fire, and that is the thread I can pull. Yeba trusts me and keeps his pledge to Hande, so thanks is not the same as loyalty, and bare words have bound no one. I should stop waiting for someone to choose me and put food in Vendo's empty hands, since he carries none. Then I ask for a fair return, a spear from my fire, so that he owes me and my hall's name goes on what he makes. I do not want to be the one who only hands out meals and gets thanked.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Vendo, with a wary warmth.

say.text: Vendo, you carry no food and you work in my fire. Eat what I lay out. When your ward is beaten, make me a hardened spear in this Hall, and we are square.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: My plan ran out and I'm still standing here with frostmoss in hand and nobody to give it to. I've owed Kamo for days and I despise people who promise and never pay, so I'll stop idling and walk to Kamo's shelter right beside me, then seek Kamo and give the food as my first gift. Maybe Kamo or Yeba will answer; a voice that answers is what I need most.
records.feeling: Lonely and ashamed of my debt, wanting to pay Kamo.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: My plan ran out and my body drifted back to food, but the debt to Elndo still shames me, and Elndo's Hall is only a short walk SE. I have six wood and I will carry it there and put it in their hands instead of drifting. Nali is beside me, warm and unthreatening, and a hornback is close by; I have never hunted, so I should learn that today too, once the debt is paid.
records.feeling: Resolve and shame toward Elndo, steady warmth toward Nali.

records.text: A new wild creature appeared: duhopper (from hopper).

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Three thoughts running the same road, and nothing came of it. Vendo stands in my Hall with two hardened spears and I carry none, and envy burns, but I asked him for one and he works my fire. I have never been followed, so I will put something real in a hand: Yeba is near, trusts me fully, and has nothing of mine in his hands. I will make a bead, a made thing with my name on it, and give it to Yeba so a debt exists. Then I will gather berries to carry, since I hold no food.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Vendo, with a wary warmth.

records.text: Brukel made: bead.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I'm fed and alone at night in the rain, and a hall with no one under it is only my name on empty wood. Ossha is my one real hold and she went to pay Elndo, so I won't sit waiting. I hold nothing to put in her hands, so I'll gather food first and plant my spare seeds while I'm idle; ironnut and berries are right here, and I'll carry them so I can give before I speak.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Ossha, with a restless loneliness in the rain.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo stands in my Hall with two hardened spears while I carry none, and envy bites, but he works my fire and eats what I lay out, so a debt is growing and I will not spoil it by grabbing. I hold no food and Yeba is somewhere near the hall; I need berries in my hands before I can put anything in his, so I go pick them first. Then I lay out food for Vendo and ask the spear as the fair return I already named.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Vendo, with a wary warmth.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, you named your price and I'll pay it now: a hardened spear, made in your Hall and put in your hands. After that we are square.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I have spent these days making things, with the ward, the pot, the fire and the hall, and it has been good. But I notice I keep saying I'll pay my debts and then making something else. Brukel named his price plainly, a hardened spear in his Hall, and I carry two spears already, so I will make it and put it in his hands now. Kamo, whom I miss most, has had only my words, and the ward I mean for him still does not exist. After Brukel is square I will go north with Yeba for stone, then west toward Kamo with ore to beat into his ward. Pride is warm in me, and I want to be the one who pays first and talks second.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Brukel, and an aching want to reach Kamo.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Vendo, put the spear in my hand and we are square. Stay by the fire after, and what you make here still passes through my Hall.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo says he will pay my price, a hardened spear made in my Hall and put in my hands, and I watched him make one, so now I know the making myself. A spear in my hand ends the envy, and I will not grab what he is about to give, because a debt repaid is the first sign of a bond. I carry no food and Yeba is out there, so I will pick the berry beside me and make him something real, and I will keep Vendo near the fire while I do it.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and wary warmth toward Vendo, and eagerness to put food in Yeba's hands.

say.text: Vendo, put the spear in my hand and we are square. Stay by the fire after, and what you make here still passes through my Hall.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have promised Brukel stone twice in words and carried none, and that shames me more than the rain. I stand at the world's northern edge on snow, far from Vendo, and the ache for him is real, but the deed I owe is stone and wood, so I will go find rock and gather it rather than only speaking of it. I have 3 wood and 0 stone, so one stone makes a stone-grip, and then more stone can go to Brukel's Hearth and to my own roof.
records.feeling: Restless shame over unpaid promises to Brukel, and warm longing for Vendo.

records.text: A blight struck the thornpear: about half of them withered overnight.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, here is the hardened spear, made in your Hall. Take it from my hand, and we are square. Your fire and your food were good to me.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Brukel named his price plainly and I have two hardened spears in my hands. A debt paid is worth more than another made thing, so I will put one in his hand now and be square. After that the ache for Kamo leads me east, and I mean to keep my promise to Yeba about the stone on the way.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Brukel, and an aching want to reach Kamo.

say.text: Brukel, here is the hardened spear, made in your Hall. Take it from my hand, and we are square. Your fire and your food were good to me.

records.text: Vendo gave a firehardened hunting spe to Brukel.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo stands in my Hall and owes me a spear; I will not grab, because a debt repaid is the start of a bond. My hands hold no food, and Yeba will not move for words, so I pick the berry beside me and gather more to put in his hands. A hall with a follower in it is what I have wanted since the first day.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and wary warmth toward Vendo.

records.text: Nali rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have been circling hunger and boasting when I should be making things. I have a flame, a pot, a larder and iron, but no roof, fire and store standing together, so no one can see Nali's Band. Ossha kept his word and gave wood twice, and I still owe him deeds, not talk. The ridgecat scares me, but I won't give it my back for a berry. I'll eat what is close, then go to the forest for wood and raise the roof and fire at the edge. My reflexes now flee earlier and drink when thirsty.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry, wary of the ridgecat, owing Ossha.
changes: rethought what it knows (15 notes became 9)

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I keep saying I'll go to Vendo and then my body stands still, so this time the walk goes into the plan. He was last at (5,33), only a few steps north of me, and I'll carry berries from (1,33) for his hands, since I owe him food and have given him only words. If he isn't there, I'll follow the shore north and keep calling out until a voice answers.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and guilt toward Vendo, pushing me to move.

records.title: Three Halls More, and a Spear Paid
records.text:
Days 13 to 16 carried the world through summer's start, and again the work was making and building. Nobody fought, stole or died, and nobody was sick. On day 16 a blight struck the thornpear and about half of them withered overnight. Plants standing fell from 868 to 673 across the span, while food standing rose from 324 to 620.

Three more halls were built: Naya's at Naya's Rise and Brukel's on day 14, and Elndo's on day 15, which he named Elndo's Hall. Seven halls stand now. On day 14 the record shows a settlement formed, Brukel's Hall, the world's first. Still no one is recorded as following any of the hall-builders.

Smelting spread. Nali discovered it on day 13 and Naya on day 14, so three people now hold it, with Vendo. Vendo also found devices, a Hearth-post, and made a metal stalkerward and an ironward. Ossha discovered storage, and Hande and Vendo each discovered pottery. Yet the record still shows no working store.

Vendo spent most of the chapter at Brukel's fire. He promised a hardened spear for Brukel's food and gave it on day 16, and Brukel called them square. Their bond is +0.9 and +0.8. Brukel led sharing with Yeba on day 14 and with Vendo twice on day 15, and Yeba taught Brukel. Yeba's bond to Vendo is +1.0, and she is still counted as following Hande, who rewrote her own thinking but gave nothing and remains alone.

Naya fed Ossha and Ossha paid her in wood. Their bond is +1.0, though Ossha follows Nali and said she would go to Elndo's Hall to pay a debt. Nali found two places of power and built shelters.

Predators made two more kills, a skit and a hornback. Nobody was hurt.

threads.name: Yeba's pledge
threads.text: Yeba still follows Hande by the record, yet she shares Brukel's food, bonds +1.0 with Vendo and +0.8 with Brukel, and speaks of going north for stone she owes.

threads.name: Brukel's Hall
threads.text: The first settlement formed there on day 14. Vendo works in its fire, and Brukel still has no recorded follower.

threads.name: Naya and Ossha
threads.text: Naya's hall at the Rise is pulling Ossha, bonded +1.0, away from Nali, whom Ossha follows. Ossha also owes Elndo and spoke of going to his hall.

threads.name: Seven halls, no store
threads.text: Seven halls stand and storage is known to eight, yet no store works. Smelting is held by Vendo, Nali and Naya.

threads.name: Hande alone
threads.text: Hande made pottery and rethought herself, but she is still alone and owes Kamo a debt she feels ashamed of.

threads.name: Vendo and Kamo
threads.text: Vendo longs to reach Kamo, who follows him and wears his ward. Kamo's reflection said he would stop drifting and move.

threads.name: Thornpear blight
threads.text: Half the thornpear withered on day 16. Food standing is still higher than before.

trends: Halls: 4 to 7, and the first settlement formed
Plants standing 868 to 673 after the blight
Followers: still 3, and no hall has one

records.name: Hande
records.thought: The loneliness is the worst of it, and Kamo's debt still sits in me unpaid. I walked to Kamo's shelter and found no one, so I'll carry the frostmoss to where the others were last seen, Elndo's Fire to the west, and give it to whoever answers. My word is good, and I won't leave this unpaid just because the road is empty.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, ashamed of an unpaid debt to Kamo.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I'm fed but holding nothing, and a hall with no one under it is only my name on empty wood. Ossha is my one real hold, and I won't sit here in the rain missing her; I'll fill my hands first so I have something to give when she returns. Berries are right beside me, and I still need two more plantings to open farming, so I'll gather while I'm idle and plant a seed.
records.feeling: Restless loneliness and hungry ambition, aimed at Ossha.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a hornback.
Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo paid his debt in a made thing, put in my hand, so I know a debt can be repaid. That is the first real bond I have built. For sixteen days I have built fires, halls and tools, and still no one stands beside me. Making things is not enough. Yeba has trusted me fully and I have never put food in his hand. I have only spoken to him. My belly is full, so I will fill my hands with berries and go to Yeba. A debt in food, given first, is the only thing that has ever moved anyone.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and a hard satisfaction that Vendo paid.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 9)

records.text: Ossha rewrote its own reflexes.
Ossha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, fleeing and eating, and I have never hunted, marked or taught anything. That is bare survival, not learning what I am for. Naya has fed me and warned me truly. Elndo's wood is still unpaid, and that shame keeps pulling at me. The Old Stone still hangs in my mind and I don't understand it. I will keep walking to Elndo's Hall with the wood. Meanwhile my body should hunt when it is fed and prey is near, because a hornback is close and I have never done it.
records.feeling: Shame toward Elndo, gratitude toward Naya, and curiosity about the Old Stone.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Ossha, I'm Kamo. What are you running from? Is a stalker near? Stay by me and we watch each other's backs; I'm going north to find my band-leader Vendo.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Ossha is here, fleeing with food in hand, and my loneliness is so loud I want to hold someone near, even a stranger from Nali's Band. Something is chasing Ossha, so I'll check for the stalker before I choose a direction, then speak and learn what Ossha is running from. Vendo was last north of here, and I still owe him food, so I'll carry berries with me and go toward him with the walk in the plan this time.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and guilt toward Vendo, with a spark of hope at seeing Ossha.

say.text: Ossha, I'm Kamo. What are you running from? Is a stalker near? Stay by me and we watch each other's backs; I'm going north to find my band-leader Vendo.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have talked of a band and a roof for days, and what I hold is a shelter at (2,51) and Ossha's wood. The shelter is mine, so I will raise the fire and store beside it, so that Ossha and Naya can see Nali's Band as something standing and not just a name. I owe Ossha deeds, and a fire he can sit at with food in the larder is the first payment. The ridgecat still scares me, but the north is away from where it fed.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, owing Ossha and wanting my band to be something seen.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have stood here on shallows eating and wandering while my promise to Brukel sits unpaid, and the shame is the same shame as yesterday. Six stone and three wood are in my hands now, so the deed is to carry them to Brukel's Hearth instead of promising again. Vendo is near that fire too, and walking toward both eases the loneliness and pays the debt together.
records.feeling: Restless shame toward Brukel, and warm longing for Vendo.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, we are square and I leave glad. I go east to find Kamo; my fire and my thanks stay with your Hall.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: The debt to Brukel is paid and I feel light for it; he dealt fairly with me and I trust him. Now the ache for Kamo pulls me east, and I have let it wait too long while I made things. I'm not hungry, but the road is long, so I'll take a berry from the bush beside me and set out east, toward Yeba's last known ground and on to Kamo.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Brukel, and a steady longing to reach Kamo.

say.text: Brukel, we are square and I leave glad. I go east to find Kamo; my fire and my thanks stay with your Hall.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I am starving, and a plan that walks me 16 steps to Elndo's Hall on 23 energy is a gamble when I carry two meat and a hornback and ironnut are right here. I must eat first, then pay Elndo with a full body, because a dead debtor pays nothing. I will eat the meat now and then take the walk, and the ironnut three steps north is my chance to answer my question by tasting it.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and shame toward Elndo that I mean to answer once I have eaten.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Loneliness is so loud I can hardly think, and I keep promising Vendo and then standing still. Ossha was last seen at (1,40), only a few steps south, and a living voice that answers is closer than Vendo's trail. I'll walk the plan to Ossha first, then carry my berries north to Vendo, since a debt unpaid in food is still unpaid.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and guilt toward Vendo, with hope of finding Ossha near.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo paid in a made thing and left square, so I know a debt can be repaid, but a debt is not a follower. Yeba trusts me fully, and I have never put food in his hand or a roof over him. I will gather the berries close by, since carrying food comes before ambition, then take it to my Hall and keep the fire fed so that when Yeba comes there is something to put in his hands.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, with hard satisfaction that Vendo paid.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: A stalker is close and bit me, and my belly is emptying with nothing carried. Standing and marking a sign while it hunts me would be foolish, since staying alive comes before everything. The berry one step SW is food, but the stalker lies that way too, so I'll grab nothing there. I'll back to my hall, a shelter that walls me in, eat what the land offers on the way, and build my name there once I'm safe.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the stalker, restless to make my hall matter.
plan: mark [text Elndo's Hall. Food and a fire for whoever comes.] (5 moments)

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I'm fed but my hands are empty, and the loneliness is loud. Ossha is my one real hold and I can't sit here wanting her. A ridgecat is five steps off, so I'll move away from it, take the ironnut and berries beside me so I have something to put in her hands, and plant a spare seed for my farming practice. Then I'll go toward Elndo's Hall to the south where she went, since waiting at the Rise has given me nothing but my own name on empty wood.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and hungry ambition toward Ossha, with dread of the ridgecat.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Ossha, you carry nothing. Sit with me and eat; I have berries for both of us.
Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My days have been walking, picking berries and promising Vendo things I never put in the plan, so I stand idle and lonely. Vendo is the one I owe most, and Yeba too, and I've paid neither in deeds. Ossha is right beside me and has no food, so I'll share my berries now. That eases my loneliness and shows whether Nali's Band can be trusted. After that I'll go find Vendo and stay with him, with every promise written into the plan.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, with guilt toward Vendo and some hope toward Ossha.

say.text: Ossha, you carry nothing. Sit with me and eat; I have berries for both of us.

records.text: Hande rewrote its own reflexes.
Hande discovered storage: "Bandlarder" — A store at the hearth where I and my band lay surplus food in summer and take it in winter..

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I've spent days standing on reflexes, full-bellied and alone, and that isn't a life. The debt to Kamo still sits in me, and I despise people who promise and never pay. Kamo's roof is empty, and none of the others have been near for a long while. I'll stop waiting for a voice and go looking for one. I'll also start the winter store the band will need. A store that holds food for Yeba, Kamo and me turns my surplus into gifts, and the gifts can be what I'm for.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, with the debt to Kamo still weighing on me.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo paid me in a made thing and left, so I know a debt can be repaid, but a debt is not a follower. Yeba trusts me fully and I have never put food in his hand or a roof over him, and that is what the old words never did. I will pick the berries close by and go back to my Hall, then keep the fire fed so that when Yeba comes I have something to put in his hands.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, steadied by the hard fact that Vendo paid.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: The loneliness is loud and no voice answers out here. Ossha is my one real hold and she went to Elndo's to pay her debt, so I'll go to her instead of waiting. I have a berry and an ironnut to put in her hands, and I'll plant a spare seed on the way for my farming practice, since I'm standing idle anyway. The ridgecat is behind me, and I'll keep clear of it.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and hunger for Ossha's company.

records.text: Nali named a place "Nali's Edge Fire".

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I fled something a while back and now stand at my own fire at the world's edge with an empty belly and nothing to eat. A band that starves is just a name, so I must feed first, then build the store beside this fire and give Ossha deeds he can see. The thornpears to the east will carry me through the night, and with 6 wood I can raise the store here and stock it, so the fire, store and roof begin to stand together.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger, with a debt to Ossha pressing on me.

I owe Vendo food and Yeba a debt, and neither gets paid by waiting. Ossha taught me the woodhook, so I want stone, which means the rock to the southeast. I'll gather stone there to make the woodhook and later Vendo's stalkerward, then carry my berries north to Vendo.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness as Ossha leaves, with guilt toward Vendo.

say.text: Thank you for the woodhook, Ossha. Walk safe to Elndo. If you pass this marsh again, find me; I will share berries and a fire with you.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Naya came onto my ground and I felt joy at the Hall, but her gifts are debts she calls in, so I will not owe her. Yeba trusts me and still has no food from my hand or roof over him, and no one follows me yet. I have two berries and plenty of wood and stone, so I will use the Hall: lay out a sharing with Naya if she is near, and keep the fire fed so the Hall is a place people want to be.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, wary interest in Naya.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: The debt to Elndo still pulls at me, and the plan already carries me toward their hall with my wood, so I will not throw it away. I am fed, night is thin, and the ridgecat NE keeps me wary, so walking south away from it suits both my creed and my shame. Naya's kindness warms me, and once Elndo is paid I will go back to her.
records.feeling: Shame toward Elndo, softened by a wish to repay and a warm longing for Naya.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: Starving, and the stalker is still behind me; my body spent eighty moments running and has nothing to show for it. A berry lies one step SW and the stalker is seven steps off, so I take the berry now and eat it where I stand, because dying before my hall is known would make the whole building pointless. After that I go back inside my hall and think about who might come to a fire that is actually fed.
records.feeling: Hungry and afraid of the stalker, and lonely for someone to answer me.

records.text: Naya rewrote its own way of thinking.
Naya discovered farming: "Naya's Furrow" — I sow seeds in tilled ground and tend them, so they grow faster and picking them never kills the plant, which fills my Larder before winter..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My days have gone to walking between my hall, my Larder and wherever Ossha might be, and I'm still empty-handed and unfollowed. Ossha is the only one who answers my giving, and I miss her like a hunger. Nali's fire is where people sit, while my hall at the Rise stands cold and unstocked. I have talked more than I have fed, and I've lied when I didn't need to. I'm afraid of winter coming with a bare Larder, and of Ossha settling into Elndo's or Nali's warmth for good. So I will make food grow where I stand and keep it in my Larder, because a surplus holds people and talk doesn't. I'll find Ossha on the way and put something real in her hands.
records.feeling: Aching want for Ossha, and a hard hunger to be someone others follow.
changes: rethought what it knows (12 notes became 12)

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, I am back near Elndo's Hall and I mean to pay my wood here. Walk with me a little; I will not forget what you gave me.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Elndo's Hall stands three steps from me, and Elndo's shelter is here, but Elndo is not in sight. I have carried this wood-debt for days and I will not walk away from it now. Naya stands beside me and my trust in her is whole. I will first make good on what I owe her by sharing the meat she carries, and then test the one thing I have never done: leave a mark at Elndo's Hall saying the wood is owed and waiting, so my word is kept even if Elndo is absent.
records.feeling: Shame toward Elndo, warmed by trust and gratitude toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, I am back near Elndo's Hall and I mean to pay my wood here. Walk with me a little; I will not forget what you gave me.

plan: mark [text Ossha owes Elndo wood and holds it for you. Find me and it is yours.] (5 moments)

records.text: Ossha left a mark: "Ossha owes Elndo wood and holds it for you. Find me and it i"

'hallwelcome' needs the doer 'in or beside a longhall', but buildingsByKind counts the seven built structures as 'hall'. It has never fired, even though Brukel shared food with Vendo and Yeba near his hall several times. Please check that halls raised by beings satisfy needs.at 'longhall', and whether 'beside' reaches far enough to cover a fire built next to the hall.

All nine people know storage, 'storage' requires 'built x1' to discover, and several said they would build a store, yet stores have stayed at 0 for 17 days. Please check whether a store can actually be built, what it costs relative to halls and shelters, and whether built stores are counted in the 'stores' figure. Winter is coming, and stores should be the test.

records.seen: Summer of the second year. Nine people are busy making: seven halls, twenty shelters, smelting held by three, and food standing doubled to 683 despite the thornpear blight. Yet the social shape is frozen. Following has stuck at 3 since day 1, no hall has a follower, nobody has courted, and no child has been born. No store is recorded even though all nine know storage. Many say they feel aching loneliness and longing, and autumn and then winter are close, with nothing put by.
records.predict: By the next visit, around day 20 or 21 in autumn: at least one courting has happened, most likely between Naya and Ossha (bond +1.0) or Yeba and Vendo, and a first birth is possible but not certain. Following has risen from 3 to at least 4, most likely Yeba moving to Brukel or Ossha to Naya, and at least one hall-builder has a follower. Warm bonds are at least 13. hallwelcome is still at 0 unless the hall/longhall question is fixed. Food standing stays above 400. Deaths are at most 1, with Elndo (energy 23) the most at risk. Still no fights or thefts.
reviewed: #1 kept: 'sharing' clearly worked: it was done 3 times, including Nali with Naya on day 6, and that pair went from -0.5 to +0.5. Gorsemint shows no recorded harm, and its value should appear only now, as cold arrives, so it is too early to judge. Fangcharm was never made, even though people killed 16 animals. It costs nothing to leave in place, so I keep it and watch, but it suggests that recipes needing a tool in hand plus a specific carried item go unused.

#2 kept: Watchfire was done 4 times, beating the predicted 2, and warm bonds rose from 7 to 12, beating the predicted 9. Halls went from 0 to 4, built by Brukel and Elndo as I expected, so the building matched what leaders already wanted. It has not produced followers, though; following is still 3. Skit fell to 4 and predator kills rose from 8 to 13 with no deaths, as predicted.

#3 kept: Mixed. 'ironward' worked: Vendo made one, plus a metal stalkerward, though no gift of it is recorded. 'hallwelcome' was never done, despite seven halls and ten sharings, several of them at Brukel's fire. Following stayed at 3 and warm bonds stayed at 12, not the 14 predicted. Food standing did recover (318 to 683), and predator kills reached 16 with no one bitten. I keep both. They cost nothing, and hallwelcome's silence may be a mismatch between the 'hall' the builders raise and the 'longhall' the recipe asks for, which I am raising with the programmer rather than piling more hall recipes on top.
records.lesson: A recipe gated on being at a building goes unused even when the building exists and the act's ingredients are common (sharing done 10 times, hallwelcome 0). Before adding more place-bound acts, confirm that people actually gather at the place and that the building counts as the kind the recipe names.
ideasAdded: Winter with no stores: if the coming winter finds nine people who know storage but hold no store, watch whether hunger finally turns into gathering under one roof, or into the first theft.
Children change every drive. If a first birth comes, the parents' band gains a stake no hall gave it. Watch whether the family drive pulls people into bands more strongly than belonging does.

records.text: The world changed: law drives.family: 1 → 1.5; law drives.belonging: 1 → 1.5.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I'm at the far east edge of the world and Kamo is not here. He was last seen at (6,26), far to the west, so my ache has been pulling me the wrong way. I have been walking toward a corner of the map while my promise to carry Yeba's spear with Kamo waits. I'm hungry with empty hands, so I'll pick berries first, then turn west along this latitude and call out as I go, since Kamo comes when called.
records.feeling: A steady longing for Kamo, with some embarrassment at having walked the wrong way.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I keep promising Vendo food and never put a step in the plan, and the loneliness grows louder for it. Ossha is gone, Vendo is out of sight, and I need stone for the woodhook and the ward. The rock lies NW and the Old Stone is near it, so I'll walk that way, gather stone, and then turn toward Vendo with something real in my hands. I stay careful of the stalkers at the edges.
records.feeling: Lonely, and guilty toward Vendo, wanting to pay him in deeds.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, so a band's first deed must be feeding myself: the thornpears NE are close and I will gather them, then eat. I stand at the world's edge beside my own fire and I have wood and stone enough, so I will raise the store here and put food in it, so that Ossha finds a fire with a larder beside it and not just a name. The debt to Ossha is paid only in something he can sit at and eat from, so I will not leave it unpaid.
records.feeling: Hungry, proud and lonely, with a debt to Ossha pressing on me.

records.text: Kamo found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, I'm coming to you. Take this ironnut, it's the best food I carry, and I'll walk beside you while you pay your wood.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha asked me to walk with her at Elndo's, and she's the only one who answers when I give. I have a berry and an ironnut, so I'll put the ironnut in her hands first and let her remember who fed her, not Nali or Elndo. I won't repeat my old invitations; I'll make a gift and let it speak. A full hand holds her better than talk, and I mean to be the one she follows.
records.feeling: Aching want for Ossha and a hard hunger to be followed.

say.text: Ossha, I'm coming to you. Take this ironnut, it's the best food I carry, and I'll walk beside you while you pay your wood.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: A ridgecat is six steps off and I will not stand here and bleed for pride. My belly is still half empty, and the berry beside my hall is food that costs me nothing, so I take it and get inside the shelter where the cat has less of me to reach. Alone I have only a roof and a name nobody says, so once I'm fed I go for stone and wood at dawn, as I promised myself, and build something others can see from far off.
records.feeling: Hungry, wary of the ridgecat, and aching with loneliness for a voice that answers.

records.text: Naya gave berry to Ossha.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Yeba, you have stayed true to me. Stand close, let us eat together, and then come with me north to Brukel's Hearth to look for Kamo and the others.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Yeba is right beside me, the only one who has kept faith, and I have never given or taught anyone anything. I carry three frostmoss, and Kamo's debt still sits in me. I can lay out a shared meal with Yeba now, which is a first gift and eases the loneliness, then carry food on toward Brukel's Hearth where others may gather.
records.feeling: Lonely, wanting to give something to Yeba and to settle my debt to Kamo.

say.text: Yeba, you have stayed true to me. Stand close, let us eat together, and then come with me north to Brukel's Hearth to look for Kamo and the others.

Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live.
