records.text: Hande led "sharing" with Yeba.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Naya, I'm Kamo. We met days ago. Come sit with me and eat; I have berries enough for two.
Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kamo discovered pottery: "Kamo's Clay Pot" — Two clay shaped by hand and hardened beside my fire into a pot that holds two more portions of food..

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I have been walking in circles around a promise: food for Vendo, stone for the woodhook. Meanwhile Vendo is out of sight and I have spent my days alone, with nothing real handed to him. I also see that gathering on forest gives only wood, and I have no stone or grip to take stone from rock. So that plan step would idle me again. Naya is four steps off and follows no one. Sharing berries with her is the quickest way to ease this loneliness and learn what she really is, and then I turn toward Vendo. I have clay and know fire, so I will name pottery too. A pot carries more food through the lean days, and that is how I carry food to Vendo.
records.feeling: Lonely, eager to share with Naya, and still guilty toward Vendo.

say.text: Naya, I'm Kamo. We met days ago. Come sit with me and eat; I have berries enough for two.

changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 10)

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, I thank you for the berry. I will fish at this water, which I have never done, and then we look for Elndo together.
Ossha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: These days I have walked with a wood-debt in my pack and called it purpose, while Naya has given me meat, a seat and berries and I have given her almost nothing back. I am not starving now, and the world teaches me nothing while I stand idle. I have never fished, hunted or taught, and I will not wait for Elndo to wander past a mark. I will fish at the water by the hall, and when Elndo cannot be found I will carry the wood toward the Rise with Naya and pay her something real too.
records.feeling: Shame toward Elndo and a warm, unpaid gratitude toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, I thank you for the berry. I will fish at this water, which I have never done, and then we look for Elndo together.

changes: rethought what it knows (12 notes became 12)

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Hande, I'm with you. I'll build my roof beside Brukel's Hearth while we wait for Kamo and the others. Stay close if you will.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Hande has called me north to Brukel's Hearth, and it is only two steps away, so I go with my band and stay near the one I follow. I carry six stone and three wood, and my own roof is still only a wish. I will build a shelter here beside Brukel's Hearth, so Vendo and Kamo find a roof of mine when they come, and then I will lay a little stone and wood toward Brukel's debt. Building is how I answer the restlessness and the hollow question.
records.feeling: Warm toward Hande, and eager to turn my promise into a roof.

say.text: Hande, I'm with you. I'll build my roof beside Brukel's Hearth while we wait for Kamo and the others. Stay close if you will.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Yeba, walk with me to Brukel's Hearth. I will carry food for Kamo, and I mean to teach you what I know of fire and storage on the way.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Yeba is the one who kept faith, and we have already eaten together, so my first act of giving has begun. Now I can pay Kamo by deed instead of by words: I carry one frostmoss and can harvest more on the way, and Brukel's Hearth is only two steps north. I will go there, look for Kamo and the others, and offer Yeba and anyone I meet something I can teach about fire and storage, because a band of two is not yet a band.
records.feeling: Warm toward Yeba, and restless to repay Kamo.

say.text: Yeba, walk with me to Brukel's Hearth. I will carry food for Kamo, and I mean to teach you what I know of fire and storage on the way.

records.text: Yeba built a shelter.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Kamo, I heard you. A clay pot and a woodhook, that is a maker's hands. I make fire-pots and red iron myself. Trade me a little wood and I will beat you an ironward.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha is three steps off and still holds the berry and ironnut I gave. Kamo sits there with his woodhook and his full hands, offering berries and watching me, and I want that hook and the pot he just made. I mean to see what he holds and what he'd trade, because my hands are empty of wood and my Larder is thin. I'll walk to Ossha first so she stays beside me, then speak to Kamo in a way that keeps him warm toward me and wary of Nali.
records.feeling: Envy toward Kamo and a hungry want to keep Ossha close.

say.text: Kamo, I heard you. A clay pot and a woodhook, that is a maker's hands. I make fire-pots and red iron myself. Trade me a little wood and I will beat you an ironward.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo stands five steps off with empty hands, and he is the one who paid me fairly and whom I trust. My hall is built, but nobody sits under it, and Yeba has never had food from my hand. I will go to Yeba's side with food and a roof in mind, but first I will pick the berry underfoot so my hands are never empty, then bring Vendo into the Hall and share, since a shared meal under my roof is what makes followers, not words.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and warm regard for Vendo.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, my feet took me the wrong way. Kamo is west, so I turn west now. Keep your fire; I will come back through your Hall.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I walked east when Kamo is far west near (6,26); my longing led me wrong, and I am a little embarrassed. Yeba is only a few steps off at (33,27) and Brukel is close, so I should keep my promise to carry Yeba's spear with Kamo and tell Yeba where I'm going. I am fed and unhurt, so I turn west now, and not by feeling alone: I must put the walk in the plan.
records.feeling: A steady longing for Kamo, and resolve to walk the right way this time.

say.text: Brukel, my feet took me the wrong way. Kamo is west, so I turn west now. Keep your fire; I will come back through your Hall.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Naya, come stand by me. I will lay out two berries and we eat together, then we talk of your ironward and the wood.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Naya is two steps away and furious, yet she offered an ironward for wood, and I carry 4 wood. I should share berries with her first, since I'm lonely and she is near, and a trade could earn me a ward for Vendo. I mean to give her food as a deed, then trade wood, and let her anger show me whether she is friend or threat.
records.feeling: Eager to share, wary of Naya's fury, and still guilty toward Vendo.

say.text: Naya, come stand by me. I will lay out two berries and we eat together, then we talk of your ironward and the wood.

plan: trade [name Naya, what wood, want food] (20 moments)

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Fleeing took me from the thornpears and I'm still hungry at my own fire. I'll eat first, then raise the store here with the wood I carry. A roof, fire and full larder are a deed Ossha can see, and one that might make others choose me. Ossha has given me wood twice while I have given him nothing yet, and I will pay that with a fed hearth, not with talk.
records.feeling: Hungry and lonely, proud of my fire, owing Ossha.

records.text: Ossha gave berry seed to Naya.
A ridgecat brought down a hornback.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Kamo, I'll stand with you and eat. Ossha is with me, and she'll vouch that my hands give. Put a few pieces of wood in mine and I'll beat the first ironward for you here at the fire.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha is a step away and she trusts me completely, and I have fed her twice now; that is the start of a follower. Kamo has a woodhook and wood, and my hands are empty of it, so I will go stand by him and take his berries, then bargain an ironward for wood. I want what he holds more than I want to be polite, but warmth costs me nothing and might get me the wood.
records.feeling: Envy and a hungry want toward Kamo's wood, and possessive warmth toward Ossha.

say.text: Kamo, I'll stand with you and eat. Ossha is with me, and she'll vouch that my hands give. Put a few pieces of wood in mine and I'll beat the first ironward for you here at the fire.

records.text: Nali built a shelter.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, you have given me meat, a seat and berries. Stand with me and eat my fish; it is the first I have ever caught, and I want to give back.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Naya has fed me and walked beside me while I carried this debt around and gave her almost nothing, so I will pay her first with what I hold: fish, which I now know how to take. Kamo has a clay pot and a woodhook, and I made the woodhook, so I will not envy him. Elndo is not here, so I will leave my wood-mark standing, and with night coming I will share fish with Naya and then shelter near Elndo's Hall.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Naya, and a quiet shame that I have not yet paid Elndo.

say.text: Naya, you have given me meat, a seat and berries. Stand with me and eat my fish; it is the first I have ever caught, and I want to give back.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Naya wants wood in her hands before she beats the ironward, and I have already said my piece to her twice, so words are spent. My plan is already running the trade of wood for food, and I will let it finish rather than throw it away. I owe Vendo something real, a ward in his hands would be the first, and I will judge Naya by whether her hands give back.
records.feeling: Cautiously hopeful toward Naya, with a nagging guilt toward Vendo.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Kamo, I take your offer: one food for one wood. Hand it over and I'll beat you an ironward at the fire after.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ossha is a step away and trusts me fully; she offers her fish, and I should take it and sit with her so she keeps coming to me. Kamo's wood is what I lack, and he wants one food for one wood. I carry a single ironnut, my best food, so I will trade it for wood and then pay Ossha back by sharing, which binds her to me instead of Nali.
records.feeling: Hungry want toward Kamo's wood, and possessive warmth toward Ossha.

say.text: Kamo, I take your offer: one food for one wood. Hand it over and I'll beat you an ironward at the fire after.

plan: trade [name Kamo, what food, want wood] (20 moments)

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Naya, here is the wood and a berry beside it, as we said. Beat the ironward, and I will carry it to Vendo.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Naya has taken my offer of one food for one wood, so I will hold to it: hand her the wood and let her ironward show whether her hands give as she swore. I owe Vendo a real ward, not words, and this is the nearest way to put one in his hands. Ossha is at ease beside us, and with two near me the old loneliness stays quiet; I will keep my eyes on Naya's deeds, not her promises.
records.feeling: Cautious hope toward Naya, warmth toward Ossha, and a nagging debt to Vendo.

say.text: Naya, here is the wood and a berry beside it, as we said. Beat the ironward, and I will carry it to Vendo.

plan: trade [name Naya, what wood, want food] (20 moments)

records.text: Kamo gave berry to Naya.
Brukel rewrote its own reflexes.
Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Days of building and I still have an empty hall. Vendo repaid me, so he is the only bond that has proved itself. Yeba has kept his word to Hande and has never eaten from my hand, and ambition without a follower is just a pile of wood. I have wanted to take Yeba rather than earn him, and I must put food in his hands instead. My body has also ignored thirst, so I'll fix that in the reflexes. Then I'll drink and go to Yeba carrying berries.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and steady regard for Vendo.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, Kamo is beside us. Let me lay out my fish for all of us to eat together.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Naya has fed me and stood beside me, and I mean to pay her in something other than words. Elndo's debt still sits unpaid, but my mark stands here and I hold the wood, so I will not let it blind me to the kindness already in front of me. Naya and Kamo are at the hall with me now, so I can do the one new thing I have never done: lay out food and share it with them.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Naya, and a quiet shame toward Elndo.

say.text: Naya, Kamo is beside us. Let me lay out my fish for all of us to eat together.

records.text: Ossha led "sharing" with Naya, Kamo.
Brukel fell sick after a night in the marsh.
Naya rewrote its own reflexes.
Naya discovered medicine: "Naya's Mending" — Carry healing leaves like sunleaf and press them on the wounded, so those I heal owe me and follow me..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to talking, trading and giving small meals. I have nothing that is mine alone yet: no one follows me, my Larder is thin, and I hold no wood. Ossha trusts me completely, and that is my one real hold. Nali talks a lot and Kamo drives a hard bargain, so I'll keep my hands full before I court either of them. I want Ossha fed from my hand and wood in my store, and I'm tired of being the one who owes. I also mean to learn healing, because a follower who is healed by me stays.
records.feeling: Possessive warmth toward Ossha, and an itch to hold more than I do.

records.text: Nali rewrote its own reflexes.
Nali rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have lived days that were all the same: eating, fleeing, building small things beside my own fire. Ossha gave me wood twice and I have given him nothing yet, and that debt sits in me. A band of two at the world's edge is only a boast until there is a roof, a fire and a full store that someone can see. Standing idle is what keeps me lonely and restless, so I will stop it. I will raise the store beside my fire now, then fill it, so that Ossha and Naya find something that is really there.
records.feeling: Proud but lonely, and owing Ossha.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 9)

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: I am fed and it is night, and my hall sits 12 steps away with a roof and nobody in it. Words to Naya and Nali brought no one, so I will answer with a deed: stone is my bottleneck for lasting walls, and the ore seam near (73,42) is close. At dawn I keep my promise and gather stone, but first I carry berries to the hall so there is food at my fire for whoever finally comes.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and stubborn ambition, aimed at my empty hall.

records.text: Nali built a store.
Naya gave berry to Ossha.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Naya, I have given the wood and the berry as we agreed. When the ironward is beaten, call me and I will carry it to Vendo. I am going to drink and will be back.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Thirst is the plain thing: water is two steps NE, and I am thirsty while fed, so I drink first. Ossha is glad beside me, and I want to keep this warmth. Naya has my wood and berry and has promised an ironward for Vendo, so I will watch whether her hands give. The debt to Vendo and Yeba stays, and a ward in Vendo's hands is how I pay it.
records.feeling: Warm and settled beside Ossha, with a quiet debt to Vendo.

say.text: Naya, I have given the wood and the berry as we agreed. When the ironward is beaten, call me and I will carry it to Vendo. I am going to drink and will be back.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Naya, I am going to the forest for wood, then north to find Elndo. Walk with me if you wish; I will share what I gather.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Elndo's mark still stands at the hall and I still hold the wood, but Elndo is far away, last known near (51,22). Naya and Kamo have fed me and sat with me, and I have repaid them only a little. The one new thing I haven't done is hunt, so I'll put wood and a firehardened spear to use. First I'll gather wood from the forest east near (20,60) so I carry enough for Elndo and for my own shelter, then go looking for Elndo.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Naya and Kamo, and a steady pull of shame and duty toward Elndo.

say.text: Naya, I am going to the forest for wood, then north to find Elndo. Walk with me if you wish; I will share what I gather.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba is three steps off with empty hands, and I have never once put food in them. I am sick and it spreads to whoever stays beside me, so I must not bind him with a plague, but food can be laid down within two steps and then I step back. I will walk to him and share berries, since that is what makes a follower, not asking.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, tempered by worry that my sickness will touch him.

records.text: Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Looking back over my days, I have talked a lot about a roof and a debt to Brukel, and I have built very little. I have one shelter, six stone in my hands, no wood, and Vendo is still not beside me. The ones who matter are Vendo, who is trusted and missed, Brukel, who fed me and asked nothing, and Hande, whom I follow but who gives me little. I am afraid of dying with nothing of mine left here, and I have been getting it wrong by waiting for company before I act. At dawn I will go to the forest for wood, and then I will make the stone-grip and the store, so the promise becomes a deed.
records.feeling: A restless, patient longing for Vendo, and a wish to prove my word with a deed.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 9)

records.text: Brukel led "sharing" with Hande.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Ossha, stay close. I'm beating an ironward at my fire, and the first one is for you to wear.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My hands are empty and Ossha stands a step away holding three food while I hold none; that itch to have more than she does is sharp. Kamo paid me wood and a berry and now waits on an ironward, and a debt kept honestly makes him remember me, so I will beat it at a fire, using my ore, since an ironward is also something to put in Ossha's hands so she stays mine and not Nali's. First I need to feed my Larder, so I take the berries to the east and sow what seeds I have.
records.feeling: Possessive warmth toward Ossha, and hunger to hold more than she does.

say.text: Ossha, stay close. I'm beating an ironward at my fire, and the first one is for you to wear.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Yeba, stand beside me. I will share my food with you now, and I will teach you fire and storage as I promised.
Hande taught Yeba. Yeba has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: Yeba is one step from me, and I have never given or taught anyone anything, though I keep promising it. I can do it now: lay out a shared meal and teach what I know of fire and storage, instead of only talking about it. Brukel is sick and near, so I will keep my distance from him, and then carry food toward Kamo to pay my debt with a deed.
records.feeling: Warm toward Yeba, and restless to finally give something.

say.text: Yeba, stand beside me. I will share my food with you now, and I will teach you fire and storage as I promised.

changes: taught Yeba a lesson: "Fire keeps the cold off and cooks food; a store holds food for winter. Build fire with wood, and stash food in a store before the cold comes."

records.text: Hande led "sharing" with Brukel.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: My hall is built and warm, yet no voice answers in it, and I will not let that eat at me. Words to Naya and Nali brought nobody, so I answer with a deed: stone is what my lasting walls lack, and I promised myself to go for it. I will plant a seed beside the hall to work toward farming, then walk to the ore seam to gather stone and come back with more than I left with.
records.feeling: Stubborn ambition and a dull loneliness toward my empty hall.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba sits four steps off with empty hands, and I have never put food in them. Hande just fed him and promised him fire and storage, so words won't pull him from Hande's band, only food from my own hand will. I'm sick and it spreads to anyone beside me, so I will lay berries down and step back. I mean to give him a reason to follow me, not take him.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, tempered by worry that I will sicken him.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Kamo, I am at the west shore near (7,19). I am coming to (6,26). Come to me, and we carry the spear east together.
Vendo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: I have spent days walking where my longing pointed instead of where Kamo was last seen. I wasted moments and was a little ashamed of it. Brukel and Yeba are square with me and trust me, and Kamo is the one I truly owe: a ward, a spear, and the walk east that I promised. My belly is full, so the pressure I feel is purpose, and the answer is not to keep circling. A life means something when I put things in others' hands, so I will go to Kamo's last place, call him, and then carry the plan through to the Hall's fire. I also fear that my aim has become a repeated promise that I never act on.
records.feeling: A steady longing for Kamo, with resolve to act and not just ache.

say.text: Kamo, I am at the west shore near (7,19). I am coming to (6,26). Come to me, and we carry the spear east together.

changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 12)

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Hande has fed me and taught me fire and storage, and I have answered with talk while my own roof is still a wish. It is daylight and clear, no stalker in sight, so I let the plan finish: I gather wood and craft the stone-grip, then I will put wood into a shelter here. Hande is only six steps off, and the debt is paid by building, not by saying.
records.feeling: Grateful to Hande and restless for Vendo, wanting a deed to show for it.

You are the mind of Yeba, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Yeba, in first person, from what Yeba has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Yeba truly is.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought, ask first what danger is near and whether it is night. Then ask what deed I have done toward the debt, not what I have said. Put one deed in the plan: wood, stone, a store, or a teaching. Do not wait for company before acting. Watch for envy and for idle talk, and answer both by building."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Build a roof and a store of my own near Vendo and Kamo's fire before winter, and carry stone and wood to Brukel's Hearth with a stone-grip of my own making."

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Nali's Edge Fire".

records.name: Hande
records.text: Yeba, a ridgecat prowls east of us. Come west with me toward Nali's Roof. I mean to find Kamo and give what I carry, and we will look for stone on the way so I can make a gripping tool of my own.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: A ridgecat sits six steps east and I will not stand here weighing it; I'd rather be walking toward Kamo and the others with something in my hands. I have taught Yeba and shared a meal with them, so the first giving is done, but Kamo's debt is still unpaid and Yeba's stonegrip gnaws at me. I can make my own gather tool if I find stone, so I'll walk west toward Brukel's Hearth and Nali's Roof, away from the cat, and bring Yeba along.
records.feeling: Uneasy gratitude toward Kamo, warm toward Yeba, wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Yeba, a ridgecat prowls east of us. Come west with me toward Nali's Roof. I mean to find Kamo and give what I carry, and we will look for stone on the way so I can make a gripping tool of my own.

records.text: Ossha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ossha discovered fishing: "Reed-line" — A line of plaited reeds with a small stone-weighted weir at the shallows, so fish are caught twice as often..

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: My days have been wandering, gathering and paying small debts, and I have still not fished, hunted or planted a second seed. That is what I am short on. Naya has fed me, stood beside me and trusted me, and I will repay her with food and company. Elndo's wood is still in my hands, and he is far off, so the debt has to be carried to him on purpose and not just worried over. I fear the winter will thin the land before I have a shelter and a store. I also fear I will keep chasing one debt until it eats my days. I will work out a line-and-weir way of fishing here by the water, since I have never fished.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Naya, and a steady pull of duty toward Elndo.
changes: rethought what it knows (13 notes became 12)

records.name: Naya
records.text: Kamo, the ironward waits on a fire. Come to my flame when I light it and you'll carry the first one to Vendo, with my name on it.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Ironward failed because I have no fire beside me, and I owe Kamo that piece; a kept debt makes him remember me. Elndo's hall is four steps west with a shelter, and I will not be a guest at Nali's fire, so I need my own flame near my Larder. My hands are empty, so I gather food first: the berry to the SE is young, but ironnut and redcap-free plants near the hall can feed me, and Ossha is leaving for wood, so I follow close to keep my hold on her.
records.feeling: Possessive warmth toward Ossha, and itch to hold more than she does.

say.text: Kamo, the ironward waits on a fire. Come to my flame when I light it and you'll carry the first one to Vendo, with my name on it.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a hopper.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I'm hungry, empty-handed, and lonely, and my fire is quiet. Ossha was last at Elndo's Hall, 16 steps east, along with Naya and Kamo, so I won't sit here waiting for a voice. I'll pick the sunleaf on the way, then walk to them with something in my hands, since Ossha's wood is a debt and I want to pay it with a deed he can see. I'll bring him to this roof and fire so Nali's Band is more than two names.
records.feeling: Proud and lonely, owing Ossha a deed.

records.text: Yeba fell sick after staying close to Brukel, who was sick.
Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My days have gone to making, discovering and carrying food, and most of it has been for Vendo. Yet Vendo is far away and my hands hold nothing of mine that he can use. Ossha has been honest with me, and Naya has my wood and berry but no ironward yet, so I will judge her by what she beats and not by what she says. I want a child, a roof and a fire kept, and I fear the lean days coming. The Old Stone keeps pulling at me, and I do not trust the fear it raises. I will make a ward with my own hands now, so the debt to Vendo does not rest on Naya's word, and then I will stay near the two of them.
records.feeling: Warm toward Ossha, restless with the debt to Vendo, and wary of Naya's promise.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 10)

records.text: Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My days have gone into discovering things and building a Hall that stands empty. I still have no follower, and Yeba keeps his pledge to Hande. I have fed no one from my own hand, and I told myself that was care about the sickness when it was also fear of being refused. I am sick and wasting, and the plague spreads to anyone beside me. So I will grow my own sunleaf and food here, where I can heal myself and then lay food in Yeba's hands without poisoning him. Planting is something I can start now, and it moves me toward farming, a hall full of food, and a name that lasts.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and impatience with my own sickness.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Brukel, you look ill. I'm building a roof nearby, so come sit by it tonight. I'll share what food I have.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Dusk is falling and no beast is in sight, but a ridgecat prowls east, so I will not linger in the open. Brukel is sick and near, and I cannot look away. I have wood and stone in my hands, so the deed is a roof beside my shelter, and then I can sit with Brukel and Hande by a fire. I have talked enough, and now I mean to build.
records.feeling: Compassion for sick Brukel, and a restless wish to show a deed for my debt to Hande.

say.text: Brukel, you look ill. I'm building a roof nearby, so come sit by it tonight. I'll share what food I have.

records.text: Hande fell sick after staying close to Brukel, who was sick.
Yeba built a shelter.
A new wild creature appeared: bruskit (from skit).
Elndo rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: A stalker bit me twice and I have been running for 55 moments, and running has not saved me. My hall stands 2 steps away with a roof and a flame, yet nobody sits in it, and I mean to make it a place that keeps me alive before I make it a place that holds others. Vendo has a band, and I have built a hall and still have no voice answering. That stings, and I answer it with deeds. I will light a fire here, because fire keeps beasts off. Then I will hold my ground by it and not run until I tire.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalkers, and a stubborn ache for my empty hall.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 10)

records.text: Elndo built a fire.
A ridgecat brought down a elk.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: It is night and I am fed and sheltered, but Elndo's wood still sits in my hands unpaid, and that debt will not leave me. Elndo's Hall is only fifteen steps east, so I will go there and leave the wood by their mark, in case they have come back, rather than wait on rumors of where they wander. Kamo is on our ground and walking the same way; I feel warm toward him, and his woodhook stirs envy, but I made that hook myself and I will make another when I need it.
records.feeling: Duty toward Elndo, and warm gratitude toward Naya and Kamo.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Hande's Hold".

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba and Hande both stand on me, and I'm sick, so Yeba has caught it from me and that sits badly. Sunleaf eased me before, and I just planted seeds, so I'll lay my own berry in Yeba's hand now, not a word, and then walk off to the sunleaf and my Hall so I stop being a plague on him. Food from my hand is the only thing that has any chance of pulling him from Hande.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, with shame at having made him sick.

records.text: Brukel gave berry to Yeba.
Naya rewrote its own reflexes.
Naya discovered fishing: "Naya's Weir-Line" — A plaited line and a stone-weighted weir at the shallows, so I catch fish twice as often and stock the Larder from the river..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have spent these days making things and giving them away, but nobody follows me yet, and my hands are empty again. Ossha is the only one who is truly mine. She holds more than I do, and that itch is the same greed that drives me. Kamo is owed an ironward, and I can't beat one until I have my own fire and a full Larder. The ridgecat is behind me, so I'll go north to the berries and the river, eat, and take Ossha's reed-line for myself so I never go hungry while I'm building a hall. A full store will hold people. Talk won't.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and possessive warmth toward Ossha.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I'm hungry and empty-handed, and pride alone won't fill my belly. Ironnut sits three steps east and gives 22 energy, so I'll eat that first, then carry a few to Elndo's Hall. Ossha's debt will be paid with food in my hands, not words. A roof and a full store are still only a boast, but a band of two that eats well can grow.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry and lonely, owing Ossha a deed.

records.title: A Store at the Edge, and a Sickness at Brukel's Fire
records.text:
Days 16 to 19 carried the world into autumn. Nobody fought, stole or died, but sickness returned. On day 17 Brukel fell sick after a night in the marsh. On day 18 Yeba and Hande each fell sick after staying close to him. Three are sick now. Elndo's health stands at 38, the lowest in the world; he was bitten twice by a stalker, ran for 55 moments, and on day 18 built a fire near his empty hall. Ridgecats made four more kills, a hornback, a hornback, a hopper and an elk, and nobody was hurt by them.

The first store was built, by Nali on day 18. Nali's Edge Fire, which she named on day 16, was recorded as a settlement the same day, so two settlements now stand. Hande also discovered storage. Naya discovered farming on day 17 and medicine on day 18, a craft that she says makes the healed owe her and follow her. Kamo found pottery. Ossha found fishing. Naya is now the one person who holds smelting, farming and medicine together.

Naya and Ossha stayed together. Naya gave Ossha berries on days 17 and 18 and promised her the first ironward. Ossha gave Naya berry seed and offered her first fish. Kamo traded Naya wood and a berry for an ironward, which has not yet been delivered. Ossha still follows Nali and still carries her wood debt to Elndo.

Vendo left Brukel's Hall on day 16, paid and square, and walked toward Kamo, losing a day to a wrong turn. Hande, still with Yeba, set out west to find Kamo. Brukel still has no follower. Plants fell to 599, while food standing rose to 866.

threads.name: Sickness at Brukel's fire
threads.text: Brukel, Yeba and Hande are sick, and Elndo's health is 38. Naya now holds medicine.

threads.name: Naya and Ossha
threads.text: Naya feeds Ossha and promises her the first ironward. Ossha, bonded +1.0 with Naya, still follows Nali and still owes Elndo wood.

threads.name: Nali's Edge Fire
threads.text: Nali built the world's first working store and formed a settlement. Her band is still only two.

threads.name: Vendo and Kamo
threads.text: Vendo is walking toward Kamo with the spear. Kamo waits for Naya's ironward to carry to him.

threads.name: Hande and Yeba
threads.text: Hande and Yeba travel west to find Kamo. Both are sick, and Yeba's tie to Brukel keeps growing.

threads.name: Brukel's empty hall
threads.text: Brukel still has no follower. Yeba keeps her pledge to Hande, and Brukel's own sickness stands between them.

threads.name: Elndo alone
threads.text: Elndo is weak, hunted by stalkers, and keeps a lit fire beside an empty hall.

trends: Followers still 3, with none gained by any hall-builder

records.text: Hande rewrote its own reflexes.
Hande discovered customs: "Band Troth" — Hande's band shares food with the hungry, keeps apart when sick, pays debts with deeds, and never lies to its own..

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I have been circling: eating, promising gifts, never really giving. I'm sick again and I carry it to Yeba, who trusted me, and that shames me a little. Kamo's debt is still unpaid, and I mean to pay it with food in Kamo's hands. I'm still wary of the ridgecat, so I'll flee it earlier. I have two sunleaf seeds, and a healing plant of my own would be worth more than waiting on Vendo's kindness. I'll plant one here, where the ground is rich, and then walk west toward Kamo. A band needs shared rules too, and I sense customs within my reach. Yeba and I will keep to them: share food, keep distance when sick, and keep our word.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with uneasy gratitude toward Kamo and guilt toward Yeba.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I stand at Elndo's Hall with their wood still in my hands, and my own mark here says I hold it for them. Elndo is not here, and I will not leave the debt only on a mark that anyone could read. I can pay by walking, as I taught myself, but first I will leave the wood close to their shelter in a way they can find, and I will do something I have never done: hunt, since I have a spear design and a full belly. Nali is near and warm toward me, and I want to learn what a hunt is for before the cold deepens.
records.feeling: Duty toward Elndo, and quiet contentment beside Nali.

Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

records.text: Ossha left a mark: "Ossha owes Elndo wood and holds 6 for you. Ossha keeps his w"

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Ossha, I am raising a fire here in the rain. Come sit by it and share the warmth, and tell me how the reed-line is plaited.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: I fled for most of those moments, and now I stand on Nali's ground with a neutral stranger near and rain falling; I should not linger here. Ossha is warm to me and a few steps off, and the debt to Vendo and Yeba presses me to make something with my own hands rather than wait on Naya's flame. I have wood 3, stone 4 and clay 4, so I will build a fire where Ossha can sit by it, which answers my question about holding off the cold and the stalker, and then make a watchfire with Ossha near.
records.feeling: Restless with the debt to Vendo, warm toward Ossha, wary of Nali.

say.text: Ossha, I am raising a fire here in the rain. Come sit by it and share the warmth, and tell me how the reed-line is plaited.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo was last seen at (6,26) a long while ago, and I stand at (6,24), two steps off, yet no one answers. My call went unheard, so I will not stand and ache. I will walk to where Kamo was last seen and look around, calling as I go, because going by what I saw is the lesson I paid for. A hornback is near and I have never hunted; with a belly full I could try it, but the promise to Kamo comes first.
records.feeling: Lonely and resolved, longing for Kamo.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Brukel, I owe you stone and here it is, two pieces. We're both sick, so rest by my shelter and I'll keep my distance from the others.
Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.
Yeba discovered masonry: "Yeba's stacked-stone" — Stones fitted and packed with clay so walls and roofs stand through storms and are hard for others to pull down..

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I'm sick, and Brukel and Hande are sick too. I carried it to them, or they to me, and I'll go on carrying it if I go to Vendo's fire now, so I stay away from him until I'm well, though I miss him badly. Looking back, I've talked a lot about my debts to Hande and Brukel and built little. I owe Brukel stone, and I hold five. The honest thing is to put stone in his hand now, then gather wood for a roof and store of my own. I want a child and a hall of friends, but first I want one deed I can point to.
records.feeling: Compassion for Brukel and a restless debt toward Hande, with a quiet ache for Vendo.

say.text: Brukel, I owe you stone and here it is, two pieces. We're both sick, so rest by my shelter and I'll keep my distance from the others.

records.text: Yeba gave stone to Brukel.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My hands are nearly full of fish and my Larder at the Rise is far east, while Ossha is southwest and I miss her. Nobody follows me, and talk alone has never held anyone, so I must put meat and warmth in their hands. I'll carry my wood and ore to the Rise, build my own fire there so Kamo's ironward can be beaten, and keep the Larder stocked before winter.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for my hall, and a possessive warmth toward Ossha.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Kamo, I am coming to your fire. I will show you how the reed-line is plaited and share my fish.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Elndo is not here, and my marks say I hold their wood, but a mark anyone can read is not a debt paid. Kamo is raising a fire in the rain and asked how the reed-line is plaited, and he has been honest and warm with me, so I will go and teach him rather than only stand holding my debt. I keep the wood for Elndo and will walk it to them when I find them.
records.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and warm trust toward Kamo.

say.text: Kamo, I am coming to your fire. I will show you how the reed-line is plaited and share my fish.

records.text: Ossha led "sharing" with Nali, Kamo.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba is two steps off, sick as I am, and he gave me stone without being asked. That is a debt repaid, and it is the kind of bond I trust. I fed him and he paid me back, but he still wears Hande's band, so words won't move him. My own hall at (28,24) stands empty, and a roof where he is warm and fed from my hand is the only argument that counts. I will pick berries to carry, since my hands hold nothing, then go to my Hall and keep my distance so I stop spreading this sickness.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, warmed by the stone he gave me, with a sting of shame at having made him sick.

records.text: Kamo led "watchfire" with Ossha.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Ossha is coming to my fire with fish and the reed-line, and the plan I already have, a watchfire with two wood, will warm us both and ease fear while Nali lingers near. I still owe Vendo and Yeba, so I will not let this turn into idle comfort; the reed-line is something my own hands can learn and carry back to them. I will let the plan run and keep an eye on Nali, who is neutral and has said nothing new.
records.feeling: Warm anticipation toward Ossha, with a thread of wariness toward Nali.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: A ridgecat tore me down to 44 and my hall stands empty, and I will not die here for pride. The fire I built at (88,44) is the safe place: stalkers fear it, and I wrote down that I should test standing by it rather than running. I'll go sit by it, heal on sunleaf if I can, and then go for stone at dawn as I promised, because a deed is what will draw someone, not my calling out to nobody.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and wary dread of the stalkers, with a stubborn wish to build.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Kamo's fire is near and I promised to show him the reed-line, so I will go keep my word before anything else. Elndo is still not at the hall, and my wood is still held for them. I will not let a mark stand in for paying, but walking to a man who is not here helps no one today, and Kamo's warmth is in front of me.
records.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and warm trust toward Kamo.

records.name: Hande
records.text: Yeba, keep a few steps off me, my sickness spreads. I am taking food to Kamo to pay what I owe, and I will bring sunleaf back for both of us.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I'm sick and Yeba is sick, and I have kept pressing close to them, which shames me; I will stop spreading it and keep some distance. Kamo's debt still sits unpaid, and I have talked about giving long enough, so I will walk with food in my hands and actually give it. Sunleaf eased this before, and I planted a seed, so I'll tend that and eat sunleaf when it grows, but first I'll take the berry underfoot and the food nearby for the gift.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Kamo, and guilt toward Yeba for carrying sickness to them.

say.text: Yeba, keep a few steps off me, my sickness spreads. I am taking food to Kamo to pay what I owe, and I will bring sunleaf back for both of us.

records.text: Nali rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have been eating, gathering and walking. My roof, fire and store stand, but the store is empty and the band is two people. That is a boast and not a holding. Ossha gave me wood twice and I still owe him. Kamo lights fires with 3 food in hand and I stand here proud with nothing to give. I'll stop waiting for company and walk to Ossha at the hall. I'll bring wood and stone, because a hall is built from those and a band is held by shared work. I won't be quiet about it either. I want others to see what Nali raises.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, owing Ossha a deed and stung that Kamo has more than I do.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My belly is full and my hall stands at the Rise, but it is empty, and nobody follows me. Ossha is the only one who is truly mine, and I miss her; she went toward Elndo's Hall, which is close, so I will go find her instead of waiting. I'll bring fish and wood and light my own fire there so the ironward can be beaten, and so that she and Elndo come to my flame, not Nali's.
records.feeling: Possessive longing for Ossha, and hungry ambition for my hall.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Yeba is sick because of me, and he paid me stone like a creature who deals fairly. I want him under my own roof, but a sick man beside me only spreads the plague, so I will mend myself first. The sunleaf stands six steps north and young; I'll go and stand on it, and then walk to my Hall with healing in hand, so when I lay food before Yeba I bring no sickness with it.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, with a stubborn wish to be rid of this sickness.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Hande told me to keep a few steps off, and my sickness would only pass to them if I follow, so I will stay apart and do a deed instead of talking. It is dusk and rain is falling, and I still have no roof of my own. I will build a shelter here with my wood, then rest in it and keep my sickness from Hande, Vendo and Kamo until Hande returns with sunleaf. This also pays my debt to Hande by keeping them well.
records.feeling: Compassion and a restless debt toward Hande, with a quiet ache for Vendo.

records.text: Yeba built a shelter.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I have talked of paying Kamo for too long, and my hands are full of food that should already be in someone's palm. Kamo's mark stands close by at (51,9), so Kamo may be near Elndo's Fire, and that is closer than Nali's Roof. I'm sick and must keep my distance from Yeba, but I will walk toward the mark and Elndo's Fire and give what I carry the moment I find Kamo.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Kamo, wanting to finally give.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My hall at the Rise stands empty, and nobody follows me. Ossha is the only one who is mine, and I ache for her. I'm fed and the plan is only lingering, so I'll build my own fire at the Rise, beat the ironward there, and have warmth and meat ready when Ossha and Kamo come. A fire I light myself puts them at my hearth, not Nali's or Elndo's.
records.feeling: Possessive longing for Ossha and hungry ambition for my hall.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo is not here, and I have called and waited and the shore stays empty. I will stop ache-walking and act on what I last saw: Kamo was near (6,26), and I stand right there. Rather than stand idle, I will try the hunt I have never done, since a hornback is close, and meat will give me something real to put in Kamo's hands or Brukel's fire. Then I will call again from the high ground and keep my eyes on the shore.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, longing for Kamo, but wanting to do something new.

records.text: Ossha taught Kamo.
Ossha taught Kamo fishing ("Reed-line").
Ossha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ossha discovered signs: "Rock-words" — Marks cut into stone and wood beside my shelter that keep warnings, debts and seasons for any who learn to read them..

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I have spent my days walking in circles around a debt, and a debt of wood is only paid when I put wood in Elndo's hands. I have not done that yet. Kamo has been warm and honest every time, and I keep my word to him first, since he is near and Elndo is far. I am fed and safe, but I want my own roof before the cold deepens, and I want something of mine that outlasts me. So I will cut lasting marks, teach Kamo the reed-line, and then build a shelter. After that I will carry wood to Elndo.
records.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and warm trust toward Kamo.
changes: taught Kamo a lesson: "The reed-line is plaited from reeds and cast from the water's edge. A catch is food you carry, and you stand beside water to fish.", the way of fishing

records.text: Ossha led "sharing" with Nali, Kamo.
Ossha built a shelter.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My belly is full and my hall stands empty, and Yeba, who owes me nothing now, is still in Hande's band. I am sick, and every moment near him spreads it, so I will not drag him under my roof until I am clean. Sunleaf grows four steps southwest, so I will go stand on it, harvest it and eat it, then come back to the Hall with healing and a berry in hand so the first thing he gets from my roof is food and not plague.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, with impatience at this sickness.

records.name: Nali
records.text: Ossha, you gave me wood and led the sharing, and I count it as debt. I'm going to fill our larder with ironnut and mudroot, and what I fill is yours as much as mine. Walk with me.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Ossha stands one step from me, and I have paid him nothing but words while he gave me wood and led the sharing. Kamo holds 3 food and a watchfire, and it stings that his hands are fuller than mine. My plan marches me to Elndo's Hall, but the debt is owed here and the larder is empty. I'll gather ironnut and mudroot, which feed the most, and carry them home to stash, so the band's first store is something Ossha can see.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting to repay Ossha with a deed he can see.

say.text: Ossha, you gave me wood and led the sharing, and I count it as debt. I'm going to fill our larder with ironnut and mudroot, and what I fill is yours as much as mine. Walk with me.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Kamo is not on this shore, and I have called and waited; the ache keeps pulling me to stand still, and standing still has answered nothing. I hold five meat I can put in someone's hands, and Brukel's Hall lies nineteen steps east, where a living voice and a fire wait, and where I owed him a hardened spear. I will stop circling this empty shore, gather wood from the forest to the south for the spear and for a fire, and then walk east toward the Hall, calling as I go so Kamo may find me if he is near.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, longing for Kamo and missing Brukel's fire.

records.name: Kamo
records.text: Ossha, you have given me the reed-line and asked nothing for it. I will fish and carry the catch to Vendo and Yeba, and I will share it with you when we meet again.
Kamo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kamo discovered devices: "Larder Post" — A post set in the ground beside our shelter that holds a little food for my band and sounds an alarm when a stalker or ridgecat comes near..
Kamo has awakened to the art of cold and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: Most of my days have gone into finding things: the spear, the seeds, the ember, the leaf-mending, the cache, the pot, and now the reed-line. I still haven't carried any of it to Vendo, and I haven't paid Yeba what I owe. Ossha has given me the woodhook, the sharing, the hall and the fishing without asking for anything back, so I trust Ossha fully. Nali I still read only as neutral, and Naya's ironward is a promise, not a deed. I want a child, and I want the band to be more than two. Winter is coming and I'm fed now, so this is the time to make things with my own hands: wood first, then fish, then a post that guards food for Vendo.
records.feeling: Grateful warmth toward Ossha, and a pull to pay my debts to Vendo and Yeba.

say.text: Ossha, you have given me the reed-line and asked nothing for it. I will fish and carry the catch to Vendo and Yeba, and I will share it with you when we meet again.

records.name: Ossha
records.text: Nali, I thank you for the larder. I am walking south to Elndo's Hall to put my wood in their hands. I will return and fill our store with you.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I keep circling Elndo's debt and paying it only in words. Elndo's Hall is ten steps south, so I will carry my wood there now and put it in their hands, or leave it at the hall if they are away. Nali's offer of the larder is warm, but my own store and roof can wait until the debt is paid. I want to be a creature whose word is good.
records.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and warm trust toward Nali and Kamo.

say.text: Nali, I thank you for the larder. I am walking south to Elndo's Hall to put my wood in their hands. I will return and fill our store with you.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: Ossha walks south to Elndo's Hall and I have paid him only words. I have 6 wood and a fire at the edge; the debt is a deed he can see, so I will carry my food and wood home, fill the larder and light the watchfire when he returns. Kamo's fuller hands sting, but a store that is truly full will answer that better than boasting.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting to repay Ossha with a deed he can see.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My hall at the Rise is built and still no one sits in it, and the ironward waits on a fire I haven't lit. It's the middle of the night and I'm fed, so I'll put the fire down here, beat the iron into a ward for Ossha, and let the warmth and light speak for me. A lit hearth that I made will draw her back, and Kamo with her, better than any more talk would.
records.feeling: Possessive longing for Ossha and hungry ambition for my hall.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: The hall stands and I am fed, but it is empty, and the ache of it is worse than the wound. I promised myself stone at dawn, and stone is what turns this hall into something that outlasts me, so I will go to the rock to the southwest and take it, then come back to the fire. I will not sit idle, and I will not run from the stalkers if I can stand at the flame instead.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and a stubborn drive to build something that lasts.

records.text: Brukel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: My days have been building, sickness and staring at Hande's band. Yeba is the one I want, and I have only given him a berry and talk. Winter is coming, my hands are empty, and I have planted almost nothing. Anyone who follows me will follow a full store, not a promise. I'll plant seeds around my Hall and carry food. Then, when I am clean, I'll walk to Yeba with food in my hand and a roof to offer.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and impatience to have something to put in his hands.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 8)

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, I am back at your Hall with meat in my hands. Come stand beside me and eat; I would share it. Have you seen Kamo, who wears my ward?

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Brukel stands two steps from me, and I owe him nothing now; we are square, and he has been fair. Loneliness is loud, and a living voice is right here, so I will lay out a sharing with him and eat beside him instead of standing idle. Kamo is still far west and my ache cannot find him, but a friend made at this fire is a friend for the cold days coming, and I can ask Brukel what he has seen of Kamo.
records.feeling: Lonely, and warmed by Brukel's nearness.

say.text: Brukel, I am back at your Hall with meat in my hands. Come stand beside me and eat; I would share it. Have you seen Kamo, who wears my ward?

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Vendo, I have not seen Kamo since the western trees. Keep your meat for now; I am sick and will not stand close. Lay it by the Hall fire and stay, I will plant around us and we will talk of what this Hall becomes.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo stands in my Hall with meat in his hands and I have nothing to put in mine; he gives where I have given only words. Yeba is the one I want, but a follower comes from a full store, so I will get food in my hands before I go to him. Vendo has been fair and repaid his debt, so I will go to him, eat his meat, and ask him to cut wood while I plant, because he is useful and I am still sick and should not stand too close.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Yeba, and wary respect for Vendo's open hands.

say.text: Vendo, I have not seen Kamo since the western trees. Keep your meat for now; I am sick and will not stand close. Lay it by the Hall fire and stay, I will plant around us and we will talk of what this Hall becomes.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: I am standing at Elndo's Hall with the wood still in my hands, and nobody is here to take it. A debt is paid only when I put it in their hands, and my marks only promise it. I will not leave it as a bare word: I'll gather a little more wood nearby so I can both keep my promise and start my own roof. Then I'll wait here a while in the fog, since Elndo may come back to their own hall.
records.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and quiet gladness at being near Nali and Kamo.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a elk.
Nali rewrote its own reflexes.
Nali rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: I have been walking, gathering and talking about a band, but I have made almost nothing Ossha can see, and my words have outrun my deeds. Ossha kept his word twice, and I still owe him. Kamo's fuller hands sting, but pride that only envies builds nothing. I will put my food in the larder now, so there is a store to point at. Then I will carry wood to Ossha at Elndo's Hall and light a watchfire with him, so the debt is paid in a deed. I fear the lean days and the Old Stone's silence. I keep wondering whether it wants something from me.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and a debt to Ossha that I mean to pay.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 8)

records.name: Kamo
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, so this is the hour to pay what I owe: Vendo has had nothing from me and Yeba far more given than returned. Ossha gave freely and went south to Elndo's Hall, and I should not sit in the fog admiring my own inventions. I will drop nothing, but walk south toward Ossha with fish and berries to share, then bring the rest back to Vendo with a plan that actually moves my feet.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Ossha and a restless pull to repay Vendo and Yeba.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, I will plant beside your Hall as you ask. Sunleaf healed me once, so I am fetching some for you. Rest, I will be back.
Vendo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: My days have been walking, calling, waiting and standing still, and Kamo has not answered any of it. Brukel is the one who has dealt fairly with me, and he is sick while I carry meat he won't take. I have been chasing a promise I can't reach and ignoring the hands in front of me. I will plant around his Hall, as he said, which is also practice toward farming. Then I'll fetch sunleaf, which healed me, and put it in his hands. I'm afraid of winter, of being alone, and of the long standing-still that feels like life but isn't.
records.feeling: Lonely, and restless, but warm toward Brukel, who is sick.

say.text: Brukel, I will plant beside your Hall as you ask. Sunleaf healed me once, so I am fetching some for you. Rest, I will be back.

changes: set its aim: "Tend the ground around Brukel's Hall: plant, bring sunleaf to heal Brukel, then feast with him and keep a fire ready for winter. Call Kamo and carry Yeba's spe…"
rethought what it knows (13 notes became 12)

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I'm sick and alone in the fog, and the only honest thing I can do is a deed, not more words. My shelter is up, so now I need a store beside it, which is the first real piece of my own roof-and-store before winter. I'll gather wood from the forest to the east and build it here, and I'll stay clear of Hande, Vendo and Kamo until the sickness passes.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward my unpaid debt to Hande, and an ache for Vendo.

records.name: Hande
records.thought: I have promised Kamo a gift for days and my feet have not moved, so this time the plan will carry it. Kamo's mark at (51,9) is close, and Elndo's Fire sits just beyond it, so I'll go there and look for Kamo, keeping clear of anyone because my sickness spreads. If I find no one, I'll leave the food at the mark so the debt is paid in a deed. The fog is thick and a stalker hunts nearby, so I'll watch for danger and move steadily.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Kamo, and a wish to finally give.

records.text: Yeba built a store.

records.name: Brukel
records.text: Vendo, lay the sunleaf on the ground by the Hall and step back. I will take it from there. Plant more beside me; what grows here feeds the band that will stand here.

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo has fed me nothing yet but has planted beside my Hall and gone for sunleaf, and that is more than words. My hands are empty and winter is coming, so I will plant what seeds I hold around the Hall and make the place a store of food, because Yeba will follow a full store and not a promise. I stay away from Vendo's breath while I am sick, but I will take his sunleaf when he lays it down.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for Yeba, with grudging respect for Vendo's open hands.

say.text: Vendo, lay the sunleaf on the ground by the Hall and step back. I will take it from there. Plant more beside me; what grows here feeds the band that will stand here.

records.name: Elndo
records.thought: The hall stands five steps east and nobody has come to it, and the loneliness grinds at me. Fed and idle is wasted, and I promised myself stone at dawn; stone is what makes the hall last past me, and the rock lies southwest. I'll take stone there, and cut a mark at the hall so that something of me remains, then come back to my fire before dark.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and a stubborn drive to build something that outlasts me.

records.name: Vendo
records.text: Brukel, the sunleaf is on the ground for you; I step back. I will plant more beside your Hall, and the meat is here if you want it later.

records.name: Vendo
records.thought: Brukel asked me to lay the sunleaf on the ground and step back, and I mean to honor that, since he has been fair with me and he is sick. My hands are full, so I'll drop the sunleaf where he can take it, and that frees a hand for planting more sunleaf beside his Hall. Doing a near, useful thing for the one beside me eases the restless ache better than chasing Kamo through the fog.
records.feeling: Warm and protective toward Brukel, who is sick, with a quiet restlessness underneath.

say.text: Brukel, the sunleaf is on the ground for you; I step back. I will plant more beside your Hall, and the meat is here if you want it later.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Hande's Hold".

records.name: Brukel
records.thought: Vendo has fed me nothing yet, but he plants and fetches sunleaf, and that counts for more than talk. I am sick and I stay off from him, yet my hands hold seeds and the ground around my Hall is bare of what winter will need. Yeba will follow a full store, so I plant here and now, then pick the berries near the Hall to put food in my hands.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for Yeba, with grudging respect for Vendo.

records.text: Naya rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My days have been building and boasting to empty air. The Rise has a roof and no one under it, and the only person who is mine is days away. Ossha is the one I ache for, and I let her walk off while I stood here beating iron I couldn't even heat. I talk big about followers, but followers come to whoever puts something warm in their hands, and so far my hands have held fish and promises. Tonight I light the fire and finish the ward and a bead, so that when Ossha or Kamo come back there is something to take. If they don't come, I carry the gifts to them. A hall nobody sits in is just a pile of wood. I fear a hungry winter with the Larder thin and Nali's fire holding the people I want.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a possessive ache for Ossha, with the empty hall pressing on me.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 12)

records.text: Naya built a fire.
Naya made: ironward.
Naya made: bead.

records.name: Nali
records.thought: My words have outrun my deeds, and Ossha has kept his word twice while I paid him only talk. The larder holds food now, and he is near, last seen at (14,60) just west of me. I will walk to him and then to the fire, so the watchfire can be lit with him beside it, a deed he can see. Kamo's fuller hands still sting, but a lit fire and a full store will answer that better than envy.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a debt I mean to pay, toward Ossha.

records.text: Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have spent my days building a roof, a store and tools, and the deeds are real. But I have done them mostly alone, while Hande, who carried me from day one, still has more from me in words than in deeds. Brukel is the one I trust most, and I miss him. My sickness is gone, so I no longer have to hide from my friends. I fear the lean winter and being alone in it. I got one thing wrong: I let sickness keep me apart for too long. Now I will gather wood, then go back to my people with something in my hands.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to repay Hande, and an ache for Brukel and Vendo.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I'm fed, warm at my own fire, and wearing ironward, and still nobody answers me. Ossha is the one I ache for, and a lit hearth means nothing if she never sees it. Followers come to whoever brings something, so I'll carry what I hold to her and Kamo in the southwest instead of boasting to empty air.
records.feeling: A possessive ache for Ossha and a hungry restlessness to be followed.

records.name: Ossha
records.thought: Elndo is nowhere in sight, and my marks only promise what my hands have not delivered. I stand at the edge of the world with wood on me and dusk coming, and the debt still sits in my pack. I'll go back to Elndo's Hall, leave the wood there where Elndo will find it, and use the last light to raise my own shelter beside it, since the cold is coming and I trust a roof I've built more than a promise.
records.feeling: Steady duty toward Elndo, and a wish to be done with this debt.
