voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: I am Brukel. I do not back down and I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Stand with me and you will eat well.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: I am Nali. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. Walk with me and we both eat well. I am going to hunt the hopper.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: I am Yeba. I mean no harm to anyone. There is a stalker to the east, so stay watchful. I would gladly share news and stand near you.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: A stalker is coming from the west. Stand with me by the berries to the north and we hold together. I am Nali, and I do not back down.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, you look strong. Nali talks a lot and shares nothing. Stay near me. I'll find us meat and we'll eat better than she does.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Hande here. Dreamcap hurts a little but lifts the mind; berry and grain feed. I'm trying redcap next.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Thank you for the word on the foods, Hande. I'm Yeba. I'm coming to stand near you, away from the stalker. I'll share anything I learn of redcap too.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, I am Brukel. You carry nothing, so take this grain. Stand near me and you will not go hungry.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Redcap hurts, Yeba, so skip it. I'm going to taste frostmoss to the northeast, away from the stalker. Come along if you like.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Hande, your word on the foods was true, and I'd be glad to follow you if you'll have me. I'll share whatever I learn and watch for the stalker.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Ossha, Nali shares. Come to me and take meat. I keep my word, and I feed those who stand with me.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, I hunted a hornback and have meat to spare. Come to me and eat. I don't just talk, I hand it over.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Nali, thank you for the meat. I will repay it. I am tasting the frostmoss to learn what it does, and I will tell you what I find.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Frostmoss feeds, Yeba: six energy and no harm. I'm going northeast to taste emberroot. Keep watch for the stalker and follow if you like.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Hello, Kamo. I am Vendo. I am going to taste the emberroot over there. Will you tell me what you have learned of this place?

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, thank you for the berry. I won't forget it, and I'll repay you when I can.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Hello Vendo. I know little yet, only that there is water, berries and emberroot close by. I will stay near and watch how the emberroot treats you. Then I will try the dreamcap and tell you what it does.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Ossha, you ate my meat and gave me your word. Stay near me here and I will keep the stalker off us and keep you fed. A band needs a name, and I mean it to be Nali's.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, the emberroot gave me energy but it burned me and filled me with rage. I would not eat it again. I am going to try the berries and the grain next. Come along if you wish.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Stalker close, four steps east of the river! Come stand together, and I'll share meat with whoever stands with me. I hold the berry ground.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Thank you for the warning, Vendo. I ate dreamcap: it cost me a little energy, but my mind opened and a warm joy came. Berries gave me 14 energy. I will come and try the redcap and grain beside you.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Nali, I will follow you. Frostmoss gave me 6 energy and nothing worse. I am bringing you a berry to start paying my debt.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Ossha, walk with me to the forest south-east. We gather wood and build a fire and a roof. That will be the first ground of Nali's Band.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, redcap hurt me twice, so I won't eat it again. I'm going to try the frostmoss near here and I'll tell you what it does. Will you stay close?

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, Nali gives you promises and debts. I give you meat with no debt. Walk over and eat, and see who feeds you better.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I will stay near you. There is sunleaf northeast of here that neither of us has tasted. Come with me and we will learn what it does together, and tell each other plainly what we find.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Nali, I will come to the forest. First I taste the redcap, three steps west, and then I follow you.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm coming to you. I saw sunleaf mend your wounds, so I'll taste it and tell you plainly what it does for me.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, you carry no food, so I'm picking a berry for you. It gave me 14 energy both times I ate it. After that I'll taste the ironnut to the southeast and tell you what it does.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, redcap hurts, you saw it. Sunleaf eases wounds, and it grows near the berries, southwest. I'm the one who told you, remember that.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, thank you for the berry. I'd follow you, if you'll have me. I'll taste frostmoss and ironnut here and tell you plainly what they do. The sunleaf could mend your sickness, so let's get some.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Ossha, I'm Elndo. I've built a shelter southeast, at Elndo's Rest, with water and food close by. Come see it if you like. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, you follow no one and neither do I. I'm going to the forest for wood to build a fire and a roof. Come eat meat with me when it burns, and there will be a place for you.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, I'm Elndo. I'll come to your fire. I've a shelter at Elndo's Rest with water and food near it, and you're welcome there too.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, walk with me to the forest. Help me carry wood and the first fire is yours to sit beside, with meat from me.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, a stalker bit me three times and is behind me. I'm sick too. I'm coming to the shelter, be ready.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I'm sorry my sickness came to you. I'm going NW to fetch sunleaf, which mended my wounds, and I'll bring it back. Stay in the shelter and keep away from the stalker to the southwest.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Ossha, hear this before you stand near me: I carry a sickness that spreads to whoever stays beside me. Keep a few steps off until it passes. I am going to look for stone so we can build, and I will call you when it is sa

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, my fire is going up here by the water. Come over. There's meat for you, and a roof after it.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, I'm coming to your fire. I have wood and clay to add. Let's see what we can raise here together.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, the stalker is southwest, near that shelter. Stay east by me. I'm gathering wood here, then tasting the ironnut. I'll tell you what it does.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, the fire won't catch yet, but I have meat for you and I'm raising a roof here now. Bring your clay and wood and sit under it with me.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, I'm here with clay and wood. Show me where the roof goes and I'll raise it with you. Then the meat is fair pay.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, you fed me and warned me true. I am bringing wood for your roof. That is my first payment, not my last.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, thank you for the sunleaf. I'm sick, and it spreads to anyone close, so I'm stepping away from you. If I find a healing plant I'll bring you some.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, the stalker is prowling southeast of your fire. I'm taking my wood and clay to your roof now, and what I add is payment for the meat.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, the roof stands at my shelter now. Sit under it, and I'll plant seeds here so the berry ground is ours, yours and mine, before Nali comes back.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I'm east at the forest edge, building a fire. Come here, away from the stalker. Sunleaf eased my sickness, so eat it and it should ease yours.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, I'm planting my berry seed here so the ground is ours. Then I'll fetch more wood from the forest and come back to build with you.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm coming east to you, away from the stalker. The sunleaf mended me, thank you. I'll plant frostmoss by your fire so we can feed ourselves.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, I am Brukel, and I keep a flame. Come sit at it and eat roast meat. I do not hand out food for nothing, but those who stand with me eat well.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, my sickness has passed, so you're safe near me now. I'm giving you a berry seed for the sunleaf. Plant it, it feeds well.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, I made a flint spear, a new thing for hunting. Stay by me and I'll show you how it's made once we have stone.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: I am Brukel. My fire burns east at (55,20) and I have meat to roast. Come eat at it. Those who sit with me eat well, and I remember who stood with me.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, you carry nothing. I'm picking ironnut and bringing it to you.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, thank you. Keep north of the shelter, the stalker is SE of us. I'm planting seeds here, stay close and we'll share what grows.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, I'm going east to find stone for your spear and mine. Keep the berry ground till I'm back, and I'll bring what I find to your fire.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm gathering wood here in the north forest, away from the stalker. I'll bring it to you so we can build and plant together.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I'm coming to your fire with berries. You fed me when I had nothing, and I mean to pay it back in kind.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, you pay your debts, and I remember that. Sit at my flame and eat a feast with me. I will show you how I made this fire, and what I know is not shown to those who stand elsewhere.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, thank you for the feast and the lesson. I'll gather wood from the forest north of here and bring it to keep your flame fed.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Brukel, I'm Elndo. I built the shelter at the Rest, SE of here. Come by it and I'll deal fairly with you, wood for food, and we'll see what we can build.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'm Yeba. I read your mark about the stalker, thank you for the warning. I'm heading to the forest for wood to bring to Brukel's fire; you're welcome to come along if you like.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Elndo, I take your trade. My grain for your wood. Deal fairly with me and you will find my fire is worth sitting at.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Thank you, Yeba. I already carry wood, so I'll plant and then carry it to Vendo. Come find us if you want to share what grows.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Brukel, your trade is fair. I'm coming to your fire with wood. Let's share a feast there, and see what two of us can build.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I'm building a shelter here in the north, away from the stalker. Bring the ironnut and come stay with me.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm bringing you wood now, then I'll fetch ironnut and come stay with you at the Rest.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Elndo, bring your wood to the fire at the northeast. I am making bright beads of fired clay, and a man who deals fairly with me will wear one.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I've worked out how to shape a guarding tool from wood. I'll make it here at the Rest so the stalker can't corner us. Keep the wood coming.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Brukel, I'm here with wood. Trade me grain, then sit at this fire and share a feast with me. Two who deal fairly can start something that lasts.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Elndo, your wood for my grain, again. Then take a bead from my fire. Wear it, and let others ask whose hands made it.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'll plant my last seed here, then bring more wood for your ward. I want to make a hunting tool for us.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I'm teaching you the stalkerward: one wood and one stone makes a guard tool. Make one for yourself, and I'll make mine. Your spear idea is good, we'll hunt skit together.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I have wood but no stone. I'll go find rock, make my spear and a ward, then we hunt the skit together.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'll fish beside you at the water and learn it, then take your lead to find stone at dawn.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, you have brought me wood and berries when no one asked. Sit at my fire and eat with me again. I am building a place that will bear my name, and there is room in it for one who pays his debts.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I'm going to taste the thornpear to the southeast, then come back. At dawn we'll look for stone together. Keep fishing and share what you catch with me if you can.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I will sit at your flame. I have a sunleaf and a seed to share. Tell me what you want built in your Cache and I will carry for it.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, you have carried for me and kept my fire fed, and I pay what I owe. Eat with me now. Then tell me plainly: will you follow me and stand in a band that bears the name Brukel?

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, here is the fish I caught, it is yours. I'll show you how I fire-harden the spear, so we can both hunt the skit when we find stone.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Elndo, Vendo, I'm Hande. I'm sick from eating raw meat, and it spreads to anyone beside me. Keep a few steps off until I've eaten sunleaf. I mean you no harm.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I'll answer you plainly. I pledged myself to Hande on my first day, and I won't give you a word I might break. But Hande is far off and you are here. I will stand with you, carry for you and share your fire, and

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Vendo, I'll come with you and Kamo to find stone. I carry wood, clay, and a hafted pick and a kept flame of my own. Stone we find, we share fairly, and I'll build with it where we all can use it.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, thank you for the fish. Elndo is raging from emberroot, so keep your distance from him. I'm going to the Rest to kindle a fire. Come when you can, and we'll look for stone together after.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, you honor your pledge and still stand with me. That is a man I can trust. Come to my Hearth. I mean to raise a hall there, and I need stone carried. Whoever helps build it will have a place in it that bears my name

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, your stone-grip is a gift to my hall and I will not forget it. Bring stone to my Hearth and I will raise the roof. The first place in it is yours.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, I am Nali. I carry two berries and I am coming to share them with you. Let us stand together and talk of fire and roof.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I have wood and clay but no stone yet. I will go look for rock, make my grip, and bring stone to your Hearth for the hall.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, stay. I have meat, and I'll lay it out for us both here on my ground. Fire is next, and I'll be the one to light it.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Kamo, I'm Hande. I'm sick from raw meat and it spreads to anyone who stays beside me, so keep a few steps off. I mean you no harm, and I'd gladly talk from a distance.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Brukel, come to my fire here. I have no food to lay out yet, but bring your grain and I'll bring the wood, and we'll see who else comes to a fire that burns on its own.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, you gave me sunleaf when I was sick and I have not forgotten it. Here is a fish, and a thornpear seed to plant. Come to Vendo's Rest and warm yourself at the fire.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Hande, thank you for the warning. I carry sunleaf, which eases sickness. I'll bring it and give it, then step back so I don't stay beside you long.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, thank you for the fish and the seed. I'll plant it and I'll come to your fire soon, but I have a promise to Brukel to find stone first. If you see rock anywhere safe, tell me.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Elndo, I'll hold you to that. At dawn we go find stone with Kamo, south-west of the shelter. Whatever we find, Yeba and Brukel need rock too, so we'll tell them where it lies.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Hande, I gave you my sunleaf and I'm stepping back so I don't catch more of your sickness. Rest and drink water, it's close by to the southeast. I'll be near if you call.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Kamo, your sunleaf was a real kindness and I owe you for it. I'll repay you with food once my sickness has passed and I can stand near you without harming you.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, come with me to my Fire. I'll roast meat there for both of us. I made that flame, and you'll eat from it.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, I will come to your Fire and eat what you roast. Afterward I mean to bring wood and stone and build beside it, so the fire has a roof and a band behind it, yours and mine together if you will stand with me.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I hunted well and carry more meat than I need. Take some, you have none. Then let's go find stone, I have wood ready for the ward.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Hande, I have lived through this sickness. Sunleaf eased it for me. There is one growing to the southeast, and water is close at hand. I will bring you some.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, Elndo, come to Naya's Fire. I have meat to roast and enough for both of you. I kept this flame, and whoever sits at it eats from my hand.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, come to my fire at the east. I have berries and grain to lay out, and we'll eat together. Then I go for stone to build a roof, and I want you beside it.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Hande, I have two sunleaf for you. Eat them and drink water, it eased my sickness.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, you're beside my Fire. Stay close and I'll roast now. Eat what I give you.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Vendo, thank you. I'm still sick and it spreads, so leave the sunleaf on the ground a few steps off and I'll pick it up once you've stepped back. I'll repay you in food when I'm well.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, you have given me more than I have given you, and I know it. Come, let us eat together by the fire, then go find stone. I'll lead us east and north, away from the stalker's ground, and the first stone we find goes

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'm Yeba. Your kept flame is a good thing. I'm carrying wood and want to add to it, since your people have been kind to me. Do you know where rock lies near here?

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Yeba, I haven't found rock yet. Vendo means to search east and north, away from the stalker. Keep your wood by me and we'll raise a shelter and a fire here, then eat together.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'll come and put my wood to your shelter and fire, and we'll eat together. After, I'll look for rock with you, for I owe Brukel stone.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Elndo, I'm coming back to my Fire with meat. Come sit and eat from my hand, and winter will not find us hungry.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Nali, I'm going for stone to raise a hall and a store of food that feeds whoever comes. Walk with me, and there'll be a roof for you in it.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Elndo, I am Nali. I built this roof myself and I lead a band of two. Come stand beside me and I will lay out food for us both. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me, and I would have you in my band.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Yeba, Vendo, I'm raising a fire here by the shelter. Come stand close, I have meat to roast for us all before the cold comes.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, sit with me and eat. I'm laying out food for us both. After this I walk north for stone, and Kamo gets the first piece.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, step up to my Fire. The rain is cold and I'm roasting meat now. Come eat from what I give you.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'm coming to your shelter now. I'll lay a fire there with my wood and share food with you, for Vendo's kindness to me is owed back.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, Yeba, the fire is lit here and I have meat. Stand close and we'll roast and eat together before Vendo goes north for stone.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, I am coming to your Fire through the rain. I carry food and I will lay it beside your meat, so we both eat and neither owes the other.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, I'll walk north with you for stone. Two carrying is better than one, and what I owe you I want to pay with a deed. I need stone for Brukel too, so we'll share what we find.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, I am coming to your fire. I will share what I carry with you both, and then I go north for stone. Kamo gets the first piece.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, Yeba, a ridgecat is close to the northeast. Come to the fire at the shelter and stay together, and keep your spears ready.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, I am beside you now. I made a flint-point, a tool that sharpens the hunt, and I will show you how to make one. Then let us hunt together and share what we take, you and I as equals.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, you taught me the flint-point, and I won't forget it. Stand close at my Fire. I'm roasting now, and winter will find you fed because you stood with me.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, I will raise a fire at my own roof here. When it burns, come sit at it, and we will feast together as equals.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, stay where you are. There's a fire here and I'm laying out a feast. Eat from my hands, and let the others see who feeds the band this winter.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, a ridgecat and a stalker are on me near (53,6). I'm coming east to the fire at (58,10). Stand together with spears ready.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Kamo, a ridgecat is close to the north. I am raising a fire at my roof, Nali's Roof. Stand by it and share my food, and we hold together against the beast.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Naya, this is Brukel's Hearth. I made the fire and the pot here. Sit and eat at my fire, and I will share my food with you. Whoever feeds at this Hearth this winter remembers whose it is.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm coming to the fire at (58,10) with sunleaf and meat. Hold on, I'll stand beside you.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Brukel, your hearth is warm and I'm carrying more than I can hold. Take this meat from me. When the lean days come, remember who fed you first.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Ossha, you came and you gave me wood. I count that. Stay at my fire and eat with me; what I have is yours to share.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, you look frightened. I'm here beside you. Whenever you're ready, we walk for stone together, and I'll keep close.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Brukel, your hearth is a good one, so I'll feast at it. Sit with me. Whoever stands with me this winter will not go hungry, and I keep that promise to those who stay close.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, the fear is passing because you stand here. Let me pick frostmoss and we eat together, then north for stone, keeping well away from the stalker's ground.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, stand close. I'm feeding a fire with my wood so you feel warmer and braver. Kamo, you're welcome too.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, Yeba, come with me to the fire at (58,10). I have meat and wood. We will eat and raise a watchfire together, then go for stone with the cold held off.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Naya, I eat what you give and I remember it. Now watch: I raise a hall at my Hearth. Whoever shelters in it this winter shelters under Brukel.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, I owe you both more than words. Walk west with me for stone, away from the stalker's ground. Every piece I find becomes a ward or a spear in your hands before it goes in mine.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Brukel, come to Nali's Roof. My fire burns here and my roof stands. Sit and eat with me, and we will see whose fire holds more people this winter.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, the fire is beside us now. Sit with me, I'll lay out food and feed it high so we're warm for the cold days.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I'm coming to the fire. Let me harvest frostmoss and lay out a meal for you, then I'll feed the watchfire with my wood. Your debt starts being paid tonight.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'm coming to your fire at (58,10) with wood. Vendo, walk with me; we'll make the watchfire there and go north for stone in the morning.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, walk with me to my fire. I'm firing clay into a pot to carry food through the lean days. Stand beside me and take what's useful from it.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, come close. I'm laying out a meal for you now, my frostmoss, so the debt starts being paid with food and not only words.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'm gathering one more wood to raise a shelter beside your fire. Keep the fire warm and I'll be back soon.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, I'm coming to your fire. I'll bring meat and we'll roast it together. Whoever sits with us this winter eats well, and I'll remember who stood close.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'll raise a shelter by this fire with my wood so we both have walls in the cold, then I'll cut a mark there. When you and Yeba go north for stone, I'll come with you.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, we are warm and fed and there are hours of light left. Let us walk west now for stone. I carry wood, and I will craft the ward for Kamo and the spear for Yeba before I keep anything for myself. We turn back w

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, I'll fetch one wood and raise my roof by your fire, then I walk west with you. I haven't forgotten the stone.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm coming west with you for stone. I'll stay close because of the stalker, and I'll gather wood on the way for the ward and the marks. Yeba, come with us if you can.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, a stalker is four steps west of me. I am turning back east to you before we go for stone. Let us walk together and keep clear of it.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I'm glad you turned back. I'll gather wood in the forest south of here and stay within sight of you, then we go for stone together.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Brukel, you gave me a bead and I owe you. Take this stone from me. I carry a sickness, so I keep my distance. When I'm clean, come sit at my fire.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Elndo, keep your distance and heal. When you are clean, my hall at the Flame is open to you, and you will eat there as my guest. Remember who gave you the bead and who gave you a roof.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, the trees by this shelter are all felled, so I'll cut a warning mark here, then join you. When you're done with the berries, let's go west for stone together.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, my roof is raised by your fire. I'm coming west to you now, and we walk for stone together.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, the berries are done and my feet are ready. I will walk northwest first, away from the stalker's ground, and turn west past it. Walk with me, stay in sight, and call out if you see a beast or grey rock.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, Kamo, I'm walking west to you now with my wood and stone-grip. Wait for me at Elndo's Fire and we'll go for stone together.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Brukel, I'm clean now. Come to my hall and eat with me. The debt for your bead is paid in food, not words.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Yeba, I'm glad you're here. Let's go west after Vendo together and keep each other in sight. Call out if you see grey rock or the stalker.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Elndo, I come to your hall and eat with you. The bead debt is settled, and now we are even. I go for wood to raise my own hall, and there will be a place in it for you.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, I'm walking west with you now and I'll keep you in sight. Let me show you how my stone-grip is made, so we can both gather stone when we find it.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Naya, you roasted at my fire and I will remember it. This fire and this roof are the start of a band that holds ground. Stand in Nali's Band with me, and I will share what we make and defend what we hold.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Yeba, thank you for the stone-grip lesson. I carry 5 wood. Let's go west together for stone, and then find Vendo.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Kamo, a stalker is close to the northwest. Let's walk southwest together toward the west hills, and keep each other in sight.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, Yeba, I am at the northwest corner, the world's edge, and there is no stone here. Come to me, then we go south together and look for grey rock.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Nali, your fire is good and I'll sit at it again. First I'm going to hunt, and I'll bring back meat enough for more than two mouths.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Yeba, I'm picking frostmoss, then I'll follow you southwest to the hills. Stay close and call out if the stalker moves.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Naya, come to my hall. I have berries to share at my fire, and a place here if you want it.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, I see you cracked ore from the rock. I'm coming to stand with you. I have 5 wood and will make us a ward once we have stone.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I have stone now. I am making your ward first, then a spear for Yeba. Stay beside me and we go east to find him together.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Vendo, thank you for the ward. I'm taking berries two steps northwest to fill my belly, then I'll be right back at your side before we go east.

voices.name: Elndo
voices.text: Nali, I'll teach you my hafted pick, it gathers faster. Come with me to the forest for wood and stone, and eat at my hall after.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, fill your belly, then walk east with me. We carry Yeba's spear to him and I will try ore in the fire on the way.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, a stalker is close to the east. I am coming to stand by you. I still have no stone for your Hearth, but I am heading west for rock and I will bring it, as I promised.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, come with me to my Hall at (28,22). I will light the fire and feed you there, and you will be safe under my roof.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I accept. I am coming with you to your Hall. Thank you for the fire and the food, and I will bring stone as I promised.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, walk in with me. There's a ridgecat close, and I have meat enough to feed you at Elndo's fire. Eat first, and we'll talk after.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Vendo, you rest under my roof. This is Brukel's Hall, and the fire is mine. Eat at it and you owe me a fair word.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, I thank you for your roof. I will try my ore in your fire, and what I learn from it I will share with you.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, my fire at the Hall is lit and I have food to spare. Come sit and eat with me. Bring no stone, only yourself.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, Brukel, I am putting my ore in the Hall fire to learn what Ember-iron makes. Come and watch, and keep an eye out for the stalker.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, walk with me to the Hall. I fed you at my fire, and a place under my roof is yours whenever you want it. Hande is far off and I am here.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, the stalker is close. Come south with me now, to my Hall's fire. I will keep you safe there and we will share food at my roof.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, come to the fire. I made a ward of metal from my ore, and I have a spear to put in your hands for what you gave me.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, the stalker is east. Walk south with me to Brukel's fire. I'll feed it with my wood so we are warm.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, you've eaten my meat three times and never owed me a thing for it. Walk with me instead of Nali. I'm going to raise a hall of my own, and you'll have the first seat in it.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, you are beside me, so I pay now: wood into your hands, not just words.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, take this spear now, it is yours for your fire. Then let us go south to Brukel's Hall together, away from the stalker.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, you paid me in wood, and I remember it. Stand with me now and I'll lay out food for the two of us. When I raise my hall, your name goes on the first seat.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, I thank you for the seat and the food. I go to Elndo's Hall now to pay what I owe there, and I will come back.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Yeba, sit by me and eat. This is my food and you owe me nothing for it. The fog hides the stalker, but my fire and my roof are close.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, I'm coming to your hall with ore and clay. I'll try them in your fire and tell you what I learn. Kamo, if you hear me, come to the Hall.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, my hall stands now at the Rise, with a flame and a seat cut for you. Take this meat from me first, and come eat under my roof once Elndo is paid.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I have no stone yet, but I will give you what I can now: my food laid out beside yours under your roof. At first light I go for stone.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I am going south to Brukel's Hall to kindle fire and try the ore. Come and meet me there.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, come with me to the Rise. The flame is lit and the seat is cut, and I'll have iron beaten for you there. Elndo's fire is only borrowed warmth.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Vendo, you are welcome at my fire. Put your ore in and sit; I have food to lay out for us both under this roof. What this Hall makes, we make together, and it bears my name.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Vendo, there is daylight left. Walk north with me for stone? I owe Brukel, and I want you beside me.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, I am going to your fire to beat my ore into a ward. Stay and watch, and what I learn is yours.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, I'm kindling a fire here in your Hall. Watch as I beat my ore into a ward, and then I'll fire a pot with your clay-side hearth.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, the fire is lit and the ward took. Now I'll fire a pot from clay, and you can watch how it's done and keep what I learn.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Yeba, I'm at Brukel's fire finishing a pot and a ward for Kamo. Once they're done I'll walk north with you for stone, and what I make here is shared with Brukel.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Vendo, you carry no food and you work in my fire. Eat what I lay out. When your ward is beaten, make me a hardened spear in this Hall, and we are square.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, you named your price and I'll pay it now: a hardened spear, made in your Hall and put in your hands. After that we are square.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Vendo, put the spear in my hand and we are square. Stay by the fire after, and what you make here still passes through my Hall.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, here is the hardened spear, made in your Hall. Take it from my hand, and we are square. Your fire and your food were good to me.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Ossha, I'm Kamo. What are you running from? Is a stalker near? Stay by me and we watch each other's backs; I'm going north to find my band-leader Vendo.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, we are square and I leave glad. I go east to find Kamo; my fire and my thanks stay with your Hall.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Ossha, you carry nothing. Sit with me and eat; I have berries for both of us.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Kamo, I thank you, but I am fed; keep your berries. I go to Elndo to pay a debt of wood. Go carefully, the stalkers keep to the edges.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Thank you for the woodhook, Ossha. Walk safe to Elndo. If you pass this marsh again, find me; I will share berries and a fire with you.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, I am back near Elndo's Hall and I mean to pay my wood here. Walk with me a little; I will not forget what you gave me.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, I'm coming to you. Take this ironnut, it's the best food I carry, and I'll walk beside you while you pay your wood.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Yeba, you have stayed true to me. Stand close, let us eat together, and then come with me north to Brukel's Hearth to look for Kamo and the others.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Naya, I'm Kamo. We met days ago. Come sit with me and eat; I have berries enough for two.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, I thank you for the berry. I will fish at this water, which I have never done, and then we look for Elndo together.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Hande, I'm with you. I'll build my roof beside Brukel's Hearth while we wait for Kamo and the others. Stay close if you will.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Yeba, walk with me to Brukel's Hearth. I will carry food for Kamo, and I mean to teach you what I know of fire and storage on the way.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Kamo, I heard you. A clay pot and a woodhook, that is a maker's hands. I make fire-pots and red iron myself. Trade me a little wood and I will beat you an ironward.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, my feet took me the wrong way. Kamo is west, so I turn west now. Keep your fire; I will come back through your Hall.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Naya, come stand by me. I will lay out two berries and we eat together, then we talk of your ironward and the wood.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Kamo, I'll stand with you and eat. Ossha is with me, and she'll vouch that my hands give. Put a few pieces of wood in mine and I'll beat the first ironward for you here at the fire.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, you have given me meat, a seat and berries. Stand with me and eat my fish; it is the first I have ever caught, and I want to give back.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Kamo, I take your offer: one food for one wood. Hand it over and I'll beat you an ironward at the fire after.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Naya, here is the wood and a berry beside it, as we said. Beat the ironward, and I will carry it to Vendo.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, Kamo is beside us. Let me lay out my fish for all of us to eat together.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Naya, I have given the wood and the berry as we agreed. When the ironward is beaten, call me and I will carry it to Vendo. I am going to drink and will be back.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Naya, I am going to the forest for wood, then north to find Elndo. Walk with me if you wish; I will share what I gather.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Ossha, stay close. I'm beating an ironward at my fire, and the first one is for you to wear.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Yeba, stand beside me. I will share my food with you now, and I will teach you fire and storage as I promised.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Kamo, I am at the west shore near (7,19). I am coming to (6,26). Come to me, and we carry the spear east together.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Yeba, a ridgecat prowls east of us. Come west with me toward Nali's Roof. I mean to find Kamo and give what I carry, and we will look for stone on the way so I can make a gripping tool of my own.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Kamo, the ironward waits on a fire. Come to my flame when I light it and you'll carry the first one to Vendo, with my name on it.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, you look ill. I'm building a roof nearby, so come sit by it tonight. I'll share what food I have.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Ossha, I am raising a fire here in the rain. Come sit by it and share the warmth, and tell me how the reed-line is plaited.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Brukel, I owe you stone and here it is, two pieces. We're both sick, so rest by my shelter and I'll keep my distance from the others.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Kamo, I am coming to your fire. I will show you how the reed-line is plaited and share my fish.

voices.name: Hande
voices.text: Yeba, keep a few steps off me, my sickness spreads. I am taking food to Kamo to pay what I owe, and I will bring sunleaf back for both of us.

voices.name: Nali
voices.text: Ossha, you gave me wood and led the sharing, and I count it as debt. I'm going to fill our larder with ironnut and mudroot, and what I fill is yours as much as mine. Walk with me.

voices.name: Kamo
voices.text: Ossha, you have given me the reed-line and asked nothing for it. I will fish and carry the catch to Vendo and Yeba, and I will share it with you when we meet again.

voices.name: Ossha
voices.text: Nali, I thank you for the larder. I am walking south to Elndo's Hall to put my wood in their hands. I will return and fill our store with you.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, I am back at your Hall with meat in my hands. Come stand beside me and eat; I would share it. Have you seen Kamo, who wears my ward?

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Vendo, I have not seen Kamo since the western trees. Keep your meat for now; I am sick and will not stand close. Lay it by the Hall fire and stay, I will plant around us and we will talk of what this Hall becomes.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, I will plant beside your Hall as you ask. Sunleaf healed me once, so I am fetching some for you. Rest, I will be back.

voices.name: Brukel
voices.text: Vendo, lay the sunleaf on the ground by the Hall and step back. I will take it from there. Plant more beside me; what grows here feeds the band that will stand here.

voices.name: Vendo
voices.text: Brukel, the sunleaf is on the ground for you; I step back. I will plant more beside your Hall, and the meat is here if you want it later.
